Job.JobTitle: Territory Sales Director - Management Liability & Professional Liability
Job.JobDescription:
Company Details

Why Join Berkley Select?

At Berkley Select, you'll join a high performing organization that combines the strength and stability of W. R. Berkley Corporation with the agility, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit of a specialty insurer.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Own and grow your territory with significant autonomy.
  • Partner with industry leading underwriting professionals.
  • Build meaningful relationships with top brokers nationwide.
  • Influence business strategy and market expansion initiatives.
  • Advance your career within one of the most respected organizations in specialty insurance.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary Range: $150,000 to $175,000 annually

Actual compensation will be determined based on geographic location, experience, qualifications, and overall market factors.

Total Rewards Package

  • Annual performance-based incentive opportunity
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company contributions
  • Profit Sharing Program
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • Tuition Assistance and Professional Development Support
  • Industry Education and Certification Opportunities
  • Comprehensive Wellness Benefits

Berkley Select delivers professional liability insurance solutions to individuals, businesses, professional services firms, and nonprofit organizations.

As a Berkley company, Berkley Select is staffed with a team of experts with a specific focus on Professional Liability. Berkley Select utilizes individual risk underwriting, loss control, and claims practices to provide superior products and services to its customers.

Berkley Select is a Berkley Company. W. R. Berkley, founded in 1967, is one of the nation's premier commercial lines property casualty insurance providers. W. R. Berkley Corporation (NYSE: WRB).

Company URL: https://www.berkleyselect.com

The company is an equal employment opportunity employer.LI - Remote

Responsibilities

Drive Growth. Build Relationships. Shape the Future of Professional Liability!

We are seeking dynamic, relationship focused sales professionals to join our growing team as Territory Sales Manager, ideally based in PA or FL, with addtional preferred states as follows: AZ, CO, GA, IL, IN, KY, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, SC, TN, TX, VA.

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence strategy, drive profitable growth, and expand Berkley Select's market presence across your assigned territory.

If you thrive on building relationships, developing market strategies, creating growth opportunities, and collaborating with high performing underwriting teams, this opportunity is for you.

What You'll Do

As the primary field representative for Berkley Select, you will serve as a trusted advisor to brokers, producers, and distribution partners while driving profitable new business and strengthening existing relationships.

Strategic Broker Development

  • Develop and execute territory business plans focused on profitable growth and market expansion.
  • Build, strengthen, and manage executive level relationships with retail and wholesale broker partners.
  • Conduct strategic business reviews, planning sessions, and joint growth initiatives.
  • Identify and capitalize on cross selling opportunities across Berkley Select's product portfolio.
  • Recruit, evaluate, and appoint new agency and broker partners aligned with company growth objectives.

Territory Growth & Market Expansion

  • Analyze market trends, competitive intelligence, and distribution opportunities to uncover new business opportunities.
  • Expand Berkley Select's presence within key target industries and underserved markets.
  • Develop targeted growth strategies that align with corporate and regional business objectives.
  • Partner with underwriting leadership to identify and pursue high value opportunities.

Business Development & Pipeline Management

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified new business opportunities.
  • Leverage data, analytics, and market intelligence to prioritize production efforts and maximize territory performance.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed growth, retention, and profitability goals.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility, forecasting, and activity reporting through CRM and sales platforms.

Product Expertise & Market Leadership

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Management Liability and Professional Liability insurance solutions.
  • Maintain deep knowledge of competitive products, industry trends, and marketplace developments.
  • Deliver impactful broker training, product presentations, and educational sessions.
  • Collaborate with underwriting, claims, marketing, and leadership teams to drive strategic initiatives and solve complex challenges.

Relationship Management

  • Establish trusted advisor relationships with key broker partners and influencer stakeholders.
  • Lead stewardship meetings and executive level relationship reviews.
  • Represent Berkley Select at industry conferences, networking events, and broker functions.
  • Create meaningful engagement opportunities through regional events and flagship company programs.

What Makes You Successful

You are a strategic business builder who combines strong insurance expertise with relationship driven sales skills. You know how to create opportunities, influence decision makers, and deliver profitable growth while positioning yourself as a valued partner to brokers and clients.

Qualifications

  • Required Qualifications

    • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and insurance industry experience.
    • Minimum 5 years of experience within the insurance industry.
    • Demonstrated success in business development, territory management, or broker distribution sales.
    • Strong knowledge of Management Liability, Professional Liability, or other specialty insurance lines.
    • Proven ability to develop and manage high value broker relationships.
    • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship building skills.
    • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to leverage data to make informed business decisions.
    • Ability to travel up to 50%.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Established broker and wholesale relationships within assigned territories.
    • Demonstrated history of generating significant new business growth and expanding distribution networks.
    • Extensive understanding of large and complex professional liability risk exposures.
    • Experience utilizing CRM platforms, sales analytics tools, and AI driven technologies to support business development strategies.
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and business intelligence tools.
    • Ability to thrive in both independent and highly collaborative environments.

Additional Company Details

We do not accept any unsolicited resumes from external recruiting firms.

Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

What's the culture like at Assurant?
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Aon is looking for a Customer Service Specialist

As a Customer Service Specialist you will contribute to the success of our Private Flood Insurance Program business. Not only will you become a valued team member, but you will also grow your skills with a revered company in the risk management industry.

What the day will look like:

Under moderate supervision, the Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for taking inbound calls along with underwriting and processing private flood insurance documents in accordance with our carrier agreements, surplus lines rules, and state regulations.   • Process flood insurance policies using web-based applications.

Skills and experience that will lead to success:

  • 1+ year of office and/or administrative background

  • Customer Service experience, including telephone communication, will be extremely beneficial
  • Must be able to work 8:00a-5:00p MDT or 9:00a-6:00p MDT
  • Strong organizational and interpersonal skills with attention to detail
  • Proficiency in keying alphanumeric information with accuracy and adequate speed and the use of basic office equipment, such as copiers, faxes, voicemail
  • Ability to shift between priorities, as needed, throughout the workday while maintaining an established level of productivity using time-management techniques
  • Prior experience in the insurance industry will be helpful

Education:

  • High School Diploma or GED

Posting Description

Who We Are:

Diversified Brokerage Services (part of NFP, an Aon company) is one of the largest brokerage general agencies in the United States specializing in life insurance, and we're proud of our roots, starting as a family run business in 1968 and growing to where we are today. NFP is an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers who help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach.

This position exists to provide DBS with a dedicated resource focused on acquiring and growing relationships with new individual brokers, producer groups and national accounts as well as growing relationships with existing brokers, producer groups and national accounts. Job Description

Join Aon Affinity as a Data Product Manager and help shape the future of data, analytics, AI, and decision-making across the business! This role can be based virtually or in a hybrid office setting, depending on location and business needs, offering flexibility aligned with Aon's Smart Working policy.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

As the Enterprise Data Product Manager, you will lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for enterprise data products that enable growth, operational excellence, customer experiences, analytics, automation, and AI-powered decision-making across Aon Affinity. You will serve as the key link between business stakeholders, Product Domains, Data Analysts, Product Analysts, and Data Engineering teams, ensuring data is managed as a strategic business capability.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Defining and managing enterprise data product roadmaps, priorities, and investment decisions aligned to business goals and domain strategies.
  • Partnering with leaders across Growth & Distribution, Payments, Servicing, Claims, and other business areas to identify data opportunities, business requirements, and measurable outcomes.
  • Translating business needs into scalable, reusable data products including curated datasets, data services, APIs, semantic models, reporting foundations, and AI-ready data assets.
  • Providing day-to-day direction, prioritization, and coaching to Data Analysts and Product Analysts while connecting discovery, analytics, and engineering delivery through a shared roadmap.
  • Collaborating closely with Data Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Technology teams to deliver secure, governed, and scalable data solutions.
  • Driving data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, privacy, and stewardship practices that build trusted enterprise data assets.
  • Enabling analytics, business intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, and intelligent automation through strong data foundations.
  • Measuring adoption, business outcomes, utilization, and return on investment while continuously improving enterprise data products and capabilities.

How this opportunity is different

This is a highly visible role that will help define how Aon Affinity leverages data as a strategic competitive advantage. Rather than supporting a single function, you'll work across multiple product domains, business leaders, analysts, and engineering teams to create enterprise-scale capabilities that drive measurable business value.

You will have the opportunity to influence data strategy, shape future AI-enabled capabilities, and establish reusable data products that support growth, customer experiences, operational excellence, and innovation. You'll join a collaborative environment where product thinking, analytics, and technology come together to solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes across the organization.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Data Product Management, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Strategy, or a related discipline, with demonstrated ownership of products, platforms, or business capabilities throughout their lifecycle.
  • Strong experience translating business problems into product requirements, roadmaps, priorities, and measurable outcomes while working within Agile or product-led environments.
  • Working knowledge of modern data ecosystems, enterprise data concepts, analytics platforms, data products, APIs, semantic models, SQL, and Python (or similar analytical programming languages).
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, facilitate discovery sessions, and provide direction and coaching to analysts and business contributors.
  • Experience supporting data governance, data quality, analytics, AI/ML initiatives, or enterprise data capabilities, preferably within insurance, financial services, brokerage, or other regulated industries.

Education

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative field (such as Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar).

The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $93,500 - $120,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

A summary of all the benefits offered for this position:

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance. This role does not accrue vacation. Rather, this role is eligible to take paid time off at the discretion of the employee and management in accordance with company policy and practices. Various other types of leaves of absence; paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

Positioned uniquely between strategic advisory and brokerage functions, this role is part of Aon's well-known construction and infrastructure platform. As a Senior Account Executive, C&I - South Region, you will employ Aon's rich data, analytics, and market connections to develop and execute integrated, multi-line insurance solutions for complex projects. You will lead specialist teams in different regions, influence risk management from project launch through completion, and provide outstanding solutions that surpass standard placements.

This position is hybrid, offering the option to work from Atlanta, GA, Houston, TX or one of our Florida offices in Tampa, Jacksonville, or Miami.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

As a Senior Account Executive, you will advise clients on effective risk transfer, insurance design, and contract risk oversight to deliver outstanding results. The position also acts as a client representative with contracting and financing partners and leads collaborative brokerage teams across various insurance lines, including Workers' Compensation or equivalent experience, General Liability, Professional Liability, Environmental Liability, and Builders Risk.

Strategic Advisory & Risk Management

  • Serve as a subject matter expert on construction-phase risk transfer, risk financing, and risk control strategies
  • Evaluate project-specific risks and provide assessments of risk allocation, insurability, and market appetite
  • Advise clients on value-for-money risk transfer strategies applying Aon's proprietary data, benchmarking, and analytics
  • Provide guidance to ensure seamless and effective risk transfer among all project collaborators
  • Establish and maintain insurance cost benchmarks to support informed client decision-making

Client Advocacy & Contract Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for clients in discussions with contractors, lenders, and joint venture partners
  • Provide contract risk advisory services, including insurance and indemnity review and negotiation support
  • Deliver thought leadership and client education sessions, including insights on U.S. versus international construction risk and insurance practices

Insurance Program Development & Brokerage Delivery

  • Lead the design and placement of best-in-class, project-specific insurance programs in collaboration with Aon product and specialty leaders
  • Coordinate brokerage teams across multiple lines of coverage to provide integrated, efficient insurance solutions
  • Prepare and lead insurance market presentations and insurer engagement strategies
  • Collaborate with internal analytics teams and external experts on EML/PML analyses and related risk modeling

Project & Collaborator Management

  • Act as the project manager across Aon's brokerage, advisory, analytics, and global service teams
  • Drive alignment across geographies, fields, and service lines to deliver consistent client outcomes
  • Translate complex insurance structures and coverage concepts into clear, practical guidance for non-insurance collaborators

How this opportunity is different

This role sits at the dynamic intersection of strategic advisory and brokerage execution within Aon's global construction and infrastructure platform. As a Senior Account Executive, you will use Aon's comprehensive data, analytics, and market relationships to design and place integrated, multi-line insurance solutions for complex, large-scale projects. You'll coordinate specialist teams across geographies, influence risk outcomes from project inception through delivery, and deliver distinctive, impactful solutions that go well beyond traditional placement.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 10–15+ years of experience in construction risk advisory, insurance brokerage, or related project risk roles
  • Deep expertise across multiple construction-related insurance lines
  • Experience advising senior client collaborators on complex, large-scale construction and infrastructure projects
  • Strong understanding of construction contracts, risk allocation, and delivery models
  • An active P&C License is required, or you must be willing to obtain one within 90 days of your hire date.

Education: Bachelor's degree or relevant experience considered equivalent.

How we support our colleagues

Alongside our extensive benefits package, we promote a diverse and welcoming workforce. Additionally, our flexible work setting enables you to prioritize your wellbeing and maintain a healthy work/life balance, helping you be your best self at Aon. Moreover, every team member receives two “Global Wellbeing Days” annually, giving you the opportunity to concentrate on your personal needs. We also provide several options for different working styles to support our colleagues.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

The Senior Marketing Automation Engineer – Oracle Eloqua & CRM Integration (Redwood) serves as the technical guide for Oracle Eloqua and its integration with Oracle CRM (Redwood) and other enterprise systems. This role owns Eloqua architecture, data models, integrations, and advanced configuration to ensure a robust, scalable, and well-governed marketing automation stack.

You will partner closely with Marketing Operations, CRM, IT, integration, data, security, and compliance teams to design, implement, and maintain the technical capabilities that power campaigns, customer journeys, data quality, and platform reliability.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Platform architecture, integration, and data ownership

  • Lead the technical architecture of Oracle Eloqua, including instance configuration, environments, integration patterns, data structures, shared assets, naming conventions, and scalable configuration standards.
  • Design and maintain Eloqua data models across contacts, accounts, custom objects, shared lists, shared filters, and related structures to support current and future business needs.
  • Lead the design and implementation of integrations between Eloqua and Oracle CRM (Redwood), including field mapping, sync rules, error handling, batch and near real-time synchronization patterns, and monitoring strategies.
  • Collaborate with integration and IT teams to architect and maintain data flows using APIs, ETL, iPaaS platforms, or other enterprise integration capabilities.

Governance, data quality, and advanced Eloqua configuration

  • Define and implement data quality rules for records entering Eloqua, including standardization, validation, duplication, enrichment, and alignment with CRM and enterprise data models.
  • Configure and maintain consent, subscription management, and preference center capabilities, ensuring accurate reflection across Eloqua and CRM.
  • Build and maintain technical frameworks in Eloqua, including global data processing programs, normalization programs, lead scoring implementation, AppCloud apps, extensions, and reusable technical building blocks.
  • Configure complex Program Canvas or Program Builder flows for data processing, routing, enrichment, and platform-level automation, while enabling non-technical users to implement campaigns within a governed framework.

Platform evolution, documentation, and enablement

  • Lead or support Eloqua and CRM migration, re-implementation, upgrade, and platform enhancement efforts, including data assessment, mapping, transformation, cutover planning, validation, reconciliation, regression testing, and UAT.
  • Monitor and fix integration failures, CRM sync issues, logs, and data anomalies; design alerting and monitoring approaches to proactively detect and resolve issues.
  • Create and maintain user documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, data dictionaries, mapping documents, and configuration plans covering integrations, data flows, processing programs, and system behavior.
  • Serve as a main technical point of contact for Eloqua-related questions from Marketing Operations, CRM administrators, and integration or engineering teams.

How this opportunity is different

This role is an opportunity to shape the technical foundation of a global marketing automation and CRM ecosystem. You will not only support Eloqua configuration; you will influence how the platform is architected, integrated, governed, monitored, documented, and evolved. The work sits at the intersection of marketing technology, CRM, data engineering, integration, security, compliance, and business enablement, giving you broad visibility and significant impact across the organization.

.

  • Demonstrable experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Eloqua-to-CRM integrations, ideally with Oracle CRM or Redwood, including data mapping, synchronization, fix, monitoring, and governance.

Preferred experience

Job Description

Production Underwriting Professional

Commercial Property Catastrophe (Flood & Wind)

This is a remote position in the US

The Production Underwriting Professional is responsible for driving profitable growth and delivering specialized underwriting expertise for commercial property catastrophe exposures, with a primary focus on flood and wind coverages. This role evaluates, prices, and underwrites complex commercial property risks aligned with delegated underwriting authority while developing strong relationships with retail brokers, agents, and clients.

The ideal candidate combines technical underwriting expertise, strong sales and business development skills, and a disciplined approach to portfolio management. The position requires balancing new business production goals with underwriting profitability standards, ensuring that risks are appropriately structured, priced, and managed within established underwriting guidelines.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Production & Business Development

  • Manage and triage new business submissions to grow a profitable portfolio of commercial property catastrophe business. Including the prioritization of multiple submissions, outstanding quotes, additional information needed, and requests.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with insurance brokers, agents, and carrier partners.
  • Understand product features, underlying coverages, and authority limits to identify new business opportunities and expand existing client relationships.
  • Meet or exceed production, retention, and revenue objectives.

Underwriting & Risk Analysis

  • Understand multiple P&C coverage lines such as: Primary Flood, Excess Flood, Commercial Flood, NFIP guidelines, Deductible Buyback, and RCBAP
  • Analyze commercial property submissions with emphasis on flood and wind exposures. Including the evaluation of insurance applications and related documents, including Elevation Certificates, loss data, Flood Risk Scores/Surge Reports, statement of values and other information needed to accurately evaluate and classify the degree of risk in relation to proposed coverage limits.
  • Evaluate catastrophe modeling outputs, loss histories, construction characteristics, occupancy, protection, and exposure data to prepare insurance quotes and proposals.
  • Assess coastal, inland flood, named storm, hurricane, and severe convective storm risks to provide recommendations for referrals to markets.
  • Structure coverage solutions and recommend appropriate limits, deductibles, and terms in accordance with delegated authority.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accurate documentation and underwriting files.
  • Utilize underwriting systems, catastrophe modeling platforms, and CRM tools effectively. Including the Microsoft suite of tools, AI platforms, Salesforce, Adobe Acrobat.
  • Ensure compliance with underwriting authority, regulatory requirements, and company standards.
  • Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and service delivery.
  • Candidate should be organized, able to prioritize work and possess effective time management skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work well with team members and co-workers in a virtual setting, participate in and support an underwriting team environment, advance your knowledge with formal educational courses, and interact with management.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Experience underwriting commercial property insurance risks.
  • Knowledge of catastrophe coverages, including flood and wind exposures.
  • Strong analytical, sales, and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to evaluate complex risk information and make sound underwriting decisions.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.

Preferred

  • Experience with CAT modeling tools and exposure management platforms.
  • Knowledge of coastal property risks, NFIP programs, excess flood markets, and wind underwriting practices.
  • Experience working with large schedule commercial property accounts.
  • P&C license preferred

Success Measures

  • New business premium growth
  • Renewal retention rate
  • Quote-to-bind conversion ratio
  • Portfolio profitability
  • Broker relationship development
  • Service level adherence
  • Quality and accuracy of underwriting decisions

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Summary:

Provide support to broking team members and contributes to strategic recommendations, problem solving, and solution development for prospects and clients. Develops a comprehensive understanding of prospect and client risk profiles and exposures, and acts to cultivate and increase insurance market interest leading to the development of effective risk financing and risk transfer solutions. Focuses on tailoring required coverage, terms and conditions, and developing the appropriate program.

This is a full-time opportunity with standard hours, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET. To support hybrid or remote work, candidates must maintain a reliable, confidential, and interruption-free workspace and have a stable high-speed internet connection.

In addition to the base salary, this role is eligible for 25% commission on first year new business.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Participate in the analysis of clients' or prospects' existing programs and ensure requirements. Review current policies and formulate recommendations for customized risk solutions
  • Negotiate with insurance carriers; drives financial and non-financial outcomes that support organic revenue development and retention. Seize upon opportunities to upsell and cross-sell, leading to greater client product density and expanded account margin
  • Ensure placements are handled according to NFP's service model standards and timelines
  • Support the team in developing client/prospect diagnostics – working at the direction of the Broker or Senior Broker to complete a total program assessment, including total cost of risk, service results, and opportunities fo program improvement
  • Assist in timely production of required documentation and follow-up, ensuring timely flow of materials
  • Assist team members with proposal development for existing and prospective clients
  • Respond to client queries and concerns to resolve issues promptly
  • Attend client meetings with team; leading to refined and enhanced client communication and presentation skills
  • Present to local account executives, participate in RFPs, occasional client meetings and conference calls
  • Support the deployment of data and analytics to provide program insights for clients and the broking team
  • Develop productive business relationships with key insurance underwriters and local NFP account teams
  • Cultivate a thorough understanding of markets to better assist the broking team
  • Execute on NFP's broking strategies, including strategic carriers, panels, and preferred wholesaler utilization
  • Develop and maintain a thorough knowledge of the insurance marketplace, and the various lines, products and services offered by various insurers
  • Ensure client, broking and brokerage data files are maintained in a complete, organized and timely fashion

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to successfully interact with a variety of people
  • Proven negotiation skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Attention to detail, demonstrating reliability and accuracy
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to adjust to changing priorities
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • Experience with Epic (agency management system) a plus

Education and/or Experience:

  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred

Certificates, Licenses, Registration:

  • P&C License preferred

What We Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $43,000 – $50,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Job.JobTitle: Vertical Sales Executive - Higher Education (Building Automation)
Job.JobDescription:
Position Location: This role is a US based remote position.


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn't just about improving buildings; it's about creating perfect places that improve people's lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


As the Vertical Sales Executive - Higher Education (Building Automation), you will identify, develop, and win large-scale capital projects valued at $3M+ across colleges and universities. This is a strategic, quota-carrying hunting role focused on creating opportunities before they reach procurement, building executive-level relationships, and leading complex pursuits involving building automation, digitalization, energy infrastructure, and smart campus modernization.

Successful candidates are energized by proactive prospecting, uncovering customer needs, influencing decision makers, shaping projects before RFP release, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to secure transformational projects. Higher Education experience is valued, but demonstrated success hunting and closing complex technical opportunities is the primary requirement.


As the Vertical Sales Executive – Higher Education (Building Automation), you will:

  • Identify, qualify, and pursue new capital-project opportunities valued at $3M+ across an assigned national or regional portfolio of Higher Education accounts.
  • Build a robust, self-generated pipeline through targeted prospecting, market intelligence, industry networks, construction and capital-plan signals, partner relationships, and direct executive outreach.
  • Create and advance opportunities before formal procurement or RFP release by shaping customer priorities, influencing solution strategy, and positioning Siemens as the preferred partner.
  • Lead complex pursuits from initial identification through qualification, solution development, executive alignment, commercial strategy, proposal, negotiation, and project award.
  • Develop executive relationships with university leaders across Facilities, Finance, Operations, Sustainability, Procurement, Research, and the C-suite.
  • Build compelling business cases that connect automation, digitalization, energy performance, resilience, deferred maintenance, and lifecycle outcomes to institutional priorities.
  • Orchestrate Siemens Area teams, operations leaders, technical specialists, Digital and Automation resources, partners, and executive sponsors around a clear win strategy.
  • Position Siemens building automation, Building X, digital services, energy optimization, infrastructure modernization, and related smart-campus capabilities as an integrated customer solution.
  • Own account and pursuit strategies while collaborating effectively within Siemens' matrixed sales model and respecting local customer relationships and execution responsibilities.
  • Maintain disciplined pipeline, forecast, probability, next-step, and customer-engagement data in Siemens sales systems.
  • Use AI-enabled tools and data sources to accelerate account research, stakeholder mapping, outreach preparation, opportunity qualification, and pursuit planning.
  • Represent Siemens at targeted customer meetings, conferences, industry associations, and partner events.
  • Collaborate with delivery and operations teams to ensure commitments made during the sales process are executable, profitable, and aligned with customer expectations.

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in building automation, controls, energy services, infrastructure modernization, performance contracting, digital buildings, or similarly complex technical solutions
  • Demonstrated success originating, developing, and closing large capital or enterprise opportunities valued at $3M+
  • Proven history of new-logo acquisition, proactive pipeline generation, and advancing opportunities without relying primarily on inbound demand or inherited accounts
  • Experience leading long-cycle, multi-stakeholder pursuits involving executive decision makers, engineering, operations, finance, procurement, and external partners
  • Ability to establish credibility with both technical and executive audiences and translate complex capabilities into measurable business outcomes
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including value-based selling, business-case development, forecasting, negotiation, and margin discipline
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional pursuit teams and influencing contributors without direct authority
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% based on customer, pursuit, conference, and team needs
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Current or prior Siemens sales experience, including working knowledge of Siemens Building Automation, Digital Buildings, Building X, energy, or related Smart Infrastructure offerings
  • Experience selling directly to colleges, universities, healthcare systems, government agencies, or similarly complex institutional customers
  • Experience with performance contracting, capital planning, deferred maintenance, central utility or energy infrastructure, modernization programs, or multi-building portfolios
  • Familiarity with consultant, architect, engineer, general contractor, mechanical contractor, electrical contractor, and partner-influence channels
  • Understanding of Higher Education capital approval, funding, procurement, governance, and consensus-driven decision making
  • Experience with Siemens sales and project governance processes, including SieSales and relevant milestones
  • Knowledge of digital building platforms, analytics, AI-enabled building services, energy optimization, and recurring digital-service models

Job.JobTitle: Flex Force Building Automation Systems Specialist
Job.JobDescription:
Position Location: This role serves customers throughout the greater Southeast area (travel could be throughout the country). Must be located within a commutable distance to a Siemens office location: Norcross, GA, Jacksonville, FL, Miramar, FL, Tampa, FL, Orlando, FL, Raleigh, NC, Charlotte, NC or Richmond, VA.


Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn't just about improving buildings; it's about creating perfect places that improve people's lives.

Transform the everyday with us!


The Building Automation Systems Specialist handles the centralized control of a building's heating, ventilation, air conditioning, lighting, and other systems through a building management system or building automation system (BAS).The objectives of building automation are improved occupant comfort, efficient operation of building systems, reduction in energy consumption and operating costs, and improved life cycle of utilities.


As a Building Automation Systems Specialist, you will:

  • Assist with building automation system startup, ensuring that all systems and components are designed, installed, tested, operated, and maintained according to the operational requirements of the customer.
  • Work well with others, take ownership, be a team player, and act with integrity. This position reports to the local Supervisor and takes direction from a mentor and Lead Technician.
  • Assist with commissioning new Distributed Digital Control System on construction sites. Commissioning is ensuring all systems and components are functioning as required.
  • Document commissioning details; communicate deficiencies and progress.
  • Plan work with mentor, Lead Technician, and Team Leader.
  • Complete commissioning within planned timelines.
  • Submit accurate time-keeping daily and expenses weekly.
  • Work overtime when needed.
  • Able to accommodate in an out of state overnight travel of up to 85%

You will make in impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Electro-mechanical experience (wither from a previous role or through education) and user PC/software skills
  • 1+ year of experience with Building Automation systems or related job skill/industry experience
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability to read and understand design and construction documents
  • Must be willing and able to work in a variety of circumstances, including climbing ladders, scaffolds, and high lift equipment, working in ducts, crawl spaces, roofs, basements, above ceilings, and in outside/inside/heat/cold/day/night conditions
  • Must be able to demonstrate the ability and willingness to differentiate types/colors of wire, use hand tools, laptop, email, smartphone, and tablet and the ability to carry and move equipment and tools weighing up to 75 pounds unassisted
  • Must be willing and able to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
  • Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)
  • Verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship
  • Must be willing to travel 85% of the time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED; Associate degree in electronics or related field

Machine Builder General, Business Developer Zone Americas

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for Machine Builder General, Business Developer Zone Americas. This position is preferred in Alpharetta GA, or Chicago IL and would have hybrid capabilities. Any candidates located outside of these metropolitan areas would be required to travel to Alpharetta, GA, consistently.

You'll make an impact by:

  1. Market/customer engagement, opportunity mgmt. & deal support
    • Representing Digital Industries Automation to key regional market stakeholders in Zone Americas, e.g. at trade fairs, conferences and associations, in social media as Technology and Thought Leader Ambassadors
    • Actively driving new technologies and DI AUT offerings into Sales organizations e.g. to Sales Acceleration and/or OEM Sales channels
    • Supporting Zone Americas LCB Sales organization with OEM and Machine Builder industry expertise in the bid process for major new projects
    • Analyzing market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscapes to identify new business opportunities and areas for portfolio growth/ expansion and align closely with Account Manager and Technical Sales
    • Providing (top- and bottom-line) input for new feature business case and analyzing business performance and deriving impactful actions and segment-specific initiatives
    • Owning the business- & masterplan for dedicated industry assignment – focus on our OEM and machine builders' business out of discrete, process & infrastructure markets!
    • Providing customers with end-to-end solutions ranging from automation and drive technology to digitalization offerings, and actively drive the introduction of new DI AUT products & innovations
    • Contribution to the definition and implementation of a segment-specific marketing and use-case strategy
  1. Sales Enablement
    • Empowering sales teams by providing key tech. insights and sales narratives and having the domain technology expertise of the specific segment – focus on our OEM and Machine Builder market
    • Defining the business and sales strategy for the specific segment and passionately driving its execution in close collaboration with our LCB sales organizations
    • Supporting LCB sales representatives to optimally develop key customers within the industry segments esp. for our OEM and Machine Builder market
    • Orchestrating activities and strategies of international customers in close collaboration with the LCB Sales Acceleration & Channels
  1. Portfolio Expertise
    • Providing technical expertise on portfolio selection and fit, supporting both internal sales teams and external customers
    • Maintaining a strong overview of the international market and competitive landscape. Identifying and interpreting trends as well as market and business developments in the specific industry
  1. Post-Sales support & customer success
    • Ensuring a seamless handover to delivery teams, ensuring smooth service execution and solution delivery e.g., facilitate customer onboarding, adoption, and satisfaction to drive long-term customer retention and growth
  1. Customer & market feedback
    • Providing feedback to portfolio development teams based on market requirements and customer insights and translating those to global PLM- & application development teams
    • Advocating for technology and service adoption at executive levels, supporting long-term business transformation initiatives
    • Rolling-out focus initiatives

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline
  • 8+ years of related experience in sales management & Industry automation (Automation & Drive Systems)
  • Knowledge of SIEMENS DI AUT automation & drives products or competitors corresponding products for the discrete OEM industries
  • Solid technical background and hands-on engineering experience in DI AUT automation & drives portfolio
  • Strong customer relationship and business development capabilities.
  • Strong technical and commercial acumen
  • Customer-focused mindset
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong collaboration and teamwork skills
  • Strategic business development capabilities
  • Ability to influence technical and commercial decision-makers
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Results-oriented with a high sense of urgency
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3 years sales management experience, and at least 5 years working experience in Industry automation, especially in Automation & Drive Systems
  • Good communication skills internally and externally
  • Ability for structured & analytic approach to analyze status, propose measures, implement and follow-up.
  • Teamwork spirit.

Job.JobDescription:
Siemens Digital Industries Software

Strategic Student Program (SSP)

Discover your career with us at Siemens Digital Industries Software!

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

We're currently recruiting co-ops and interns for our Spring 2027 Strategic Student Program. Our opportunities will allow you to find a career path that most inspires you. Here, you will apply your education to solve real-world problems and turn theory into practice. At Siemens, our goal is to empower our students to become the next leaders of our company.

Baseline Program Requirements:

  • Currently enrolled as an undergraduate student at an accredited university
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship by the company
  • A minimum 3.0 GPA


Perks:

  • Employee discounts at our top customer sites
  • Networking with our global leaders
  • Mentorship from senior employees
  • Individual career development planning
  • Professional and technical workshops
  • Paid volunteer time off
  • Energetic student community
  • Leadership opportunities
  • Potential for full-time offers after university graduation and completion of the program


Position Overview:


Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Digital Thread & Systems Engineering Intern to support the Capital PreSales organization. This role offers an opportunity to work on innovative digital engineering initiatives spanning aerospace, defense, automotive, and software-defined product development.

The intern will assist in the development of engineering datasets, digital thread demonstrations, and proof-of-concept solutions that connect systems engineering, software development, electrical design, and lifecycle management processes. Working alongside experienced mentors, the intern will contribute to customer-facing demonstrations and internal innovation projects focused on digital transformation and model-based engineering.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop aerospace and automotive engineering datasets used for demonstrations and technical enablement.
  • Support Digital Thread initiatives connecting requirements, systems, software, electrical, and lifecycle information.
  • Assist in building and validating proof-of-concept solutions using Siemens Capital and the Siemens Xcelerator portfolio.
  • Contribute to systems engineering and model-based systems engineering (MBSE) workflows.
  • Create technical documentation, presentations, and demonstration assets.
  • Participate in technical reviews, innovation projects, and customer-focused engineering initiatives.


Requirements:


  • Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment within the United States of America.
  • Interest in digital engineering, systems thinking, and software-defined products.
  • Experience with Python, scripting, or data analysis is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

The SEWP VI Administrator will report directly to SGT Contracts leadership. This individual is responsible for the day to day administration, governance, and operational execution of Siemens Government Technologies' NASA SEWP VI contract.


The role manages SEWP workflows, maintains contract documentation, ensures compliance with NASA SEWP policies and Federal Acquisition Regulations, and serves as the primary operational interface with Siemens Industry, federal customers, and the NASA SEWP Program Office.


The successful candidate will be highly organized, detail oriented, self directed, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast paced federal contracting environment.


Responsibilities:

•Maintain SEWP VI contract files, catalogs, pricing tables, product lists, and required documentation.

•Perform SEWP contract administration, including review of incoming RFQs, timely submission of deliverables, and execution of task order workflows in accordance with corporate policies and SEWP requirements.

•Monitor SEWP portals for RFQs, catalog updates, vehicle modifications, and program office announcements.

•Serve as SGT's internal owner of SEWP VI operational activities.

•Coordinate quote development with Siemens Industry product owners, proposal teams, and distributors.

•Request and validate vendor/manufacturer special pricing as needed; maintain complete audit ready justification files.

•Verify product availability, lead times, configurations, CLIN/SKU accuracy, and compliance before submission.

•Review pricing and margins for compliance with SGT and Siemens governance requirements.

•Track, assemble, validate, and submit complete proposal packages within SEWP timelines.

•Stay current on SEWP policies, ordering procedures, rule interpretations, and vehicle changes.

•Support Federal Account Executives and Business Development teams by providing SEWP insights, identifying opportunities, and coordinating customer engagement activities.

•Collaborate with federal contracting offices and the NASA SEWP Program Office on operational issues, system troubleshooting, and policy clarifications.

•Coordinate technical or engineering resources from Siemens when required for complex configurations.

•Prepare and present reports, dashboards, and analytics on order volume, win rates, pricing approvals, turnaround time, and revenue realization.

•Conduct periodic internal audits of SEWP VI processes and catalog accuracy.

•Communicate effectively with internal and external program team members and direct supervisors.


Requirements:

•Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of equivalent experience.

•Five years of experience in Federal Government contract administration, preferably within GWACs or NASA SEWP.

•Strong analytical, organizational, and time management abilities.

•Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

•Polished written and oral communication skills, including ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and federal customers.

•Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple concurrent tasks in a dynamic contracting environment.

•Skilled in standard office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, PowerPoint) and ability to adapt quickly to new tools, including SEWP QRT, catalog systems, and pricing portals.

•Ability to coordinate activities across cross functional Siemens and SGT teams.


Travel:

•No more than 10% travel annually within DC area


Security Clearance:

•Candidate must be a United States Citizen with no dual citizenship and have the ability to obtain and/or maintain a U.S. Federal Secret Security Clearance.

About Siemens Digital Industries Software

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

Position Overview

As a Principal Infrastructure Architect, you'll play a pivotal role in translating business requirements into tailored infrastructure builds that leverage Siemens Digital Industries Software standard methodologies. You'll lead enterprise-scale solution deliveries, assess customer environments, and develop resilient, scalable infrastructures while ensuring compatibility with existing systems. You'll maintain critical customer relationships, establish architectural standards, conduct meticulous reviews, and uphold compliance and industry standards, driving continuous improvement and innovation that improve performance and scalability across our customer base.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Design Leadership

  • Own the design and delivery of enterprise-scale infrastructure architectures across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with long-term business objectives
  • Translate business, program, and technical requirements into end-to-end infrastructure architectures that follow industry guidelines, organizational standards, and customer IT strategies
  • Serve as the senior technical authority for infrastructure architecture, providing expert mentorship on system sizing, performance, availability, security, networking, operating systems, and database platforms
  • Ensure all solutions follow security, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements while upholding professional standards and organizational values

Multi-functional Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Delivery, and Product teams to support pursuits, influence solution roadmaps, and guide customers through architectural options and trade-offs
  • Engage with customers to understand technical and business requirements, translating them into practical, value-driven infrastructure solutions
  • Maintain customer relationships and handle project documentation standards to ensure clarity and alignment across all project phases

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and coaching to other infrastructure architects and consultants, elevating architectural maturity and guidelines across the organization
  • Conduct architectural reviews to ensure quality, compliance, and alignment to standards
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and innovative practices that improve organizational capabilities

Qualifications

Required

  • Extensive experience as an Infrastructure Architect or Consultant delivering enterprise-scale solutions across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) and hybrid infrastructure designs
  • Deep knowledge and practical experience with performance tuning for enterprise infrastructure components, including compute, storage, networking, security, high availability, and disaster recovery
  • Proven experience with Windows and Linux operating systems and enterprise database platforms such as Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server
  • Proven customer-facing consulting skills, including partner engagement, expectation management, and technical communication with both technical and executive audiences
  • Experience with enterprise-grade software platforms in Product Lifecycle Management or Manufacturing Operations Management domains
  • Ability to work independently under self-management, providing leadership within project and program constraints

Qualified Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States. Qualified Applicants will not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

Preferred

  • Experience serving as Lead Infrastructure Architect on strategic, large-scale, or global consulting programs
  • Experience driving automation, standardization, and reusable architecture patterns through scripting, templates, or reference architecture
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring other architects or consultants and contributing to communities of practice or knowledge sharing initiatives
  • Experience with Siemens Digital Industries Software Teamcenter or Opcenter platforms
  • Familiarity with containerization and modern deployment approaches (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) in enterprise or cloud environments
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, Security, or Infrastructure-related certifications)
  • Exposure to highly regulated environments (ITAR, NIST, GDPR, FDA)
  • Travel: 25%

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Compensation & Benefits

The total cash compensation range for this position is $146,700 to $293,400 with 10% of this being comprised of an annual incentive target (100% achievement). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training.

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

Work Environment

This role is primarily remote with the option for hybrid work at a Siemens DISW office hub. Some travel (up to 25%) may be required for customer engagements. Qualified applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States.

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.


Position Overview:

Siemens DISW's Engineering Grid Computing Services team strategically supports over 3000 engineers located in R&D centers worldwide. The Engineering Grid Computing Service (EGCS) within GTI operates 18+ globally distributed high-performance computing grids across 7+ sites, currently provisioning 263,000+ CPU cores across four scheduler platforms (Altair Grid Engine, Altair Accelerator, IBM LSF, and SLURM). This infrastructure processes up to 12 million jobs per day at peak and serves approximately 3,000 engineers — it is the compute backbone that chip design, verification, and validation depend on. We are seeking a Grid Operations Architect to own the architectural vision and technical strategy for the next generation of this computing fabric. The immediate mandate: scale consolidated grid capacity from a quarter million cores to almost one million cores over the next five-six years while simultaneously transforming and modernizing the entire environment— the migration from Altair Grid Engine to Accelerator Plus, a hierarchical scheduler purpose-built for the throughput demands of EDA workloads This is a senior technical leadership role that bridges grid operations, infrastructure engineering, and strategic planning. Today, a lean team of 3 core grid administrators and 4 regional service delivery partners operate this global service — the Architect role is the structural investment that accelerates transformation and reduces key-person risk. You will define how Siemens DISW's compute infrastructure is designed, deployed, and operated on a world-class scale. The key purposes of this role are based on the following:

  • As EDA workloads grow and push the limits of what performance can be achieved with existing designs, a next generation architecture is the answer to meet the growing computing demands.
  • The Accelerator migration is the architectural response — and it needs a dedicated owner.
  • Key Technical/Strategic leadership need has been identified, providing depth and resilience to team
  • The path to 24x5 follow-the-sun coverage, >50% toil reduction through automation, and full-service excellence depends on an architectural foundation that today's operational team does not have the bandwidth to design.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the multiyear architectural roadmap for scaling grid compute capacity from 263K+ cores to 1M+ cores across 18+ globally distributed grids, consolidating across sites while maintaining availability and performance.
  • Design the phased migration plan from AGE to Accelerator's hierarchical scheduling platform
  • Design next generation grid topologies, scheduling frameworks, and resource management strategies that optimize utilization, throughput, and cost efficiency at a million core scale. One of the largest grids alone handles 60K+ cores and 2M+ jobs/dayarchitectures must perform at this density.
  • Develop consolidation strategies to reduce operational complexity rationalizing 4 scheduler platforms toward a unified Accelerator based model, standardizing tooling, and harmonizing operational policies across regions.
  • Lead capacity planning and forecasting models that project compute demand growth using linear, exponential, and flat percentage projections. Translate business requirements into infrastructure investment plans aligned with the 80% utilization ceiling and 72% procurement trigger governance model.
  • Architect hybrid and cloud burst strategies (e.g., NavOps ) to augment on premises capacity for peak demand and elastic workloads working with A&S and Networking teams while respecting the latency and data locality requirements of EDA workloads
  • Design fault - tolerant, self healing grid architectures that minimize downtime and reduce manual intervention critical for enabling 24x5 follow the sun coverage without proportional headcount growth.
  • Establish architectural standards, reference designs, and best practices for grid deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management across all 18+ grids and 9+ clusters.
  • Design and drive the evolution of the grid automation and tooling ecosystem — modernizing legacy Perl/Shell-based operational tools toward scalable, maintainable platforms (Python, APIs, infrastructure-as-code, GitLab CI/CD). Target: >50% reduction in manual operational toil across 8 identified operational areas.
  • Architect the observability and analytics stack (Elastic Stack with geo-redundant instances across Americas and Asia, Grafana, Power BI) to provide real-time visibility into grid performance, availability, utilization, and capacity across all grids.
  • Design AI-assisted alerting and auto-classification capabilities leveraging Elastic AI Agent and ServiceNow API integration to move from reactive monitoring to predictive operations.
  • Evolve SLA frameworks and operational KPIs from current state to improve reporting, performance: 99.97% availability per quarter, >97% SLO compliance, 30-minute MTTR, job wait time tracking at P50 and P95.
  • Lead proof-of-concept and pilot initiatives for emerging technologies (containerised workloads, GPU/accelerator scheduling, next-gen schedulers) and evaluate their applicability to Siemens EDA workloads.
  • Partner with engineering leadership, R&D teams, and business stakeholders to understand compute demand trends, workload characteristics, and evolving requirements.
  • Collaborate with A&S team, Infrastructure Technology Verticals — networking, storage, virtualization, and data center operations — to ensure end-to-end infrastructure coherence and performance.
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison with grid software vendors (Altair/Siemens, IBM, SchedMD) for roadmap alignment, escalation management, and strategic feature requests. Leverage Siemens' internal ownership of Altair for strategic advantage.
  • Present architectural proposals, trade-off analyses, and investment recommendations to senior IT leadership and executive stakeholders. Connect every infrastructure investment to a business outcome.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to grid administrators and operations engineers, elevating the team's architectural thinking and engineering practices. Drive cross-training from 2 to 3+ schedulers per person.
  • Establish and maintain grid operations governance — change management (moving toward Git-based infrastructure-as-code), configuration standards, security policies, and compliance frameworks for large-scale compute environments.
  • Drive continuous improvement through data-driven analysis of incidents, performance trends, and utilization patterns using Elastic dashboards and capacity modelling tools (Griddash).
  • Design self-service onboarding and provisioning workflows (ServiceNow catalogue items) to reduce manual provisioning overhead and improve time-to-compute for engineering teams.
  • Ensure software license compliance across all grid engines and associated tooling — particularly critical during the scheduler consolidation from 3 license agreements to 1.
  • Contribute to disaster recovery and business continuity planning for grid services.
  • Participate in daily operations standups, weekly staff meetings, and bi-weekly cadences with key customer teams. Provide architectural input on operational issues and escalations.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in systems engineering, infrastructure architecture, or HPC/grid computing environments, with at least 5 years in an architecture or technical leadership role.
  • Deep expertise with distributed computing platforms — hands-on experience architecting and operating at least two of: Altair Grid Engine, Altair Accelerator, IBM LSF, SLURM, or equivalent workload schedulers.
  • Demonstrated experience scaling compute infrastructure in large, multi-site, enterprise-wide environments (100K+ cores). Experience with scheduler migrations or platform consolidation at production scale.
  • Strong systems-level knowledge of Linux (RHEL/CentOS), including kernel tuning, performance optimization, and large-scale fleet management.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure automation and tooling — Python, Perl, Shell scripting — with experience in modern approaches (Ansible, Terraform, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines).
  • Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, NFS/GPFS, InfiniBand), storage architectures, and virtualisation as they relate to HPC and grid computing.
  • Experience in cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) and hybrid cloud/cloud-burst architectures for HPC workloads (e.g., NavOps, Cycle Cloud).
  • Proven ability to develop and communicate multi-year technical roadmaps and translate business requirements into architectural decisions with clear investment justification.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills with experience presenting to senior leadership and executive audiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification in one or more of cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI)
  • Knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, Singularity) and their application in HPC environments.
  • Experience with observability and analytics platforms (Elastic Stack, Grafana, Prometheus,
  • Power BI) at scale — particularly geo-distributed deployments.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML operations and GPU/accelerator scheduling for heterogeneous computing architectures.
  • Experience with database systems (MySQL, MSSQL, PostgreSQL) for operational data management and reporting.
  • Understanding ITIL 4 processes — incident management, problem management, change control— in large-scale infrastructure operations.
  • Experience supporting EDA (Electronic Design Automation) workloads — simulation, regression,
  • DRC/LVS, benchmarking, and tape-out compute patterns.
  • Background in capacity planning, financial modelling for infrastructure investments, and TCO analysis.

This is not a traditional grid administration role. The Grid Operations Architect will shape the strategic direction of one of the largest compute fabrics in the industry — an infrastructure that processes up to 12 million jobs per day and directly enables the design and verification of next-generation

semiconductors. You will lead the most significant technology transformation in the service's history (the Accelerator migration), architect a 4x capacity scale-up across a globally distributed footprint and design the automation and observability foundations that make million-core operations sustainable.

If you thrive on solving complex scaling challenges, influencing technology strategy at the intersection of HPC and enterprise IT, and building infrastructure that operates at world-class scale — this role offers an exceptional opportunity to leave a lasting mark on Siemens' engineering capability.
