Job.JobTitle: Enterprise Software Sales Leader (Dept of Defense & DoW)
Job.JobDescription:
About Siemens Digital Industries Software

We are a leading global software company dedicated to computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company and the energy of a software start-up, we create a world-class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth.

Position Overview

Lead our Federal Aerospace & Defense sales team covering the U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army, and Department of Energy. You'll nurture executive customer relationships and develop multi-year sales strategies to drive adoption of our Xcelerator portfolio and core products—Teamcenter, NX, and related solutions. Managing five Client Sales Executives, you'll build a high-performing team focused on delivering innovative PLM solutions to federal customers and supporting the war-fighter mission. The Federal group generates significant revenue, and you'll play a critical role in expanding this presence across the Department of War and its supply base. You'll work collaboratively with Sales Managers covering Aerospace & Defense original equipment manufacturers to ensure coordinated strategy and seamless customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Relationship & Strategic Leadership

  • Build and maintain high-quality relationships with senior and executive leadership across federal agencies, including U.S. Air Force, U.S. Army, and Department of Energy
  • Lead the development and execution of long-term comprehensive strategies for customer retention and growth, ensuring continuous focus across cross-functional sales teams on identifying and executing new business opportunities
  • Nurture executive customer relationships and collaborate with sales and technical leadership to develop and implement high-impact multi-year sales strategies
  • Lead quarterly business reviews and strategic account planning with key federal customers
  • Navigate complex, sophisticated federal sales cycles and coordinate across federal contracting vehicles and procurement processes
  • Understand customer strategy, PLM solution strategy, and their alignment to drive value-based selling

Team Development & Sales Execution

  • Develop, motivate, and coach a high-performing team of five Client Sales Executives to progress and close business using standard sales methodologies
  • Supervise the development and implementation of in-depth account strategy plans aligned with federal customer requirements and strategic objectives
  • Provide mentorship and coaching to team members on complex deal negotiations and customer relationship management
  • Drive identification and execution of new business opportunities within the federal sector, ensuring quota achievement across the team
  • Foster a team culture that emphasizes high ownership, customer-first focus, fast-paced execution, high integrity, and an optimistic environment

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Growth

  • Work effectively in a matrixed environment with internal teams and external partners across the Aerospace & Defense organization
  • Collaborate with sales managers covering Aerospace & Defense original equipment manufacturers to ensure coordinated strategy and avoid conflicts
  • Build strong relationships and partnerships both internally and externally; quickly establish trust with senior leaders and empower cross-functional teams to develop solutions
  • Ensure alignment between company objectives and customer needs, balancing growth with customer success and optimizing results at the company level
  • Address competing priorities and solve complex problems in a timely manner
  • Support partner sales representatives in understanding federal customer needs and provide training on new initiatives, including perpetual-to-SaaS migration transactions

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years' experience selling large strategic enterprise software solutions to the Department of War, with ability to navigate complex federal sales cycles. This software sales experience is a non-negotiable.
  • At least 2+ years of managing a sales team, directly or indirectly
  • At least 3-5+ years experience selling into the US Military sector.
  • Consistent track record of planning, negotiating, and closing deals with highly complex accounts

  • At least 3+ years' experience in large enterprise software, selling at the C-suite (CXO) level

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We are seeking a Lead Project Engineer - Solutions for a high-visibility role combining technical expertise, customer engagement, and end-to-end solution ownership across the GTD value chain. You will serve as a technical authority spanning offers engineering, orders engineering, and project execution — a role intentionally developed for engineers who want to move beyond narrow, product-only positions.

The Utility Systems & Solutions business within Siemens Electrification & Automation (EA) enables a more reliable, resilient, and sustainable electric grid across the full generation, transmission, and distribution (GTD) value chain. We partner with electric utilities and EPC organizations to deliver integrated, turnkey electrical systems that support grid modernization, capacity expansion, and the energy transition. We combine deep power-system expertise, digital-ready platforms, and proven EPC execution to reduce project risk, shorten deployment timelines, and help customers future-proof their grids. Our portfolio includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (AIS & GIS), outdoor circuit breakers, MV protection, control and automation systems, power equipment centers, overhead and underground distribution solutions, low-voltage motor control centers, photovoltaic (PV) inverters, and complementary MV/LV technologies. These solutions deploy across Generation — conventional power plants, renewable energy facilities, and energy storage systems, Transmission & sub-transmission — substations, switching stations, and grid interconnections, and Distribution — feeder expansion, grid hardening, resilience initiatives, and customer electrification.

Our national headquarters is in Wendell, North Carolina— in the heart of the Research Triangle, about 20 minutes east of Raleigh. Enjoy top-rated schools, a mild four-season climate, easy access to mountains and coast, and a cost of living that lets your compensation go further than most major metros — without trade-offs.

This Senior Lead Project Engineer - Utility Systems / Medium Voltage Solutions Engineer position is based in Wendell, NC. 100% Remote work will be considered for highly qualified candidates, following initial training/onboarding in NC. Local candidates are encouraged to apply. Relocation assistance is available if eligible.

Why This Role Is Different

This is not a static engineering position. It is a career pathway. You'll gain broad, hands-on exposure across power generation, distribution, and transmission, end-to-end ownership with real customer impact, a clear path to expand into offers engineering, business development, and project leadership, and the opportunity to become a utility systems expert with unmatched technical and market versatility. If you're searching for a role where your expertise, influence, and value grow year after year, this is the opportunity.

You'll make a difference with:

Technical Authority & Solution Ownership

Own the full technical outcome of MV substation and utility system projects from feasibility and quotation through handover — including risk, quality, scope, and compliance. Review and approve one-line diagrams, AC/DC schematics, and protection/ control/ communication/ automation philosophies. Translate sophisticated utility and EPC requirements into practical, standards-compliant, commercially sound solutions.

Customer-Facing & Commercial Partnership

Be a trusted technical advisor to customers, utilities, EPC partners, and internal collaborators. You will partner with sales, commercial, and business development teams to shape solution strategies, support negotiations, and influence order decisions. Bridge technical execution with commercial responsibilities to deliver a seamless customer experience with minimal handoffs.

Multi-functional & System Integration Leadership

Lead engineering execution including design coordination, customer approvals, manufacturing support, FAT, installation support, and commissioning. Drive system-level integration across Siemens and third-party technologies, including MV/LV AIS & GIS switchgear, Motor Control Centers (MCCs) and drives, protection, control, and automation (PLCs, SCADA), transformers, E-Houses, batteries, relay and control panels.

Mentorship & Continuous Improvement

Mentor engineers, designers, and drafters to raise technical capability across the team. Influence technical standards, best procedures, and solution architectures as a recognized SME. Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance engineering quality, scalability, and efficiency. Optionally take on expanded project management responsibilities covering schedule, cost, and execution.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Eight (8) or more years designing and delivering electrical power distribution, substation, or utility systems.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Medium Voltage protection and control technologies (SCADA, IEC 61850, DNP3).
  • Proven track record evaluating customer specifications and delivering optimized system solutions.
  • Proficiency reviewing electrical schematics and identifying risks, gaps, and improvements.
  • Experience managing Bills of Material in an ERP environment (SAP preferred).
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and elevating team performance.
  • Ability to handle contending priorities while maintaining technical precision.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced proficiency with Engineering Base (strongly preferred) or AutoCAD Electrical.
  • Background in MV switchgear.
  • Experience with E-House solutions, third-party integration, factory testing, and site commissioning.
  • Solid understanding of ANSI, IEEE, UL, and NEMA standards.
  • Master's degree in Engineering (Power Systems preferred).
  • Experience using Salesforce or other CRM in a technical sales or solution support environment.

Senior Customer Partner-Transformation & Growth -Power & Utilities

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

Our customers are navigating some of the most complex transformation challenges of the decade.

In Power & Utilities and Energy, customers are modernizing aging grid infrastructure, integrating renewables at scale, improving reliability and resiliency, and building the digital backbone for the next generation of energy delivery. At the same time, rapid growth in data centers and AI-driven compute demand is creating major new load requirements, putting pressure on utility planning, interconnection timelines, transmission capacity, substations, transformers, and resource adequacy. Utilities are balancing regulatory pressure, affordability concerns, cybersecurity risk, and the need to move from legacy systems to more connected, data-driven operating models that can support both the energy transition and accelerating demand growth.

The Senior Customer Partner isn't just a bigger book of business — it's a different kind of leadership. You're shaping how Siemens shows up in an entire industry. You're the person in the room when a CEO is deciding whether to bet their transformation agenda on us. You're not just running an account — you're defining a market. If that's the conversation you want to have, read on.

At Siemens Advanta, we bridge the real and digital worlds to help the world's most complex industries move faster, operate smarter, and grow stronger. We are seeking a Senior Customer Partner – Transformation & Growth to operate at the VP level — with the capacity to both shape and lead a strategic market vertical and run a large multinational account.

If you've spent your career building and leading executive relationships across Power & Utilities and Energy — and you're ready to help utilities modernize the grid, address growing demand from data centers and AI-driven load growth, and define how Siemens wins in this market — this role was built for you.

You'll make an impact by:

Own the Account. Lead the Relationship.

  • Serve as the primary Siemens Advanta executive for one or more priority Power & Utilities and Energy accounts, with responsibility for shaping relationships across utilities facing grid modernization, reliability, resiliency, and load growth challenges.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with C-suite and VP-level utility stakeholders, including technology, operations, grid modernization, customer, and finance leaders making major investment decisions across transmission, distribution, data, and digital transformation.
  • Serve as the senior Siemens executive sponsor for key utility accounts, ensuring coordinated engagement across local, regional, and global Siemens structures.
  • Synchronize with Siemens Key Account Managers and Siemens Grid Software leaders to elevate conversations to the enterprise level, helping utilities navigate the full breadth of the Siemens ecosystem.

Shape the Vertical. Drive the Market.

  • Help drive the Power & Utilities go-to-market strategy, translating sector trends such as grid modernization, renewables integration, data center load growth, reliability, resiliency, and regulatory pressure into a scalable commercial agenda for Siemens Advanta NAM.
  • Develop and execute tailored account and vertical growth strategies that create new utility opportunities, expand existing relationships, and position Siemens Advanta as a strategic transformation partner to the sector.
  • Represent Siemens externally as a Power & Utilities industry leader, bringing market insight, customer perspective, and strategic relevance to utility transformation, grid modernization, and energy transition conversations.
  • Maintain executive discipline across forecasting, account planning, risk management, and pricing to convert complex utility opportunities into long-term, profitable growth.

Sell Outcomes. Deliver Value.

  • Sell professional and managed services at scale, structuring multi-year, outcome-based engagements tied to grid modernization, digital transformation, asset performance, data platforms, and operational resilience. You understand that in this business, the sale doesn't end at signature.
  • Shape integrated utility transformation opportunities that leverage the full breadth of Siemens, including Siemens Grid Software, Smart Infrastructure, Digital Industries, Siemens Advanta, and the Siemens Xcelerator ecosystem.
  • Lead complex utility pursuits and strategic dealmaking across geographies, business units, functions, and stakeholders, from early shaping through negotiation and closure.
  • Partner with solution, delivery, and specialty teams to develop compelling executive narratives, differentiated proposals, and transformation roadmaps for senior utility decision-makers.

Orchestrate the Ecosystem. Multiply the Impact.

  • Orchestrate complex internal and external ecosystems, aligning Siemens business units, grid software teams, delivery organizations, and strategic partners to accelerate execution, value realization, and customer impact for utilities. You've done this before and have a specific example of how you made it work.
  • Mobilize partner capabilities to support faster scaling, repeatable solutions, and improved transformation experiences across Power & Utilities accounts.
  • Elevate utility customer conversations to the enterprise level, helping clients navigate complexity, prioritize grid and digital transformation initiatives, and unlock measurable business value.

We are looking for a Sr. Customer Partner-Transformation & Growth, and this is a remote position based in the United States.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account leadership, transformation sales, or enterprise business development.
  • Minimum 5 years of direct, hands-on experience selling into or operating within Power & Utilities/Energy at a senior level — you've been in the room with the CISO, the CIO, utility operations leaders, and executive decision-makers responsible for grid modernization, reliability, and transformation.
  • 10 + years of experience selling professional or managed services at scale — structuring multi-year, outcome-based engagements and managing delivery accountability across complex organizations.
  • 10+ years of experience owning large, multinational accounts and/or leading a market vertical with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • 10+ years of experience in orchestrating multi-party ecosystems — aligning internal business units, external partners, and delivery organizations around a shared customer outcome.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 50–70%.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related technical or scientific field.
  • Executive presence and the ability to operate credibly at the VP and C-suite level — inside Siemens and in front of customers.
  • Familiarity with Siemens portfolios across Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, and Advanta — or a demonstrated ability to learn and connect complex capability sets quickly.
  • Experience in additional priority vertical: Power and Utilities
  • Experience developing and executing multi-geography pursuit strategies in matrixed organizations.
  • Background at a management consulting firm (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, Capgemini), industrial technology company, or systems integrator — where selling services and delivering outcomes were inseparable.
  • Deep understanding of how to navigate matrixed organizations and align stakeholders around transformation priorities.
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, business case development, and negotiation.
  • Entrepreneurial, data-driven, and outcome-oriented - you operate well in ambiguity and move fast when the opportunity is clear.
  • Passion for the specific industries you serve - genuine curiosity about how Life Sciences, Energy, or Defense customers think, operate, and make decisions.

Job.JobTitle: Technical Marketing Engineer Advanced IC Packaging
Job.JobDescription:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Position Summary

The Technical Marketing Engineer is responsible for driving technical marketing and solution development for EBS-centered offerings in the area of Advanced IC Packaging, with particular focus on 2.5D and 3DIC design flows.

This role requires the ability to understand customer challenges and use cases, and to translate them into solution-oriented workflows by connecting planning, layout, and verification tools using scripting technologies such as Tcl and Python. The ideal candidate will be able to engage customers in technical discussions, articulate solution value, and help shape future workflow directions, including emerging approaches that may involve agent-based technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and deliver technical marketing materials such as videos, presentations, and lab/demo content for Advanced IC Packaging solutions.
  • Build and demonstrate solution workflows for 2.5D and 3DIC design by connecting multiple tools, including planning, layout, and verification tools, using Tcl and Python.
  • Engage customers in technical discussions to understand design challenges, workflow gaps, and use-case requirements.
  • Translate customer technical requirements and related business needs into actionable input for development teams.
  • Understand newly developed products and enhancement features, and communicate their technical value and applicability to customers.
  • Support the definition and evolution of solution concepts that address current and future customer workflows.
  • Collaborate with internal teams across product, development, and field organizations to align solutions with market needs.

Accountability / Expected Contributions

  • Understand the goals of each assigned project and the role expected within that project.
  • Proactively drive assigned responsibilities to support successful project execution and achievement of business objectives.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and contribute effectively in project-based activities.
  • Help identify and shape future solution opportunities based on customer engagement and market direction.

Required Qualifications

  • Native or near-native proficiency in English.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in 2.5D / 3DIC design, Advanced IC Packaging, or technically supporting such flows from an EDA perspective.
  • Strong understanding of design workflows spanning planning, layout, and verification.
  • Practical scripting experience using Tcl and Python to automate or integrate workflows across multiple tools.
  • Ability to engage directly with customers in technical discussions and help define solution use cases.
  • Ability to use Linux as an end user in a business or technical environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products for business use.
  • Formal academic background in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in technical marketing, application engineering, solution engineering, or other customer-facing technical roles.
  • Experience creating technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept workflows, or presentation materials.
  • Familiarity with EDA solution positioning for semiconductor or packaging design customers.
  • Interest in emerging workflow technologies, including AI- or agent-assisted solution approaches.

Travel Requirements

  • Customer visits are required.
  • Domestic travel will be the primary travel requirement.
  • International travel may also be required occasionally.

Work Environment / Additional Considerations

  • This role requires collaboration with teams in Asia and Europe.
  • As a result, work may occasionally take place during early morning or evening hours to accommodate global collaboration.

This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

This role supports a customer service engineering team focused on migrating legacy FactoryLink (FLink) applications to Siemens WinCC platforms. The engineer will work as part of a dedicated migration team to analyze, convert, and validate customer projects while ensuring technical accuracy, consistency, and quality delivery.

We are looking for a Service Engineer. This position is remote and can be based anywhere in the continental United States.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Execute FLink to Siemens WinCC migration activities as part of a structured, team-based engineering environment
  • Analyze existing FLink applications and map functionality to WinCC equivalents under defined migration approaches
  • Develop, modify, and validate WinCC screens, scripts, and system configurations
  • Apply VBScript (VBS) and C to support migration logic, configuration changes, and routine troubleshooting activities
  • Collaborate with migration team members to meet project scope, quality, and delivery objectives
  • Participate in technical reviews, system testing, and issue resolution, escalating complex issues as appropriate
  • Contribute to engineering documentation and knowledge sharing, supporting standardized migration processes and best practices

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years demonstrated hands-on experience with Siemens WinCC, including configuration and basic system troubleshooting
  • Proficiency in VBScript (VBS) and C programming applied in WinCC automation environments
  • Experience working in a collaborative, team-based engineering environment
  • Ability to understand and convert legacy automation applications with established standards
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to follow structured approaches to issue resolution
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience with FLink systems
  • Experience with WinCC automation system migrations or modernization projects
  • Familiarity with customer-facing project environments

Job.JobTitle: Senior Software Developer – Algorithms and AI for Chip Design Automation - Remote US*
Job.JobDescription:
Senior Software Developer – Algorithms and AI for Chip Design Automation

We are looking for several experienced software engineers to join our growing team in Santa Clara, California, developing the next generation of AI-driven technology for analog and custom IC design.

Want to Solve Problems Nobody Else Has Solved?

  • How would you search through more possible solutions than atoms in the universe and consistently find one of the best?
  • How would you combine AI, optimization, graph algorithms, and geometry to automate work that experts have spent decades doing manually?
  • How would you place and connect millions of devices while balancing power, performance, area, manufacturability, and runtime?
  • How would you build software that helps design the chips powering the next generation of AI, cloud computing, communications, and automotive systems?
  • How would you bring breakthrough technology from an idea on a whiteboard to a production tool used by real customers?

That's what we do.

We are looking for engineers with a consistent track record of turning bold ideas into production software used by real customers. You'll be working on some of the hardest problems in electronic design automation, developing technology that enables the next generation of AI, computing, communications, and semiconductor products.

You will have delivered commercial software, helped bring new products or major capabilities to market, and demonstrated the ability to turn ambitious ideas into production-ready solutions used by real customers.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop software for analog IC layout automation, placement, routing, and optimization.
  • Apply AI techniques to solve sophisticated design automation problems.
  • Drive features from concept through customer deployment.
  • Collaborate with engineers, domain experts, and customers to define and deliver solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and contribute to product direction.

Requirements

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical rigor.
  • Significant experience developing commercial software products and bringing new products or major capabilities to market.
  • Strong C++ software development skills.
  • Experience applying AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI techniques in production software.
  • Strong background in algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented software design.
  • Experience with Linux development environments, testing, debugging, profiling, and source control.
  • Strong communication and customer-facing skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Ideally, you have experience developing software within or integrating with OpenAccess-based design environments such as Cadence Virtuoso.
  • Semiconductor design automation (EDA) software development.
  • Analog, custom IC, or physical design workflows.
  • OpenAccess-based environments and commercial design platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
  • Placement, routing, layout automation, or physical implementation technologies.
  • Numerical optimization, graph algorithms, and computational geometry.
  • Direct customer engagement and technical leadership.
  • Python or TCL.

Why This Role?

We are looking for engineers with a proven history of building products that matter. The ideal candidate has experience with AI-driven solutions and OpenAccess-based design platforms, but we will also consider exceptional candidates from other industries who have demonstrated excellence in software development, algorithms, AI, optimization, graphics, scientific computing, robotics, or related technical fields.

Candidates should be comfortable taking ownership of difficult technical problems, driving innovation, and delivering technology that creates measurable impact for customers. Experience with EDA, OpenAccess, or Cadence Virtuoso is highly desirable, but not required for exceptional candidates with a strong record of technical achievement and commercial software delivery.

Siemens Benefits

Siemens believes in fostering a work environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance. Our world class benefits package includes 401k matching, stock purchase plan, annual performance reviews/bonuses, education reimbursement, partially paid Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Life, Short/Long Term Disability, and a generous time off plan. https://benefits—jobs-sw-siemens-com.microsites.recruitrooster.com/benefits/

Job.JobTitle: Senior Energy Consultant - Power Market Modeling
Job.JobDescription:
Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Grid Software's Power Technologies International (PTI) Energy Business Advisory team is helping businesses navigate complexity, drive growth, and steer strategic direction in an evolving landscape. Our wide range of services offer solutions in planning, managing risk, improving operations, conducting custom market studies, supporting M&A activities, and developing infrastructure.

We are looking for a Senior Energy Consultant to deliver valuable solutions to utilities, investors, and project developers. We seek someone with deep expertise in power market modeling to support asset valuation, curtailment and congestion analysis, strategic market outlooks, and project siting decisions. Transform the everyday with us!

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S.

You'll make an impact as you:

  • Develop and run production cost and market models to support Integrated Resource Planning (IRP) and broader integrated system planning studies.
  • Build power price forecasts and long-term market outlooks to inform utility, developer, and investor decisions.
  • Analyze system operations, resource adequacy, and portfolio performance under different planning scenarios and policy pathways.
  • Support clients in evaluating generation, storage, and transmission investments within integrated planning frameworks.
  • Deliver insights that help clients optimize portfolios, manage risks, and align with evolving market and regulatory conditions.
  • Prepare clear, data-driven reports and presentations that communicate technical results and strategic implications.
  • Mentor junior consultants in modeling, analytics, and interpretation of results.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering, economics, operations research, finance, statistics, physics, or mathematics.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in production cost modeling and power market analytics (using Aurora, PLEXOS, PROMOD, or other production cost modeling tools).
  • Strong understanding of U.S. power markets, renewable integration, and transmission constraints.
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, primarily within the U.S.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior consulting experience with utilities, developers, or investors.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical analyses in clear, client-ready deliverables.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks, interconnection processes, and decarbonization policies.

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.


Siemens Digital Industries Software is seeking a Server Architect to join the Technology & Innovation (T&I) organization as part of the Architecture & Standards team. This role will work closely with, and under the direction of, the Senior Server Architect to define server standards and recommend compute technologies that best enable DI SW's global software development organizations.


The Server Architect will bring deep expertise in compute platforms and server hardware, with a strong focus on supporting scientific and engineering software development workloads. The role partners closely with software engineering organizations, service delivery teams, data center operations, facilities, and procurement to ensure scalable, efficient, and future-ready compute solutions.


Success in this role is measured by technical impact, operational efficiency, and the ability to become a trusted partner to engineering teams and infrastructure peers.


Key Responsibilities:

Architecture & Strategy

  • Partner with the Senior Server Architect to define and maintain enterprise server architecture standards, reference designs, and best practices for DI SW development environments
  • Evaluate and recommend compute technologies optimized for engineering, simulation, build, CI/CD, and high-performance development workloads
  • Align server architecture decisions with broader T&I infrastructure and services strategies

Engineering & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with software development organizations to understand strategic initiatives, performance requirements, and future compute needs
  • Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to engineering teams, translating workload requirements into scalable server architectures
  • Collaborate with service delivery teams to align architecture with operational realities and consumption models

Data Center, Power & Efficiency

  • Partner with data center operations and facilities teams to maximize efficiency across power, cooling, and rack density
  • Influence server platform choices and configurations to support sustainability, energy efficiency, and long-term capacity planning

Technology Evaluation & Vendor Management

  • Maintain deep awareness of server market trends, CPU/GPU roadmaps, accelerator technologies, memory, interconnects, and platform innovations
  • Manage relationships with server and component vendors, influencing roadmaps where possible to align with DI SW requirements
  • Lead or support proofs of concept (POCs), technology evaluations, and platform validations

Lab, Logistics & Procurement Support

  • Manage logistics for loaner systems, seed units, and evaluation hardware, including lab reservations, tracking, and lifecycle coordination
  • Partner with Procurement to support deep-dive quote requests, technical comparisons, and vendor evaluations
  • Provide architectural input to sourcing decisions and long-term supplier strategies

Capacity & Utilization Insight

  • Support capacity planning efforts by contributing to compute capacity and utilization reporting
  • Consult with service delivery teams on reporting requirements, trends, and opportunities for optimization

Required Qualifications:

  • Deep hands-on expertise in server and compute hardware architectures (CPU, memory, storage, accelerators, interconnects)
  • Strong understanding of compute platforms supporting scientific, engineering, and software development workloads
  • Experience working with enterprise data center environments, including power and cooling considerations
  • Proven ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into practical architectural recommendations
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage engineering teams, operations, and vendors


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting large-scale software development or HPC-adjacent environments
  • Familiarity with virtualization, containerized workloads, and hybrid deployment models
  • Experience leading or coordinating hardware POCs and technology evaluations
  • Prior involvement in vendor roadmap discussions or strategic sourcing initiatives

What Success Looks Like:

  • Well-adopted, forward-looking server standards that meet current and future engineering needs
  • Strong partnerships with software development organizations built on trust and technical credibility
  • Efficient, scalable compute platforms that optimize cost, power, and performance
  • Clear influence on vendor technology direction and internal infrastructure strategy


Compensation & Benefits:

The salary range for this position is $129,600 to 233,300 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation (5-10%). The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/



This position will be subject to U.S. export control requirements under the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and/or Export Administration Regulations (EAR). Employment is contingent on either verifying the U.S. Person status or obtaining any necessary export license.

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are looking for a Lead Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software's Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is critical to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid. The Senior Power Systems Lead will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations, while mentoring others on the team.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Performing/leading consulting engagements related to power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Managing/supporting project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Producing reports and presentations with study results in collaboration with team members.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction, analyzing clients' business requirements and identifying opportunities for further business.
  • Supporting proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Providing mentoring and technical development to junior consultants.
  • Developing automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and boost overall efficiency.
  • Delivering on-site consulting and training services.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor's or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience performing power systems analysis for electric utilities, ISOs, RTOs, developers, or national labs; 5+ years preferred.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others professionally.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E required; additional experience with TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld. preferred.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior relevant consulting experience.
  • Experience working in the ISO-NE, PJM, and/or SPP regions
  • Experience in distribution planning.
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD™ or EMTP-RV

What you'll bring

Yard Driver Operations

  • Drives tractor/trailers in a safe and correct manner by adhering to all regulations (e.g., company, local, state and federal).
  • Transports trailers to appropriate destinations in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Tells management about unsafe working conditions, damaged products, or improper procedures.
  • Operates tractor/trailer in a safe and correct manner. Maintains a clean work environment to ensure safety and compliance.
  • Maintain trailers by inspecting to ensure that mechanical, safety, and emergency equipment is in good working order; maintaining proper fuel levels; and performing trailer inventory checks.
  • Utilize warehouse management systems (e.g., yard management system, radio) to move trailers to designated locations within the yard.
  • Ensure quality by maintaining records, logs and forms, including any forms required by the Department of Transportation (DOT).
  • Operate tractor/trailer unit safely by adhering to all safety requirements, to include placing trailers in designated locations.

City Driver
  • Operate tractor/trailer safely by adhering to all safety requirements; inspect mechanical, safety, and emergency equipment of tractor/trailer unit before, during, and after trips.
  • Maintain records by retaining load-related paperwork, electronic logs (e.g., hours of service log) and forms (e.g., forms required by the Department of Transportation, local, state and federal agencies).
  • Maintain records by retaining trip-related paperwork (e.g., trip sheet) and electronic logs, and forms (e.g., forms required by the Department of Transportation).
  • Plan routes based on local and state traffic laws and local restrictions; follow routes according to information from maps and atlas.
  • Complies with company policies, procedures, and standards of ethics and integrity by implementing related action plans; using the Open Door Policy; and applying these in executing business processes and practices.
  • Completes work assignments and priorities by using policies, data, and resources; collaborating with managers, co-workers, customers, and other business partners; identifying priorities, deadlines, and expectations; carrying out tasks; communicating progress and information; determining and recommending ways to address improvement opportunities; and adapting to and learning from change, difficulties, and feedback.

Qualifications

Must have

Yard Driver and City Driver positions will require specific qualifications to be met in order to compete for these position.
Yard Driver- Off Property (Driving off facility property)

  • Valid state-issued driver's license
  • Will obtain Class A Commercial Driver's License (CDL) within 6 months of job entry date and will maintain it while employed in this position

City Driver
  • Interstate (Class A) Commercial Drivers License with Hazmat endorsement (including cleared background check) or will obtain HAZMAT endorsement (with cleared background check) within 120 calendar days of date of hire.Minimum of 30 months experience working in a full-time Class A tractor/trailer driving position in the previous 3 years.
  • No more than two (2) moving violations while operating a personal or commercial motor vehicle in the last three (3) years.
  • No serious traffic violations while operating a commercial motor vehicle in the last three (3) years.
  • No convictions for a DUI, DWI, OUI, or reckless driving involving alcohol/drugs within the last ten (10) years.
  • No preventable accidents* while operating a commercial motor vehicle in the last three (3) years. (*The preventability of any accidents will be determined by Walmart based on the ATA Guidelines.)
  • No preventable* DOT recordable accidents (collisions resulting in disabling damage and/or immediate medical treatment away from the scene) while operating a commercial motor vehicle in the last ten (10) years. (*The preventability of any accidents will be determined by Walmart based on the ATA Guidelines.)
  • No preventable accident* resulting in a fatality or catastrophic injury in driving history (commercial motor vehicle). (*The preventability of any accidents will be determined by Walmart based on the ATA Guidelines.)

Head Teller
Reports to: Branch Manager
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt | Supervisory Role: Yes

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, make a positive impact in our community, and be rewarded for your success.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Head Teller Role

The Head Teller provides exceptional customer service while accurately and efficiently completing customer transactions. This role ensures adherence to all bank operational, security, compliance, and privacy policies, maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality. The Head Teller oversees daily teller operations, supervises teller staff, and ensures that branch cash handling procedures are followed.


Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver Outstanding Customer Service: Create a warm, professional, and efficient environment where every customer feels valued. Proactively understand their needs and confidently recommend Trustco Bank products that support their goals.
  • Leadership & Team Growth: Supervise, mentor, and coach tellers to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and exceptional service. Uphold strict compliance with all policies, acting as a role model. Oversee daily cash balancing and maintain detailed audit logs for accuracy. Manage cash shipments, including ordering, verifying, and distributing funds as needed.

About the IRA Coordinator Role

The IRA Coordinator assists in overseeing the operations and transactions involving IRAs and HSAs. Monitors opening and closing of accounts, account distributions, rollovers, and customer inquiries. Ensures compliance with governmental regulations regarding IRAs and HSAs.


Assisting with the administration of the Financial Services Department through the handling and oversight of daily and monthly reports, the processing of new and closed accounts, working with account administrators and investment advisors on daily tasks associated with estates, trusts and investment accounts, working with staff members on the factoring of mutual fund postings, working with trust administrators in the processing and filing of annual tax returns and various tax forms, assisting with IRA and employee benefit accounts and working with internal and compliance departments on various request and matters presented to the department.


Key Responsibilities

  • Reviews forms from branches and operations to ensure accuracy.
  • Ensures compliance with government regulations, including account over-contributions, early distributions and required minimum distributions.
  • Maintains records and is responsible for timely reporting.
  • Process data into the Bank's system as needed.
  • Schedules and organizes activities such as meetings, conferences and department activities for all members of the department.
  • Performs desktop publishing.
  • Establishes, develops, maintains and updates filing system. Retrieves information from files when needed.
  • Organizes and prioritizes large volumes of information and calls.
  • Sorts and distributes mail. Opens mail for the Financial Services Department. Drafts written responses and/or replies by phone or e-mail when necessary. Responds to regularly occurring requests for information. Process returned mail and ensure it gets to the tax payer in a timely manner.
  • Answers phones for the Financial Services Department. Takes messages or fields and/or answers to all routine and non-routine questions.
  • Types and designs general correspondences, memos, charts, tables, graphs, business plans, etc. Proofreads copy for spelling, grammar and layout, making appropriate changes. Responsible for accuracy and clarity of final copy.
  • Processes IRS and Tax and Finance correspondence.
  • Request checks for IRS and Tax and Finance payments.
  • Daily reconciliation of the securities general ledger.
  • Works independently and within a team on special nonrecurring and ongoing projects.

  • Ability to work well independently and in groups.
  • Working knowledge with Microsoft Office Programs; Excel and Word.

We're looking for a dynamic and results-driven Branch Manager to lead the daily operations of a full-service branch. In this role, you'll oversee all aspects of branch performance—from sales and customer service to lending, operations, and security. About the Head Teller Role

The Head Teller provides exceptional customer service while accurately and efficiently completing customer transactions. This role ensures adherence to all bank operational, security, compliance, and privacy policies, maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality. The Head Teller oversees daily teller operations, supervises teller staff, and ensures that branch cash handling procedures are followed.


Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver Outstanding Customer Service: Create a warm, professional, and efficient environment where every customer feels valued. Proactively understand their needs and confidently recommend Trustco Bank products that support their goals.
  • Leadership & Team Growth: Supervise, mentor, and coach tellers to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and exceptional service. Uphold strict compliance with all policies, acting as a role model. Oversee daily cash balancing and maintain detailed audit logs for accuracy. Manage cash shipments, including ordering, verifying, and distributing funds as needed.

About the Mortgage Originator Role

Unlock Your Earning Potential with the Area's Lowest Mortgage Rates


As a Mortgage Originator with Trustco Bank, you become the face of one of the region's strongest and most respected portfolio lenders. With consistently some of the lowest mortgage rates in the area and a long history of exceptional service, Trustco gives you a unique competitive edge to grow your business, expand your network, and build lifelong client relationships.

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you willprovideexceptional service to our policyholders. PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of the Actuarial Specialist is to produce complex analyses, manage projects, and oversee team workload to meet high levels of service within the Actuarial department. This position exists to support and execute Company strategy as directed by the Chief Actuary, while acting as a team leader and as a trusted advisor to other business leaders.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Provides technical analyses and participates in process development.

  • Provides technical actuarial analyses in the areas of ratemaking, reserving, analytics, and systems integration.

  • Participates in the development and documentation of actuarial department processes.

  • Takes responsibility to modify processes in order to improve accuracy and efficiency.

  • Develops new business processes or comprehensive analytic efforts.

  • Initiates project design within system constraints and demonstrates an understanding of dependencies.

Works with business leaders to develop and implement new products and expand into new markets.

  • Acts in the capacity of a trusted advisor to other business leaders.

  • Ensures that the work product supports business growth and profitability.

  • Takes a prominent role in communicating and explaining actuarial findings to business leaders.

  • Fosters positive, collaborative working relationships with higher level experts across the organization.

  • Works with individuals in other departments in fulfilling the actuarial role within larger projects.

Assists in developing the actuarial team and oversees subordinates' work.

  • Maintains a positive work climate and fosters motivation and engagement.

  • Performs at the level of a subject matter expert and a team lead for a functional area (e.g. regulatory/filings, corporate including reserving, systems administrator, pricing, ratemaking).

  • Ensures soundness and integrity of actuarial analyses.

  • Reviews subordinate's work to uphold consistency with Standards of Practice and provides valuable feedback.

Excess & Surplus Specific:

  • Supports development and enhancement of pricing tools for E&S product lines.

  • Performs individual large complex accounts pricing review and works closely with E&S underwriters.

  • Provides business requirements for system integration and set up data export functions for data reporting.

  • Builds business reports to monitor rate change and profitability of the portfolio.

  • Evaluates and refines pricing assumptions based on industry benchmark data and competitive analysis.

  • Demonstrated success in Commercial Lines (GL, Commercial Auto, and etc.) and/or E&S market environments.

  • Proficient in Excel, Python and SQL; expert in actuarial and statistical modeling techniques. Experienced with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).

  • Strong technical pricing skills with knowledge of exposure-based pricing, experience modelling, catastrophe modelling and stochastic simulation techniques.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities but may act as a team lead and mentor actuarial analysts.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university required in Applied Mathematics, Computer Science or related field.

  • Minimum 5 years of related experience in actuarial roles required.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

ACAS designation highly desired but relevant work experience may be considered.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills and proven project leadership abilities.

  • Thorough knowledge of actuarial models and ability to assess results.

  • Thorough knowledge of broad segments of ICW systems and related business areas.

  • Experience managing multiple projects and resources.

  • Dedication to building a working knowledge of emerging analytic techniques.

  • Ability to work independently in deriving solutions to new business problems.

  • Comfortable and competent in client interaction settings.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Business Development Underwriter - Indianapolis/Northern IN
Job.JobDescription:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this job is to establish collaborative relationships with agencies and producers to understand external marketplace and underwrites within established performance standards. This role evaluates complex business for risk acceptability; matching price to exposure, loss frequency and severity for profitability, and rating plans/modifications for renewal retention. This role exists to ensure that the Company's marketing and producer management objectives are met, through the generation and maintenance of a profitable book of business in accordance with Company goals and guidelines.

LOCATION: Candidates located in Indianapolis area or northern Indiana are preferred, as this role supports a territory covering that region.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Drives and manages a profitable and growing book of business.

  • Sells, services and maintains a producer force that can sell and control a profitable and growing book of business.

  • Monitors the production and quality of assigned producers.

  • Drives profitable sale of the Company's products including increasing sales of existing products, and the introduction and selling of new products as they are developed.

  • Develops the assigned producer group to improve the quality and quantity of the business we obtain from assigned producers.

  • Serves as the primary Company contact and representative with existing and prospective producers.

  • Keeps alert to industry changes, including WCIRB/NCCI rulings, forms, and coverage changes.

Prospects and develops new business.

  • Prospects and prequalifies new producers to determine working relationship.

  • Appoints new quality producers; sets and monitors production expectations with each Agency.

  • Maintains a thorough knowledge of the geographic territory assigned with regard to production sources, competitor activity, and economic and demographic idiosyncrasies.

  • Directs activities pertaining to industry affairs and trade show events including exhibiting, special events and lead generation follow up.

  • Manages marketing research to help identify opportunities for management, product enhancements, new distribution channels and new geographic markets with growth potential.

  • Supports strategic programs to promote new products, reposition existing products and integrate diverse corporate philosophies to support overall marketing and Underwriting efforts.

  • Utilizes high level underwriting authority to effectively price Company's products.

  • Accepts or rejects complex risks, evaluating all risk characteristics (operations, financials, management, employees, prior experience, etc.) as compared to the average in its class and prices for profit within Company Underwriting guidelines.

  • Quotes retro, deductible plans, and other more complex pricing products and has a solid understanding of their various components.

  • Conducts customer presentations explaining these plans in detail.

Delivers superior customer service through collaborative relationships.

  • Provides production support through producer visitations and by participating in underwriting and production presentations.

  • Provides personal assistance to agents and insureds through regular visits to outside locations such as producer's offices.

  • Utilizes company technology to be available to customers when needed.

  • Effectively communicates decisions and resolves agent/customer concerns promptly.

  • Presents Agency Management solutions to agency principals and ICW management team.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have direct reports but may mentor and/or train junior team members.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university in Business, Accounting, Statistics or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Minimum 5 years of related experience in underwriting required, 7 years preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Current driver's license required.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Demonstrated success servicing the Company's clients and building and maintaining relationships with production sources.

  • Proven sales and effective relationship management skills.

  • Ability to apply fundamental to advanced Underwriting concepts, practices, and procedures in an area of specialization.

  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as submissions, loss control reports, and standard policy form/endorsements.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead special projects.

  • Ability to mentor and train professional and support staff.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

  • Role requires 40-50% travel to meet with clients, attend industry events, and develop new business opportunities.

  • Travel is usually limited to automobile, but occasional air travel is required.

  • Requires regular visits to outside locations such as producer's offices.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • This remote/Indiana field position operates in a home office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment.

Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.


We are seeking an experienced leader to drive strategy and execution of technical documentation for our comprehensive portfolio of simulation software, which provide solutions across mechanical, thermal, and fluid dynamics disciplines. This role leads a multi‑country organization, including existing first‑line managers, and is accountable for content quality, delivery models, team capability, and measurable business impact. The leader will guide transformation toward AI‑enabled, context‑rich information creation and consumption aligned with customer workflows.


Key Responsibilities:

    • Refine resourcing and load‑balancing models; strengthen cross‑product collaboration and capacity planning.

Job.JobTitle: Principal Technical Program Manager – Data Center Strategy & Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
The Principal Technical Program Manager will lead complex, multi-year data center infrastructure, consolidation, migration, and technology-transformation programs across enterprise and cloud environments.


This role is responsible for translating business and technical requirements into executable infrastructure strategies, coordinating cross-functional engineering and operational teams, and maintaining control of scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder expectations. The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge of data center, network, security, compute, storage, virtualization, and disaster-recovery environments with senior-level program leadership.


The position is best suited to an experienced infrastructure leader who can operate effectively in ambiguous environments, establish governance, challenge incomplete requirements, and guide programs from initial assessment and strategy through design, procurement, deployment, migration, commissioning, and operational handover. This closely reflects the candidate's demonstrated experience managing large data center portfolios, critical migrations, network and security architecture, and enterprise infrastructure programs.


Key Responsibilities:

Data Center Strategy and Program Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of complex, multi-phase data center and critical-infrastructure programs.

  • Develop data center consolidation, migration, modernization, capacity, resilience, and lifecycle strategies.

  • Establish program objectives, delivery roadmaps, workstreams, milestones, dependencies, governance structures, and success criteria.

  • Convert strategic requirements into executable project scopes, schedules, resource plans, budgets, and risk-management plans.

  • Lead infrastructure assessments to evaluate current-state architecture, operational maturity, service resilience, capacity, technical debt, and business-continuity risks.

  • Identify gaps between contracted scope, stated requirements, and discovered operational or technical needs.

  • Evaluate program alternatives and clearly communicate cost, schedule, risk, operational, and technical tradeoffs to leadership.

  • Maintain accountability for overall program performance while coordinating multiple projects, vendors, and technical disciplines.


Data Center Design and Infrastructure Coordination

  • Coordinate the development and review of high-level data center infrastructure architectures and design requirements.

  • Ensure that compute, storage, virtualization, network, cybersecurity, facilities, cloud, and application requirements are incorporated into the overall solution.

  • Facilitate technical alignment among data center architects, facilities engineers, network and security teams, platform teams, application owners, operations, and external consultants.

  • Support active-active, primary-secondary, disaster-recovery, high-performance computing, and critical-production infrastructure strategies.

  • Review design assumptions for availability, scalability, maintainability, redundancy, recoverability, capacity, and operational readiness.

  • Identify infrastructure dependencies and integration requirements across network, security, compute, storage, application, and facility environments.

  • Support the development of migration architectures, sequencing plans, coexistence strategies, rollback plans, and cutover requirements.

The role does not replace the licensed architects or engineers responsible for detailed electrical, mechanical, structural, fire-protection, or code-compliance design. It provides technical program leadership and ensures that those disciplines are properly coordinated.


Migration and Deployment Management

  • Develop and govern migration frameworks for critical applications, infrastructure platforms, and data center services.

  • Coordinate application discovery, dependency mapping, migration-wave planning, readiness reviews, cutover execution, rollback planning, and post-migration validation.

  • Lead deployment planning for greenfield and brownfield data center environments.

  • Ensure infrastructure, network, security, operations, facilities, and application teams are aligned before migration or production activation.

  • Establish formal entry and exit criteria for design, build, testing, commissioning, migration, and operational handover phases.

  • Track implementation defects, open risks, incomplete deliverables, and operational-readiness gaps through final closure.

  • Coordinate business-continuity and disaster-recovery planning for critical services.

The candidate's background includes leading active-active greenfield data center deployments, establishing migration processes for more than 10,000 critical applications, and managing major infrastructure programs with substantial budgets and extended delivery schedules.


Network, Security, and Technology Integration

  • Provide program-level oversight for enterprise data center network and security architecture.

  • Coordinate LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, software-defined networking, routing, firewall, remote-access, and unified-communications workstreams.

  • Ensure network and security designs meet availability, performance, segmentation, scalability, and operational-support requirements.

  • Facilitate coordination of routing, failover, connectivity, authentication, access-control, and security-zone requirements.

  • Ensure cybersecurity, governance, risk, and compliance requirements are incorporated into program planning and design decisions.

  • Guide technical teams in evaluating infrastructure standards, technology lifecycles, automation opportunities, and future-state roadmaps.


Commercial, Procurement, and Vendor Management

  • Support the preparation, evaluation, clarification, and negotiation of RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, SOWs, and vendor proposals.

  • Translate technical and operational requirements into clear procurement documentation and evaluation criteria.

  • Coordinate technical due diligence of data center operators, consultants, contractors, technology suppliers, and managed-service providers.

  • Evaluate vendor proposals for technical compliance, delivery risk, commercial assumptions, scalability, resilience, and operational suitability.

  • Monitor vendor performance against contractual milestones, deliverables, service levels, and quality requirements.

  • Identify scope gaps, exclusions, assumptions, change requests, and commercial risks before they affect delivery.

  • Support contract negotiations and change-control discussions by providing documented technical and program-impact analysis.


Governance, Risk, and Executive Communication

  • Establish and maintain program governance, reporting, escalation, decision-making, and change-control processes.

  • Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.

  • Track schedule, budget, scope, quality, resource capacity, benefits realization, and operational-readiness indicators.

  • Prepare executive-level reports, decision papers, program dashboards, and recommendations.

  • Clearly communicate complex technical issues to executive, business, operational, and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Escalate unresolved risks, scope conflicts, budget pressures, resource constraints, and delivery concerns in a timely manner.

  • Facilitate steering committees, design reviews, readiness reviews, risk workshops, and executive decision meetings.

  • Create consistent program-management processes and reusable organizational assets across portfolios and business units.

The candidate has demonstrated experience developing governance frameworks, managing program changes and tradeoffs, coordinating subject-matter experts, and reporting schedule, budget, quality, and risk to senior leadership.


Stakeholder and Team Leadership

  • Build strong working relationships with CIOs, directors, senior managers, engineering leaders, application owners, operations teams, facilities organizations, procurement, finance, and external partners.

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams without relying solely on direct reporting authority.

  • Clarify roles, responsibilities, interfaces, decision rights, and escalation paths across program participants.

  • Promote accountability, transparency, customer advocacy, continuous improvement, and high delivery standards.

  • Mentor project managers, technical leads, analysts, and other program team members.

  • Resolve conflicts constructively while protecting agreed program objectives, governance, and technical requirements.


Required Qualifications:

  • Ten or more years of progressive experience leading enterprise infrastructure, data center, network, cloud, or technology-transformation programs.

  • Demonstrated experience managing large, complex, multi-year infrastructure programs involving multiple technical disciplines and stakeholder groups.

  • Strong knowledge of data center architecture, enterprise network infrastructure, cybersecurity, compute, storage, virtualization, and disaster-recovery concepts.

  • Experience leading data center consolidation, migration, modernization, greenfield, or major infrastructure deployment initiatives.

  • Demonstrated ability to develop program strategies, scopes, schedules, budgets, resource plans, governance structures, and risk-management frameworks.

  • Experience coordinating architects, engineers, facilities teams, operations personnel, application owners, vendors, and executive stakeholders.

  • Experience managing program budgets, forecasts, commercial risks, and significant technology portfolios.

  • Experience supporting or leading RFI, RFP, SOW, vendor-selection, and contract-scope activities.

  • Strong executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.

  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally based on program requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with active-active data center architectures and large-scale application migrations.

  • Experience with high-performance computing and other business-critical infrastructure environments.

  • Experience with Cisco networking, SD-WAN, software-defined networking, Palo Alto security platforms, BGP, OSPF, and enterprise remote-access solutions.

  • Familiarity with IT service management, business continuity, disaster recovery, ERP, and infrastructure lifecycle management.

  • Experience working with colocation providers, engineering consultants, general contractors, cloud providers, and managed-service organizations.

  • PMP, PgMP, ITIL, TOGAF, CDCP, CDFOM, or comparable technical or program-management certification.

  • Experience working in global, matrixed organizations.

  • Experience managing programs valued at $100 million or more.

The resume supports extensive cross-functional leadership, formal project planning, RAID management, infrastructure assessments, executive reporting, and development of procurement documentation such as RFIs, RFPs, and SOWs.


Key Performance Indicators:

Success in the role will be evaluated through:

  • Achievement of program milestones within approved scope, schedule, and budget.

  • Quality and completeness of infrastructure requirements and delivery plans.

  • Timely identification and mitigation of program risks and dependencies.

  • Accuracy and transparency of executive reporting.

  • Successful completion of data center migrations and production cutovers.

  • Reduction of unplanned scope changes and unresolved design gaps.

  • Stakeholder confidence and effectiveness of cross-functional coordination.

  • Vendor performance and contractual compliance.

  • Operational readiness and successful transition to support teams.

  • Delivery of measurable improvements in infrastructure resilience, scalability, capacity, security, cost, or service performance.
