Senior Customer Partner-Transformation & Growth

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

Our customers are navigating some of the most complex transformation challenges of the decade.

In Life Sciences and Pharma, they're racing to compress drug-to-market timelines, digitize manufacturing operations, and meet tightening regulatory demands — all while managing global supply chain fragility. In Power & Utilities and Energy, they're modernizing aging grid infrastructure, integrating renewables at scale, and building the digital backbone for the next generation of energy delivery. Across Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor, and Automotive, they're contending with supply chain volatility, digital engineering mandates, and the pressure to move faster than their competitors.

The Senior Customer Partner isn't just a bigger book of business — it's a different kind of leadership. You're shaping how Siemens shows up in an entire industry. You're the person in the room when a CEO is deciding whether to bet their transformation agenda on us. You're not just running an account — you're defining a market. If that's the conversation you want to have, read on.

At Siemens Advanta, we bridge the real and digital worlds to help the world's most complex industries move faster, operate smarter, and grow stronger. We are seeking a Senior Customer Partner – Transformation & Growth to operate at the VP level — with the capacity to both shape and lead a strategic market vertical and run a large multinational account.

If you've spent your career building and leading executive relationships in Life Sciences, Power & Utilities, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor, or Automotive — and you're ready to define how Siemens wins in an entire industry — this role was built for you.

You'll make an impact by:

Own the Account. Lead the Relationship

  • Serve as the primary Siemens Advanta executive for a major multinational account and a priority industry vertical — including Life Sciences/Pharma, Power & Utilities/Energy, Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor, or Automotive.
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with C-suite and VP-level stakeholders — the CIO, CDO, COO, and board-level leaders making transformation decisions worth hundreds of millions of dollars.
  • Serve as the senior Siemens executive sponsor for key accounts, ensuring coordinated engagement across local, regional, and global structures.
  • Synchronize with Siemens Key Account Managers to elevate conversations to the enterprise level, helping clients navigate the full breadth of the Siemens ecosystem.

Shape the Vertical. Drive the Market

  • Lead vertical go-to-market strategy — translating sector trends, customer priorities, and Siemens capabilities into a scalable commercial agenda for Siemens Advanta NAM.
  • Develop and execute a tailored account and vertical growth strategy that creates new logos and deepens existing relationships in equal measure.
  • Represent Siemens externally as an industry leader, bringing market insight, customer perspective, and strategic relevance to vertical growth efforts and account strategy.
  • Maintain executive discipline across forecasting, account planning, risk management, and pricing to convert complex opportunities into long-term, profitable growth.

Sell Outcomes. Deliver Value.

  • Sell professional and managed services at scale — structuring multi-year, outcome-based engagements and managing delivery accountability across complex organizations. You understand that in this business, the sale doesn't end at signature.
  • Shape integrated transformation opportunities to leverage the full breadth of Siemens — including Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, Advanta, and the Siemens Xcelerator ecosystem.
  • Lead complex pursuits and strategic dealmaking across geographies, functions, and stakeholders — from early shaping through negotiation and closure.
  • Partner with solution, delivery, and specialty teams to develop compelling executive narratives, differentiated proposals, and transformation roadmaps for senior customer decision-makers.

Orchestrate the Ecosystem. Multiply the Impact.

  • Orchestrate complex internal and external ecosystems — aligning business units, delivery teams, and strategic partners to accelerate execution, value realization, and customer impact. You've done this before and have a specific example of how you made it work.
  • Mobilize partner capabilities to support faster scaling, repeatable solutions, and improved customer transformation experiences across the vertical.
  • Elevate customer conversations to the enterprise level, helping clients navigate complexity, prioritize transformation initiatives, and unlock measurable business value.

We are looking for a Sr. Customer Partner-Transformation & Growth, and this is a remote position based in the United States.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic account leadership, transformation sales, or enterprise business development.
  • Minimum 5 years of direct, hands-on experience selling into or operating within Life Sciences/Pharma or Power & Utilities/Energy at a senior level — you've been in the room with the CISO, the COO, and the board.
  • 10 + years of experience selling professional or managed services at scale — structuring multi-year, outcome-based engagements and managing delivery accountability across complex organizations.
  • 10+ years of experience owning large, multinational accounts and/or leading a market vertical with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • 10+ years of experience in orchestrating multi-party ecosystems — aligning internal business units, external partners, and delivery organizations around a shared customer outcome.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 50–70%.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in Engineering, Business, Life Sciences, Information Systems, or a related technical or scientific field.
  • Executive presence and the ability to operate credibly at the VP and C-suite level — inside Siemens and in front of customers.
  • Familiarity with Siemens portfolios across Digital Industries, Smart Infrastructure, and Advanta — or a demonstrated ability to learn and connect complex capability sets quickly.
  • Experience in additional priority verticals: Aerospace & Defense, Semiconductor, or Automotive.
  • Experience developing and executing multi-geography pursuit strategies in matrixed organizations.
  • Background at a management consulting firm (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, IBM, Capgemini), industrial technology company, or systems integrator — where selling services and delivering outcomes were inseparable.
  • Deep understanding of how to navigate matrixed organizations and align stakeholders around transformation priorities.
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, business case development, and negotiation.
  • Entrepreneurial, data-driven, and outcome-oriented - you operate well in ambiguity and move fast when the opportunity is clear.
  • Passion for the specific industries you serve - genuine curiosity about how Life Sciences, Energy, or Defense customers think, operate, and make decisions.

Position Summary:

Are you passionate about helping Electronics companies, including consumer electronics, contract manufacturers, and data centers, transform their business with innovative technology solutions? Are you skilled at defining strategies across sales, marketing and product functions that drive software revenue growth in a SaaS business model? Are you skilled at understanding customer processes and driving the definition of software-based solutions to support those processes? Are you a skilled leader in leading change within a matrixed organizational structure? Have you sold technology or been a major contributor to the process of selling technology into the Electronics industry?

In this position you will have a chance to apply these skills and more as you define and drive the execution of our strategy to drive growth and increased market share within the Electronics industry. Your strategy will drive investment priorities, solution direction, sales and marketing strategy across Siemens Software.

The Electronics Industry leader is responsible for defining and driving the industry strategy for the Electronics industry within Siemens Digital Industries Software business unit. As a focused, priority industry within Siemens Digital Industries Software, customers in the Electronics industry have direct influence on the future of developing software solutions that help our customers drive profitable growth. The strategy you develop in this position drives our solution development (make, buy, partner), sales and marketing prioritization. The position requires working with customer CXOs, VP/Chief Engineer/Director of Engineering and Manufacturing and with Siemens Digital Industries and Digital Industries Software executives, sales teams, internal product development, and marketing teams.

The Electronics Industry Leader will be responsible for:

  • Developing an industry-specific strategy and business plan that looks at market trends, competitive evaluations and customer needs and articulates a strategy for market growth in the industry. That strategy will include product and solution strategy, sales strategy and marketing strategy. The sales strategy will include strategic account pursuits and territory sales plans. The person will also have accountability for working these strategies with country managers and account teams, channel sales and digital sales across the globe to optimize market growth and expansion. The business plan must also address M&A priorities and targets. The industry leader will be responsible for leading and presenting the industry vision and strategy to the global sales team.
  • Solution Definition requirements including shaping our product development priorities, technologies, and portfolio investments. In this portion of the job, the person will have accountability for defining product direction and investment priorities based on market trends, competitive assessments, SaaS solutions, customer inputs, and industry knowledge. The individual will define and work with Solution Directors and the various product groups to help outline and define solution improvements and priorities, and work with product group's managers and technical teams to define technical issues, gaps, and specific required solutions for their industry.
  • Go-to-market, including developing “Go to Market” strategies and messaging in partnership with the marketing team. Additionally, the individual will have responsibility for speaking at major internal Siemens events and external industry events and forums across the globe. The individual will work with other members of the organization to develop templates and solutions that leverage industry guidelines to help customers shorten their deployment times and realize business benefits quicker. They will also work with other industry verticals to help support their go-to-to-market efforts for customers within their respective industry.
  • Sales and Customer Engagement: Drive alignment across the sales organization to the industry strategy. Help global sales teams understand how to compete and win against major competitors. Capture and distribute industry-specific knowledge globally. Lead major customer pursuits globally.

Qualifications include:

  • A deep understanding of selling software or related technology to customers in the Electronics industry, including consumer electronics, contract electronics manufacturers and data centers.
  • Understanding of Electronics business and processes is required.
  • A BA/BS degree in engineering, manufacturing or other relevant field is required. An MBA or other graduate degree is desirable.
  • Experience working in the Electronics industry is desirable.
  • Experience in digital technology driven process improvement and re-engineering in engineering and manufacturing processes is required.
  • Key Attributes for this role include critical thinking, competitive assessments, business insight, technology foundation, business development.
  • Executive presence is required, with proven success working with internal and customer executives.
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills are required.

Work Location:

  • Office environment or remote / work from home
  • This is a global role that can be based remotely in the United States of America
  • This is a global role with the expectation that the candidate can travel globally as needed to support the requirements of the job.
  • The salary reflected in the posting is for hires within the United States of America only

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

We are looking for a Senior Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software's Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is essential to the planning and integration of renewables, storage, and FACTS to the electrical grid. The Senior Power Systems Consultant will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Leading and performing advanced power system studies, including system dynamics, electromagnetic transients, interconnection analysis, and grid code compliance using industry-standard tools.
  • Performing and reviewing detailed modeling and simulation work for synchronous machines, inverter-based resources, and control systems.
  • Managing and supporting technical project execution by tracking milestones, validating study assumptions, and ensuring work meets defined technical scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
  • Developing, validating, and documenting study methodologies and assumptions, and producing detailed technical reports and client-ready presentations.
  • Collaborating with multi-disciplinary engineering teams to interpret study results and resolve complex system performance issues.
  • Providing technical mentorship to junior consultants on modeling approaches, simulation techniques, and established guidelines.
  • Designing and implementing automation scripts and workflows to enhance model development, study execution, post-processing, and quality control.
  • Supporting on-site technical consulting engagements and delivering specialized training on power system modeling, simulation tools, and study methodologies.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in electrical engineering with a focus in Power Systems Engineering.
  • 5+ years of experience in power system studies, with strong hands-on expertise in PSCAD and electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations.
  • Proven experience developing, validating, and troubleshooting detailed PSCAD models for inverter-based resources, renewable generation, energy storage systems, and grid-connected power electronics.
  • Experience performing EMT studies for grid compliance, including fault ride-through, control interactions, harmonic and subsynchronous interaction analysis.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E required
  • Familiarity with utility and regional transmission organization requirements and standards (for example: ERCOT, SPP, WECC, PJM, Southern Company, or similar).
  • Experience supporting interconnection studies, system impact studies, or facility studies.
  • Ability to lead technical workstreams and review technical deliverables
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting technical findings to clients, utilities, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in electrical engineering with a focus in Power Systems Engineering
  • Additional experience with platforms like TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld preferred.
  • Good knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards with understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing others professionally.

We are looking for a Senior Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software's Power Technologies International (PTI) team. This role is responsible for performing advanced power system planning and integration studies for renewable and inverter-based resources, including large-scale simulation and analysis of electrical transmission networks. The position involves developing and executing steady-state, dynamic, and electromagnetic transient studies to support grid interconnection, compliance, and operational reliability for clients such as generation developers, independent system operators, and transmission owners. operators, and transmission providers to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations.

This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S.

You'll make an impact as you:

  • Apply power system planning methodologies to model and analyze transmission system steady-state, dynamic, and transient performance.
  • Perform generation interconnection and integration studies for conventional and inverter-based resources, ensuring compliance with utility, regional transmission organization, and grid code requirements.
  • Develop, tune, and validate power system models (including generator, inverter, and control models) to meet study objectives and regulatory or interconnection requirements.
  • Prepare comprehensive technical reports documenting study assumptions, methodologies, results, conclusions, and recommendations.
  • Collaborate within small project teams to deliver high-quality technical outputs while meeting project scope, schedule, budget, and quality targets.
  • Develop and implement automation scripts to improve the efficiency, consistency, and accuracy of simulations and post-processing.
  • Support proposal development by contributing to technical approaches, project plans, budgets, schedules, and resource estimates.
  • Provide on-site technical consulting support and deliver specialized training to clients as required.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in electrical engineering with a specialization in Power and Energy Systems
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in the electric power industry as outlined below. Advanced degree MAY be substituted for professional experience if academic work included required studies and tools listed below.
  • Candidate must have knowledge of transmission system planning or operations with experience analyzing power flow, dynamic stability, and electromagnetic transients using PSS®E, TSAT, or PSLF.
  • Great written and spoken communication skills in English are required.
  • Ability to travel 10% domestically.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior experience in Power System Consulting.
  • Generation interconnection or operations experience in MISO, SPP, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE, PJM
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD/EMTDC or EMTP-RV

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.


Position Overview:

The Emulation Hardware Support Manager will lead a global team of engineers responsible for deploying, maintaining, and optimizing emulation hardware systems (e.g., FPGA-based platforms) across hybrid environments, including on-premises data centers, cloud infrastructure, and customer sites. This role requires a strategic leader who combines technical expertise in hardware systems with operational excellence, team development, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure 99.9%+ uptime, rapid incident resolution, and scalable infrastructure growth.


The ideal candidate will drive continuous improvement in hardware reliability, automation, and support processes while managing a 24/7 operational environment. This position serves as a critical bridge between R&D, IT, facilities, and customer success teams, ensuring alignment between product design, infrastructure capabilities, and customer needs.


Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of 19+ Emulation Hardware Support Engineers across multiple regions.
  • Design and oversee on-call rotations, training programs, and career development plans to build expertise in FPGA-based systems, Linux administration, and network diagnostics.
  • Implement performance metrics (e.g., MTTR < 2 hours, <5% escalations) and conduct quarterly reviews to align team goals with organizational objectives.

Infrastructure Operations & Reliability

  • Own end-to-end lifecycle management of emulation hardware, including capacity planning, deployment, firmware updates, and decommissioning.
  • Develop and support SOPs for hardware diagnostics, failure analysis, and preventive maintenance to minimize downtime.
  • Partner with IT and facilities teams to optimize data center layouts, power/cooling efficiency, and hardware security protocols.

Incident Management & Escalation

  • Lead critical incident response for Severity 1 issues, coordinating with engineering and customer teams to resolve outages within SLA targets.
  • Conduct post-mortem analyses to identify root causes (e.g., firmware bugs, thermal throttling) and implement corrective actions.
  • Maintain a knowledge base of resolved cases to accelerate future troubleshooting.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with R&D to provide field feedback for improving hardware design (e.g., debug interfaces, telemetry capabilities).
  • Partner with sales/support teams on customer-facing activities, including pre-sales technical reviews and on-site deployment support.
  • Coordinate with vendors to negotiate SLAs for component replacements and firmware support.

Process Optimization & Automation

  • Implement monitoring tools to track system health metrics (latency, thermal levels, FPGA utilization).
  • Automate repetitive tasks such as log analysis, firmware rollouts, and inventory tracking using Automation tools.
  • Lead quarterly capacity planning reviews to align infrastructure with projected customer demand.


Qualifications:

  • Education: BS/MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. Equivalent experience: 10+ years in hardware operations roles.
  • Expertise in FPGA-based emulation systems (e.g., Veloce or Equivalent)
  • Basic/Mid-level Linux administration
  • Leadership: 5+ years managing technical teams in 24/7 environments. Proven track record of reducing MTTR by ≥30% through process improvements.
  • Global compliance standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2)


Leadership Competencies:

  • Crisis Management: Demonstrated ability to lead teams during high-pressure outages (e.g., resolving multi-rack failures under SLA deadlines).
  • Stakeholder Communication: Skill in translating technical incidents into business impact reports for executives.
  • Innovation: History of implementing cost-saving initiatives (e.g., predictive maintenance algorithms reducing hardware CAPEX by 15%).

Assistant Branch Manager
Reports to: Branch Manager
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt | Supervisory Role: Yes

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, make a positive impact in our community, and be rewarded for your success.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

Ready to lead with confidence and make a meaningful impact? Apply now and become part of our dedicated banking family!

About the Assistant Branch Manager Role

Join Our Dynamic Banking Team and Lead with Excellence!

Are you a motivated leader with a passion for delivering exceptional customer service and driving branch success? We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Assistant Branch Manager to support our Branch Manager in orchestrating the seamless operation of our branch, fostering a trusted environment, and elevating the customer experience. This pivotal role offers the chance to influence our community's financial well-being and grow professionally within a reputable institution.

As the Assistant Branch Manager, you will be the vital right hand to our Branch Manager, overseeing daily operations, supervising staff, and ensuring our branch functions with efficiency, security, and warmth. Your expertise in residential mortgages, IRA services, and personal banking products will empower you to deliver tailored solutions that meet our clients' needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operational Leadership: Stepping into the Branch Manager's shoes during their absence, managing staff, and maintaining smooth day-to-day operations.
  • Team Supervision: Overseeing Head Teller and Teller teams, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
  • Branch Branding & Growth: Building a strong branch identity, promoting sales initiatives, and championing exceptional customer service.
  • Customer Engagement: Personally, connecting with clients and prospects, resolving issues efficiently, and ensuring satisfaction aligns with our high standards.
  • Compliance & Accuracy: Reviewing and approving transactions such as large check cashing, bank checks, and ledger entries, while maintaining strict adherence to policies.
  • Performance & Standards: Striving to meet and exceed branch performance metrics, focusing on operational controls, security, and regulatory compliance.
  • Professional Development: Continually enhancing your banking acumen and sales techniques through training, workshops, and ongoing education.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Proven supervisory and leadership experience
  • Strong customer service background
  • Cash handling expertise
  • Excellent verbal communication skills
  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus
  • Access to reliable transportation
  • Well-organized and adept at managing multiple priorities
  • Team-oriented with the ability to thrive in collaborative environments
  • Ability to lift 10–20 lbs., stand for extended periods.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Previous banking or financial services experience
  • Familiarity with residential mortgages, IRA services, and personal banking products

Schedule

  • Mon & Wed: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Tue: 8:30 AM - 3:00 PM
  • Thu–Fri: 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. About the Head Teller Role

The Head Teller provides exceptional customer service while accurately and efficiently completing customer transactions. This role ensures adherence to all bank operational, security, compliance, and privacy policies, maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality. The Head Teller oversees daily teller operations, supervises teller staff, and ensures that branch cash handling procedures are followed.

  • Leadership & Team Growth: Supervise, mentor, and coach tellers to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and exceptional service. Uphold strict compliance with all policies, acting as a role model. Oversee daily cash balancing and maintain detailed audit logs for accuracy. Manage cash shipments, including ordering, verifying, and distributing funds as needed.
  • Transaction Handling: Process a variety of customer transactions—deposits, withdrawals, loan payments, check cashing—with precision. Handle verification, money orders, bank checks, and receipts efficiently. Manage credit card payments, safe deposit access, ATM maintenance, and night deposits smoothly.
  • Reporting & Compliance: Prepare and submit detailed reports accurately and on time. Keep thorough transaction records in line with audit standards and regulations.

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

Wealthspire is a leading wealth management, retirement advisory, and business management firm serving individuals, families, endowments, and institutions across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. We provide a comprehensive platform that brings together wealth management, institutional consulting, business management, family office, and retirement plan advisory services—empowering clients to navigate complexity with clarity and confidence.

With over 1,200 employees across more than 40 offices, we deliver insights and solutions backed by deep research, technology, and decades of expertise. Our collective businesses create a unified ecosystem designed to meet clients wherever they are in their financial journey. Wealthspire is redefining the future of financial solutions through collaboration, scale, and a steadfast commitment to putting people first—our clients, our colleagues, and our communities.

For more information, visit www.wealthspire.com. Wealthspire Advisors LLC, Fiducient Advisors LLC, Wealthspire Retirement, LLC, dba Wealthspire Retirement Advisory, and certain other affiliates are separately registered investment advisers.

Overview

The AVP, Business Line Marketing & Growth is a senior marketing leader responsible for driving enterprise-wide growth initiatives across Wealthspire's business lines and client segments, including private wealth and institutional audiences. This role serves as the primary marketing partner to Business Line Leaders, Sales, and Sales Enablement, while directly managing Marketing Managers and ensuring consistent, high-quality execution across the organization.

Reporting to the SVP, Business Line Marketing, this individual combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating firm and business-line priorities into actionable marketing plans that deliver measurable results. This role requires strong people leadership, communication skills, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep understanding of how marketing performance supports business growth.

Role Description

The AVP, Business Line Marketing & Growth owns the development and execution of integrated marketing strategies that support Wealthspire's growth objectives across all business lines. This role leads and prioritizes marketing efforts enterprise-wide, balancing long-term strategy with near-term execution in close partnership with Sales, Sales Enablement, and Business Line leadership.

As a manager of marketing coordinators, this role is responsible for setting direction, establishing priorities, and ensuring alignment and accountability across Marketing Managers. While this position provides oversight and leadership, it is also expected to remain execution-capable, stepping in directly on high-impact initiatives, institutional opportunities, and strategic campaigns as needed.

This individual brings a strong understanding of both institutional and private client marketing and acts as a connective leader across Wealthspire, helping unify offerings, messaging, and go-to-market execution across the firm.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enterprise & Business Line Leadership
    • Serve as the senior marketing partner to Business Line Leaders, collaborating closely to translate business objectives into integrated marketing strategies.
    • Partner with Sales and Sales Enablement to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals, pipeline development, and client acquisition strategies.
    • Contribute to enterprise-level growth planning by helping prioritize initiatives, allocate marketing resources, and sequence execution in alignment with firm strategy.
  • People Management & Team Leadership
    • Directly manage and develop multiple Marketing Managers, providing clear direction, coaching, and performance oversight.
    • Set priorities and standards across the marketing organization to ensure consistency, quality, and accountability.
    • Act as an escalation point for complex initiatives, resource constraints, and cross-functional challenges.
  • Strategy-to-Execution Ownership
    • Lead the planning and execution of enterprise and business-line marketing initiatives, including lead generation programs, institutional campaigns, strategic partnerships, and integrated go-to-market efforts.
    • Maintain the ability to execute directly on high-priority projects, ensuring momentum and excellence where senior involvement is required.
    • Oversee the development of integrated marketing plans that span channels such as events, sponsorships, advertising, content, digital campaigns, and client communications.
  • Institutional & Private Client Marketing
    • Support marketing efforts across both institutional and private client segments, ensuring strategies and messaging are appropriately tailored while aligned under a cohesive firm narrative.
    • Provide guidance on positioning, thought leadership, and campaign development to support institutional relationships and complex client needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work closely with the SVP and other leaders across Wealthspire to ensure marketing initiatives reflect a deep understanding of the firm's services, capabilities, and operating model.
    • Collaborate with corporate and centralized marketing teams to align brand standards, messaging frameworks, and campaign execution.
    • Engage and manage external vendors and partners to support large-scale initiatives and events as needed.
  • Performance, Metrics & Optimization
    • Establish clear success metrics for enterprise and business-line marketing initiatives in collaboration with stakeholders.
    • Review performance data and insights to optimize strategies, inform decision-making, and report results to senior leadership.
    • Ensure Marketing Managers are tracking and reporting outcomes consistently across initiatives.

Qualifications and Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience supporting both institutional and private client audiences.
  • Demonstrated success managing and developing people, preferably managing managers in a matrixed or enterprise environment.
  • Strong strategic marketing background with the ability to translate complex business goals into actionable plans.
  • Proven execution skills, with experience leading multiple, concurrent initiatives under tight timelines.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales and Sales Enablement teams.
  • High level of comfort working cross-functionally and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and prioritization skills.
  • Financial services or professional services experience strongly preferred.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Business Line Leaders and Sales teams view marketing as a strategic growth partner.
  • Marketing Managers are aligned, empowered, and executing consistently at a high level.
  • Enterprise marketing initiatives are clearly prioritized, well-executed, and measurable.
  • The firm presents a cohesive, differentiated marketing presence across private and institutional audiences.
  • The SVP, Business Line Marketing can operate at a higher strategic level, confident in executional excellence beneath them.

What We Offer:

Wealthspire Advisors is proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others.

The base salary range for this position is $100,000 – $120,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Wealthspire and You... Better Together!

Wealthspire is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Columbia, SC
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Reside within the greater metropolitan Columbia, SC area.

  • 2-3 years previous experience as outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.

  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Required Qualifications:

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on either a one to two-story roof.

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

** Please note, you will be required to attend 2-weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.

  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more. #LI-TW1

Skills

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Empathy, Multitasking, Working Independently

Compensation

Base compensation offered for this role is $65,000 - $105,000 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. Job Description

This role is responsible for investigating moderately complex and complex comprehensive personal liability (CPL) claims, including representative moderate and major CPL losses. Responsibilities include analyzing coverage, obtaining recorded statements, evaluating liability and damages, handling demands, issuing payments to appropriate parties, and negotiating settlements. Claims involving requiring additional expertise are referred to for further handling litigation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Negotiates and settles claims in accordance with business unit best practices.
  • Review policy language and analysis determine coverage.
  • Reviews of medical reports in preparation for claims settlement evaluation.
  • Coordinate the appraisal process for highly complex, disputed claims, ensuring adherence to policy provisions.
  • Determines and explains coverage limits in moderately complex and complex claims involving single or multiple claimants, also determines claim value.
  • Sets initial reserve, updates reserve, documents rationale and claim summary notes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for policyholder attorneys, leading direct negotiations to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Draft and respond to attorney correspondence, requests for information, and demands to maintain compliance and mitigate legal exposure.
  • Researches and responds to moderately complex and occasionally complex customer communications, concerns, conflicts or issues.
  • Summarizes documents and enters into claim system notes, documenting a claim file with notes, evaluations and decision-making process.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2 or more years of experience.
  • Adjuster License.
  • Strong negotiating experience and policy interpretation experience.
  • Experience handling third-party bodily injury claims arising from homeowners, renters, landlord, ATV, boat, and golf cart insurance policies.

Work Location:

Remote Home-Based Work:


This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States. This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington and Hawaii residents.

  • a home office a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions
  • a minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

As a condition of employment, you will be required to obtain an adjuster's license. Your manager will work with you along with the centralized licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Compensation Data:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designate Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

Candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Skills

Bodily Injury Claims, Complex Claims, Critical Thinking, Homeowners Claims, Information Collection, Multitasking, Negotiation, Third Party Claims, Time Management

Job Description

The P&C Actuary Lead Consultant job is responsible for executing and/or managing projects in support of P&C insurance reserving utilizing accepted actuarial and statistical standards, as well as methodologies and knowledge. This role works closely with reserving leadership and key business partners including Finance and Claims to evaluate reserve adequacy and volatility, monitor emerging loss trends, and lead the creation of a reserve narrative. Projects, responsibilities, and analyses will be of moderate to high complexity and support key business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provides thought and/or technical leadership, including contributions to improvement, development and innovation, and often serves as a subject matter expert
  • Plans, implements, manages, and/or contributes to projects that are moderate to high complexity and scale using accepted project management standards, with a high degree of independence
  • Uses best practices to lead and perform highly complex, high impact reserve analyses, using creative actuarial, statistical and/or predictive modeling techniques, including proper documentation and evaluation, as appropriate to inform business decisions
  • Leverages understanding of insurance business, claims operations, products, markets, and the broader economic environment to influence reserve reviews, business decisions, and communication strategy
  • Mentors, guides, and reviews the work of less experienced talent and improves the analytical capabilities of the team
  • Reviews, evaluates, and communicates appropriateness of reserving methodologies and results to leadership and business partners in a manner that is well understood and influence business decisions
  • Responsible for selecting, reviewing, using, and ensuring quality of claims, exposure, and financial data used to perform reserve analyses, reserve monitoring, and actuarial projections

Certifications

  • Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS) or Fellow of the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS)

Education

  • 4 year Bachelors Degree

Experience

  • 5 or more years of experience


Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Education & Experience (in lieu)

  • In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Seattle, WA
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster:

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will deliver exceptional service to our policyholders by traveling to customers' homes to perform on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly. You may also handle virtual claims using tools such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This role has a strong focus on water losses, as well as other perils such as minor fire, wind/hail, and miscellaneous property claims, ensuring customers receive expert guidance and resolution during challenging situations.

Youll use a mix of skills to succeed in this role, including:

  • Customer service: Delivering a compassionate, clear, and supportive claims experience.

  • Investigation: Assessing property damage, reviewing details, and determining coverage.

  • Communication: Keeping customers informed using phone, email, or video as needed.

  • Negotiation: Reaching fair settlements with customers, vendors, and other carriers.

  • Problemsolving: Using tools, resources, and critical thinking in a fastpaced environment.

  • Documentation: Maintaining accurate, timely records in the claims system.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in property adjusting, water mitigation, or independent adjusting, along with estimating.

  • Xactimate proficiency highly desired.

  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

Required Qualifications:

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

  • Residency within the Seattle Metro area is mandatory for this role.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

  • You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Wheeling, IL or Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

  • Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobTitle: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Represented, Moderate (OH/CT) Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster Moderate, and what it takes to do the job!


As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair and timely injury settlements with all parties involved.


***The ideal candidate will be able to handle a high-volume of pending cases and have experience with not only third-party casualty adjusting, but also first-party collision and third-party property damage claims.***


Candidates for this role must reside in the Eastern or Central Time Zones.


Qualifications

  • Prior represented third-party casualty claim handling experience is required
  • OH or CT claims experience highly preferred
  • 2-5 years of moderate Bodily Injury claim handling experience is preferred
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Proficient knowledge of insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination and state regulations.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite a plus


Youll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.*


**Candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.


This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.


Allstate Benefits

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit https://www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of an Inside Property Contents Adjuster: New York or New Jersey

  • You will be handling contents claims virtually.

  • Handle escalated claims files that have complex contents.

  • Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.

  • You will be using advanced video technology to collaborate with onsite vendors to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.

  • Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair and easy manner.

  • Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.

  • Coordinate with structure adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file.

  • Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Residency within New York or New Jersey.

  • Have 4+ years of experience using estimating software like Xactimate for complex contents estimating.

  • Previous experience handling property insurance claims.

  • Bachelors Degree.

  • Value providing an effortless customer service experience.

  • You enjoy the ability to work independently starting your day from home.

  • View problems and setbacks as opportunities for improvement and look forward to coming up with creative solutions.

  • Are organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

  • Are known for clear and professional communication both written and verbal.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$139,400.00 - $230,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

The Sales Executive Team is dedicated to navigating and managing a high performing sales culture in-person and/or virtually which contributes to the overall success of the Select business. The team executes on industry-leading sales strategies aligned with business objectives, builds effective relationships with customers, distribution partners and fellow employees, and creates tactical sales plans for profitable growth through extensive product knowledge and state of the art sales and influencing tactics. The team also uses digitally advanced strategies to move the business forward, leads the relationships with our aggregator/networking groups, and partners with the agent to imbed into higher producing revenue streams. As Sales Director, Select, you will lead a team of sales professionals within your agency assignments/territories to optimize growth within defined new business, retention and profitability goals and deliver success within Travelers' framework of Corporate values. You will have primary responsibility for sales strategy and business development within your agency assignments or territories and will act as a brand ambassador to sell the Travelers value proposition to distribution partners. You will be out in the field attending meetings and building relationships with agents who are in need of support while also supporting the SE and Sr SEs who are assigned to the territory. This position is an outside sales position where assigned distribution relationships within the geographic territory tend to be best served through an in-person sales strategy.

What Will You Do?

  • Select, train and manage a team of Sales Executives to develop long-term and short-term plans aligned with business objectives, achieve and exceed sales targets, and operate within Travelers' Vision and Values.
  • Coordinate sales planning and quarterly performance reviews.
  • Create an environment that fosters high performance, continuous learning, and proactive initative.
  • Oversee and influence a team responsible for developing and implementing advanced sales strategies to expand and manage territory, with the objective of driving profitable growth.
  • Own assigned territory, including development of business strategy, leveraging performance metrics to create annual plans and managing territorial performance.
  • Conduct high-level agency diagnostics to identify growth opportunities, facilitate strategic appointments, and nurture long-term relationships.
  • Proactively manage measures of point-of-sale success, sales plan effectiveness and customer satisfaction.
  • Ensure the prospecting, onboarding and establishment of performance goals for new agencies, while providing training and support.
  • Oversee in-person office visits to strengthen key partnerships.
  • Influence key agency partners through exceptional communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, such as, Product, Underwriting, and Operations to ensure alignment of sales strategies with broader business objectives.
  • Demonstrate the ability to build partnerships with other business groups to identify and initiate multiple product solutions at the account level.
  • Leverage expertise in competitor products and market trends to enhance organizational learning and identify opportunities, serving as a significant resource for competitive intelligence and distribution channel insights in the region.
  • Represent region or territory at agency council meetings and supports corporate agency management in handling strategic distribution relationships with key brokers and cross-enterprise resources.
  • Utilize thorough knowledge of Travelers' systems, platforms, and sophisticated data and analytics to guide strategic sales decisions, measure performance metrics and identify opportunities for additional products and services to maintain a balanced portfolio.
  • Analyze market, distribution channel and product offerings, identify gaps and strategic opportunities, and work with business partners to develop plan to increase market share and drive profitable growth.
  • Ensure team leverages AI technologies to optimize industry processes, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation, while continuously learning and adapting to emerging AI trends and tools.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in sales, marketing, business or related field.
  • Eight or more years of insurance marketing and sales or related experience in managing and growing a high-value book of business, developing and executing successful sales strategies, conducting comprehensive agency diagnostics, and utilizing advanced data and analytics proficiently.
  • Four or more years of experience in leadership and management of other employees.
  • Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC) (or willingness to pursue).
  • Expert knowledge of Travelers products and general Property & Casualty marketplace.
  • Exceptional influencing, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Proven ability to collaboratively build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Advanced skills in agency appointment.
  • Ability to set clear direction by defining goals and priorities and energize others to meet these goals in a timely manner.
  • Expert organizational skills to manage complex tasks and priorities.
  • Goal-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving sales targets and business objectives.

What is a Must Have?

  • Five years of professional sales experience within the Insurance Industry.
  • Two or more years of experience in leadership and management of other employees.
  • Must live in the territory that they manage and have the ability to travel up to 50% of the time.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job.JobTitle: Technician, Central Services - Universal Kids Resort (Back of House Maintenance & Repairs)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Construction & Skilled Trades, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the preventive, corrective, and annual maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Universal Kids Resort attraction ride vehicles. Responsible for following OEM specifications and requirements. Completes work orders for central services functions including the maintenance, welding, mechanical, creative fabrication, painting, fiberglass, hydraulics, and figure finish tasks to ensure proper show quality.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs disassembly and required repairs and replacements for mechanical components during annual inspections on ride vehicles using good engineering practices. Verifies all quality control and NDT requirements have been met prior to vehicle assembly. Assist in resort wide repairs on mechanical, electrical or plumbing systems.
  • Completes inspections and creates necessary work orders for discrepancies found in central services functions. Ensures materials inventory processes are being followed and align with technical procedures. Follows correct chain of command to notify Central Services Management when necessary.
  • Identifies mechanical system deficiencies and recommend immediate and long-term corrective action to decrease maintenance costs and decrease downtimes of ride vehicles. This process may require troubleshooting and referring to technical manuals, technical library and Maximo while utilizing a systematic approach.
  • Enters follow-up work orders for all discrepancies found in a timely manner. Documents all findings and work performed throughout the process of troubleshooting and performing repairs. Reports on labor in Maximo for all work performed. Demonstrates the ability to acquire skills in additional disciplines to support a broader range of operational and project needs.
  • Performs repairs to equipment due to safety, reliability, or show quality issues found during preventative maintenance to improve ride reliability and show quality. Performs modifications per engineering team, both internal and third party or OEM specifications.
  • Completes PQS qualification of assigned annuals. Trains new Technicians to do work orders, recovery procedures, and processes. Assists with seasonal weather condition sustainment initiatives as directed.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Must be willing to work varied hours, including evenings and weekends and to support seasonal maintenance initiatives.
  • Training is required and will be provided prior to performing the inspections.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Ability to work in a team environment.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION: 

  • High School Diploma or GED is required; Associates or Technical degree in related field is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years of experience with fiberglass repair/maintenance, automotive paint, mechanics, welding, hydraulics or general shop work and cleaning is required, experience with tools and small equipment required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
