Job.JobTitle: Sr. Director, Internal Consulting, Op Model Transformation
Job.JobDescription:
Job Description

We are seeking a Sr. Director of Internal Consulting to lead central initiatives for Aon. The role starts with building and carrying out a multi-year strategic overhaul of our Operating Model. Reporting to the leadership team of Aon Business Services (ABS), this role leads internal consulting and program management teams. It involves crafting, orchestrating, and scaling the transformation of the enterprise operating model at Aon. The goal is to improve how we deliver value to clients, colleagues, and other interested parties. This role will engage with senior leaders across Solution Lines, Regions, and Functions. It will also lead a cross‑functional group of internal advisors, project managers, and subject matter experts to deliver measurable performance outcomes.

This role is open to a Virtual or Hybrid colleague based in Central or Eastern Time Zone.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Vision

  • Partner with ABS leadership as well as business leaders, key collaborators, and cross-functional partners to advance the vision, objectives, and scope related to operating model transformation efforts
  • Translate strategic priorities into a clear transformation roadmap with defined business outcomes, benchmarks, and value realization targets
  • Apply structured consulting methodologies (e.g., problem framing, analytical reasoning, benchmarking, argument development) to advise recommendations
  • Develop and validate arguments for operating model changes, including financial, operational, and qualitative benefits

Operating Model Design & Alignment

  • Lead the end‑to‑end diagnostic, build and transition of the target operating model across Aon's Business Units, geographic areas, and departments
  • Translate enterprise strategy into detailed organizational framework components, including capabilities, organizational structure, roles and responsibilities, governance models, and cross functional interaction patterns
  • Be responsible for phased implementation, including pilots, scaling strategies, and stabilization, ensuring alignment with regional and solution line needs
  • Build and maintain operating model blueprints, ensuring all components (capability models, interaction models, RACIs, team structures, decision rights, important metrics) integrate across the enterprise

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior executives. Provide insight on opportunities, trade-offs, and risks related to the operating model. Ensure agreement and engagement in strategy and roadmap.
  • Shape and deliver a compelling change narrative that articulates the “why,” “what,” and “how” of the transformation for different audiences
  • Work closely with executive sponsors and the PMO to establish and maintain robust governance, decision‑making, and blocking issue mechanisms
  • Partner with Change & Communications teams to define implications of design changes, highlight required behavior shifts, and identify points of resistance or adoption needs
  • Facilitate executive and working‑level forums to align decisions, resolve conflicts, and maintain momentum

People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Recruit, develop, and mentor a high‑performing team members with capabilities in strategy, transformation, operations, change, and analytics

Posting Description

Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Summary:

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by helping employers develop healthier, more engaged, and resilient workforces while serving as a trusted strategic advisor. The role offers the chance to shape and influence the continued growth of a national consulting practice within NFP, an Aon company, collaborating with experienced teams across benefits, analytics, communications, compliance, and vendor management to address complex client challenges. In addition, you will contribute to the development of scalable tools, thought leadership, and consulting best practices that enhance client outcomes and strengthen the overall consulting experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead strategic wellbeing consulting engagements for mid-size and large employer clients, including discovery, planning, recommendations, and ongoing advisory support.
  • Design integrated wellbeing strategies that align health, emotional wellbeing, financial wellbeing, caregiving, culture, communications, vendor solutions, and benefits priorities.
  • Translate client needs, workforce insights, market trends, vendor capabilities, and program results into clear guidance for HR, benefits, finance, leadership, and account team partners.
  • Guide vendor strategy by supporting evaluations, RFPs, implementation planning, performance conversations, and ongoing accountability for client value.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative information to identify priorities, shape recommendations, evaluate progress, and tell a clear story about program impact.
  • Lead client projects and consulting deliverables with strong organization, ownership, follow-through, and readiness for client-facing interactions.
  • Collaborate with account teams, practice leaders, and internal subject matter experts to strengthen client relationships, support retention, and contribute to growth opportunities.
  • Develop and refine scalable resources, frameworks, presentations, and client-facing tools that support consistent national practice delivery.
  • Mentor colleagues, share expertise, and help raise the quality, consistency, and strategic depth of consulting work across the team.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced education, certifications, or professional credentials in wellbeing, benefits, HR, public health, or a related field are a plus.
  • Life and Health license strongly preferred, or willingness to obtain within first three months.

Core Competencies

  • Minimum 5+ years of related experience with health and benefits and/or wellbeing required.
  • Minimum 3+ years of employer wellbeing consulting experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience in employer wellbeing, health and benefits, health transformation, employee engagement, or a related consulting/advisory environment.
  • Experience supporting complex employer clients and advising internal or external stakeholders on program strategy, engagement, communications, vendor solutions, or measurement.
  • Strong working knowledge of the employer wellbeing marketplace, including emerging trends, vendor solutions, point solutions, engagement strategies, and integration with benefits priorities.
  • Comfort interpreting data, trends, client context, and partner feedback to develop thoughtful recommendations and practical next steps.
  • Strategic consulting judgment and ability to design practical, client-centered solutions.
  • Executive-ready communication skills, including strong writing, facilitation, and presentation presence.
  • Ability to influence through credibility, preparation, business context, and subject matter expertise.
  • Project leadership, organization, accountability, and comfort handling multiple priorities in a changing environment.
  • Strong listening, adaptability, emotional intelligence, and relationship management skills.
  • Market curiosity, proactive problem-solving, and ownership of work from concept through completion.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and AI, especially PowerPoint and Excel, with the ability to create polished client-facing materials.

Travel and Work Environment:

  • Hybrid role with periodic access to the Chicago office for collaboration, planning, and team connection.
  • Ability and willingness to travel periodically (25% of the time) for client meetings, internal collaboration, and practice priorities.

Job.JobTitle: Platform Consultant Cyber Platforms, Data, & Tooling
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

This role sits within Allstate Cyber Operations & Platforms as part of a set of Digital Product Teams responsible for building and operating a cohesive, scalable Security Operations platform ecosystem. This ecosystem spans:

Agentic Cyber Platforms (ACP): Operationalizing AI as a core cyber capability through shared platforms, orchestration patterns, and governance-by-design.

Security Data & Observability (SD&O): Engineering and managing the Security Operations Data Plane, enabling high-fidelity telemetry, analytics, and AI-ready data.

Tooling & Platform (T&P): Ensuring security tooling is integrated, governed, and aligned as part of a unified platform rather than disconnected solutions. Together, these capabilities enable secure, scalable, and intelligence-driven cyber operations by design.

The Platform Consultant defines and drivesarchitecture patterns, integration standards, and ecosystem strategyacross AI platforms, security data, and tooling. This role ensures the environment evolves as acoherent, reusable, and governed platform ecosystem, enabling safe, scalable adoption through well-defined paved roads.


You will translate operational intent intoenterprise-scale platform design, ensuring interoperability between AI systems, data platforms, and tooling while minimizing fragmentation and maximizing reuse.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Architecture & Standards

  • Define architecture, design patterns, and integration standards across AI, data, and tooling.

  • Establish APIs, data models, security controls, and observability requirements.

Data & AI Enablement

  • Ensure high-quality, structured data for AI (lineage, consistency, readiness).

  • Set standards for safe AI use (explainability, auditability, controlled actions).

Tooling & Integration

  • Design unified integration across tools and platforms.

  • Ensure tools produce consistent, high-quality, AI-ready data.

Paved Roads & Adoption

  • Build scalable, reusable solutions as the default (paved roads).

  • Drive standardization, reduce duplication, andguideadoption.

Strategy & Decision-Making

  • Lead build vs. buy vs. integrate decisions.

  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, andgovernance-driven.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner across teams (ACP, SD&O, T&P) for platform alignment.

  • Influence teams to drive simplification, reuse, and consistency.

Essential Criteria

  • A minimum of 5 years software engineering experience in at least 3 programming paradigms toinclude: a) Object-oriented (Java &JavaScriptrequiredand at least one other language) b) Procedural / systems (e.g.Go, Rust, C) c) Functional (e.g.F#, Elixir, Clojure, Haskell)

  • Experience using modern development tools (e.g., IntelliJ or VS Code, Git/GitHub, Spring Boot) and designing robust RESTful APIs

  • A minimum of 3 years hands onexpertisein architecting and delivering large scale distributed systems, such as cloud native microservices on Docker/Kubernetes, deployed on modern cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), ensuring scalability, high availability, and performance

  • Demonstrated success as a high impact technical advisor to multiple engineering teams, with proven ability to influence architecture direction and mentor engineers in best practices with proven leadership responsibilities.

  • Expert level knowledge of Agile/XP and DevOps methodologies, including paired programming, test driven development (TDD), and CI/CD automation, witha track recordof using these practices to accelerate delivery and improve quality

Desirable Criteria

  • Experience withagentic AI platforms, governance, and safe-action design

  • Familiarity withsecurity operations ecosystems and analyst workflows

  • Experience with:a) Telemetry and observability systems b) Data lineage, metadata, and data quality frameworks c) Canonical data models and analytics-ready datasets

  • Background intooling integration and platform standardization (golden paths/paved roads)

  • Experience aligningAI, data, and tooling strategies into a unified platform vision

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

Compensation offered for this role is 134,000.00 - 209,750.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the facilities maintenance of Universal Kids Resort buildings and designated areas. Completes specific work orders, installations, routine/preventative maintenance and repairs as assigned including, but not limited to, masonry, tile, pavers, cubicle partitions, furniture, scenic paint, roofing, and woodwork. Handles daily repair and troubleshooting tasks from Technical Services leadership. Completes special projects and other shop work as directed by Facilities Management to uphold show quality and standards. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Responsible for the maintenance and repairs for rough in carpentry to include, but not limited to, framing, sheet goods, wood decking and dock work as well as repairing wood metal stud work, and trim work including various moldings, turnings, laminate application, cabinet work, and window and door installation. Consistently provides routine/preventative maintenance in efforts to minimize the number of major repairs required, escalating to Facilities Management to address any major venue concerns when necessary. Ensures work area is clean and safe with tools and materials stored in designated storage areas and materials properly disposed of.
  • Performs routine inspection and maintenance of seating, furniture, restroom stall doors and partitions. Completes repairs and finishing to various walkways and roadways throughout the resort. Manages the preparation and painting of designated areas across UKR by determining color, mixing paint, prepping surface by cleaning, scraping, caulking, applying, putty, and sanding and applying paint. Maintains scenic aesthetic through painting techniques to include brushing, rolling, blending, spraying, and faux finishing based off of original creative intent.
  • Responsible for the installation and repairs to exterior finishes including, but not limited to Dry-Vit, EIFIS and Stucco. Fabricates tooling (molds) when multiple parts are needed. Maintains the roof surfaces of buildings, performs roof, gutter/downspout, window leak and other water infiltration repairs and preventative maintenance, and completes specific work orders for masonry, tile, pavers, and woodwork.
  • Installs and makes repairs to interior wall, floor tiles, coverings made of various materials, and to various commercial hardware, including but not limited to, door closures, panic hardware, mortis and cylindrical locks. Assists with creating, installing and removing specialized signage throughout UKR which may require the use of a High Reach to access.
  • Enters follow-up work orders for all discrepancies found in a timely manner. Documents all findings and work performed throughout the process of troubleshooting and performing repairs. Reports on labor in Maximo for all work performed. Demonstrates the ability to acquire skills in additional disciplines to support a broader range of operational and project needs. 
  • Completes preventative maintenance and show quality checks across the theme park. Trains new Technicians to do work orders, recovery procedures, and processes. Assists with seasonal weather condition sustainment initiatives as directed. 
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Previous facility maintenance experience is preferred.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of experience in general carpentry, construction, or roofing is required, experience within a seasonal/regional theme park is a plus; or equivalent combination of education and experience

Job.JobTitle: Actuarial Manager, Personal Lines Auto Analytics
Job.JobDescription:
Description

In this position, you will be leading a team whose mission is critical to both top-line and bottom-line performance. You will support profit, growth and operational objectives by providing external actuarial support for key filed product initiatives for the Personal Auto line of business, including state-level rate changes, targeted rate changes, and support of various new products and programs. This involves the initial submission of actuarial justifications, and continued verbal and written negotiations with regulators throughout the objection and approval process. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential for interactions both externally and internally.

In this role, you will perform analysis in pricing and product development and partner with various other functions such as state analytics, planning, rate revision, and countrywide rollout teams. In addition to state level assignments, we establish and promote subject matter expertise in areas such as various data sources and processes used within our group. The candidate will need to be able to provide data and analytical support for projects independently and be a thought partner to internal stakeholders.

**This role may have in-office requirements dependent upon candidate location.**

Responsibilities:

  • Provide actuarial support for state filings for rate and other new initiatives.
  • Lead team of five actuaries / analysts.
  • Provide analytical insight and recommendations to State Directors to inform business decisions.
  • Track state-level requirements for actuarial assumptions in filings and apply them appropriately.
  • Develop subject matter expertise which can be leveraged countrywide.
  • Own continuous improvement of processes to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness of external actuarial support that are quickly integrated in daily work routines.
  • Queries data for requests outside of base rate support and drive deep dives on an ad-hoc basis.
  • Communicate effectively with external regulators in writing and verbally, to support business outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; Masters degree preferred.
  • Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) or near-FCAS designation preferred.
  • 5-10 years progressively responsible experience, including supervisory experience.
  • Ability to foster teamwork and relationships across organizational line.
  • Knowledge of underwriting concepts including company/agency relationships' importance to the business success.
  • Written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to effectively express technical actuarial and statistical concepts to non-technical individuals internal and external to the organization.
  • Advanced decision making, problem solving and analytical skills.
  • Expands/maintains Actuarial professional knowledge through society (CAS/AAA) publications and meetings/conferences.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

What Is the Opportunity?

LOCATION REQUIREMENT: This field position services Insureds/Agents in the Salisbury, MD; Denton, MD and Dover, DE areas. The selected candidate must reside in the assigned territory.

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims. This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility. This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under direct supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Assess and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, including roofs, attics, crawl spaces, and other confined areas. Ability to carry, set up, and climb ladders weighing approximately 38-49 pounds.
  • May require extensive travel, including overnight stays, to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.

  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license.

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes.

This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

  • One year of auto physical damage appraisal or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

Are you a highly motivated individual with a passion for the latest engineering and manufacturing software trends including cloud-based solutions? Can you guide customers through complex digital transformations? Are you looking for a fast-paced high growth career?

If so, please apply for this outstanding opportunity at Siemens Government Technologies!


Our Customers …

Many companies are partnering with Siemens Government Technologies to build their Comprehensive Digital Twin; the virtual representation that gives them the capability of linking design and virtual simulations to physical engineering and manufacturing. Our customers are in the Federal and Aerospace and Defense Industries, where this technology gives them a competitive advantage. These customers are selecting Siemens Government Technologies because we have the comprehensive Digital Twin capabilities, available today – from concept through manufacturing into field maintenance.


Your Challenge …

Can you be a creative and independent domain specialist?

Become a member of our SGT Digital Solutions Outcome team as an Implementation Consultant for our Genesis Program. You will start by attending our June 2027 Genesis Program. Through this program, you will undergo 4 months of training that will provide you with the tools needed to contribute to customer projects. After completing the Genesis Program, you will begin working closely with customers to provide software solutions to help them realize their Comprehensive Digital Twin. Helping our customers blur the boundaries between industry domains by integrating the virtual and physical, hardware and software, design, and manufacturing worlds.


Responsibilities:

•Collaborate with industry experts to learn our best practices

•Core participant in estimating, planning, and scheduling deliverables, and tasks

•Play a key role in developing change initiatives for our customers to increase their efficiency and productivity

•Impact our customers' initiatives and business drivers

•Accelerate development in architectural design to fulfill customers' business requirements

•Provide support to control scope, cost, implementation, and quality

•Consult with users, management, and stakeholders



Requirements:

•Graduated from college with a degree in Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Fall 2026 or Spring 2027)

•University undergraduate with a minimum 3.0 GPA

•Exceptional communication skills

•Driven and self-motivated

•Strong technical leadership skills

•Ability to obtain Security Clearance

•Able to relocate if needed

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Senior Casualty Claims Consultant!

We currently have a great career opportunity for a Casualty Claims Risk Consultant. It is the responsibility of the Casualty Claims Risk Consultant to deliver tactical, client specific, casualty claims services on assigned accounts in support of Aon's core brokerage services. This position is for a workers' compensation professional; however, experience with auto and general liability, is a plus.

Work Style: Virtual work from Home.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

How this role is different

The general role of our Casualty Claims Risk Consultant is to:

  • Identify client exposures and provide customized casualty consulting services for clients to help them reduce their Total Cost of Risk.
  • Ensuring the highest level of service from claims administrator(s) and carrier partners.
  • Improve client claim outcomes by examining and analyzing key elements and related costs of their claims programs and build best practice-oriented approaches to claims cost containment.
  • Introduce appropriate Aon resources and provide project management to ensure commitments are met and results are achieved.
  • Establish project plans and budgets.
  • May require limited involvement in business development opportunities as dictated by geographic needs.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • Demonstrated expertise in workers' compensation claims management, with knowledge of casualty lines including auto and general liability, and a commitment to delivering exceptional client outcomes.
  • Strong relationship management and communication skills, with the ability to build trust, advocate for clients, and collaborate effectively with clients, carriers, TPAs, Account Executives, and internal partners.
  • Experience developing and executing strategic service plans, managing budgets, and delivering high-quality consulting services on time and in alignment with client objectives.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate claims data, identify trends, conduct claim reviews, and recommend strategies that improve claim outcomes and reduce total cost of risk.
  • Proven project management and process improvement capabilities, including managing multiple priorities, documenting action plans, applying best practices, and driving consistent service delivery.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, along with strong written and verbal communication skills and a commitment to continuous professional development.

Minimum qualifications and requirements

  • Proven performer with strong technical knowledge and work experience adjusting or managing workers compensation claims or possess multi-line claims experience with emphasis on casualty lines of coverage.
  • Retain proficiency as an insurance professional while maintaining clear and effective communication, both in writing and verbally.
  • Fluent in Microsoft office suite, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

Minimum education

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
  • Producer/Broker licensing may be required after hiring

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Healthcare Insurance Account Manager (Virtual)

Position Summary

The Healthcare Insurance Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management and administration of medical malpractice and healthcare liability insurance programs for healthcare organizations, physician groups, hospitals, healthcare systems, and individual providers. This role serves as the primary client contact for ongoing service needs, policy administration, provider roster management, regulatory compliance, and Patient Compensation Fund (PCF) enrollment activities.

The Account Manager partners closely with clients, brokers, underwriters, program administrators, and insurance carriers to ensure the accurate placement and maintenance of coverage while delivering exceptional client service and strategic program support.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned healthcare clients.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare administrators, risk managers, physician leaders, and executive stakeholders.
  • Respond to client inquiries regarding coverage, endorsements, enrollment requirements, and policy interpretation.
  • Conduct regular client meetings and participate in renewal strategy discussions.

Policy Administration

  • Manage the issuance, renewal, and maintenance of medical professional liability insurance policies.
  • Review applications, policy documents, endorsements, and binders for accuracy.
  • Coordinate policy issuance and delivery with underwriting and operations teams.
  • Assist clients with coverage changes and policy modifications throughout the policy term.

Provider Roster Management

  • Maintain accurate records of enrolled healthcare providers and entities.
  • Process provider additions, terminations, demographic updates, and coverage changes.
  • Validate licensure information and eligibility requirements.
  • Coordinate provider roster reporting and renewal submissions.

Patient Compensation Fund (PCF) Administration

  • Manage enrollment and renewal activities for applicable state Patient Compensation Funds.
  • Ensure compliance with state filing requirements and deadlines.
  • Calculate and reconcile surcharge payments.
  • Coordinate enrollment submissions with regulatory agencies and clients.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments impacting PCF participation.

Certificates and Evidence of Coverage

  • Issue certificates of insurance (COIs), evidence of coverage documents, and related materials.
  • Monitor client requests and ensure timely delivery.
  • Maintain certificate compliance and documentation records.

Financial Administration

  • Assist with premium billing inquiries and payment tracking.
  • Coordinate surcharge and regulatory fee payments associated with applicable state funds.

Compliance and Regulatory Oversight

  • Maintain working knowledge of healthcare liability regulations and state-specific professional liability requirements.
  • Ensure all enrollments, filings, and documentation comply with applicable laws and regulations.
  • Monitor provider licensure and credentialing requirements impacting coverage eligibility.
  • Support internal audit and compliance review activities.

Qualifications:

Required

  • Must have an active Property & Casualty Producer license.
  • 3+ years of insurance account management/producer experience.
  • Keen understanding of insurance terminology, policy structures, and underwriting processes.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and client service skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with healthcare providers, hospitals, health systems, physician groups, or captive insurance programs.
  • Knowledge of Patient Compensation Fund administration and state malpractice compliance requirements.
  • Experience working with agency management systems and policy administration platforms.

Core Competencies

  • Client Service Excellence
  • Relationship Management
  • Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking
  • Attention to Detail
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Project and Time Management
  • Collaboration and Teamwork
  • Written and Verbal Communication
  • Process Improvement Mindset

Success Measures

A successful Healthcare Insurance Account Manager will:

  • Maintain high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
  • Ensure timely and accurate policy administration.
  • Meet all state PCF enrollment deadlines and compliance requirements.
  • Manage provider roster changes with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients and internal partners.
  • Contribute to operational efficiency and continuous process improvement initiatives.

How we support our colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions for our colleagues as well.

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued.

Job Description

Posting Description

Who We Are:

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance who has also earned the WORK180 employer endorsement. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the world address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach! To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Summary of Role:

The Account Executive interacts with clients on a day-to-day basis while building and maintaining relationships with both client and carrier representatives. The Account Executive will prepare applications, specifications and marketing strategy for new business as well as the renewals of assigned clients with some degree of supervision and approval from their Supervisor. You will handle a book of business and take on the role of lead consultant and primary point of contact for your assigned clients. The Account Executive may have revenue goals and client retention targets.

This is a full-time role with the flexibility of a hybrid schedule from our Alpharetta, GA office. We will consider a remote option for other highly qualified and P&C licensed candidates, with experience in HNW market with established key carrier relationships. EST zone work schedule is required.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Negotiates terms, conditions, coverage limits and pricing with carriers and wholesalers.
  • Works with the Claims Department on relevant claims for assigned clients.
  • Responsible for accurate information such as updated exposures, driver information, reporting forms, signed endorsements and miscellaneous information to avoid any E&O claims.
  • Maintains a follow-up system to ensure policies, endorsements and other information is received to align with requests.
  • May direct job activities of the service team.
  • Cultivate and sustain effective relationships with carriers and clients through regular contact and client visits. Keep clients apprised of appropriate industry trends and events, including all state and federal regulatory issues.

Knowledge, Skills, and/or Abilities:

  • Excellent written communication skills – writes clearly; edits work for spelling and grammar; varies writing style to meet needs; presents numeric data effectively; able to read and interpret written information
  • Self-confident to make sound independent decisions
  • Ability to successfully interact with a variety of people/personalities
  • Strong leadership skills
  • Possess technical expertise plus good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to handle situations in a calm, courteous and professional manner
  • Strong attention to detail, decision-making skills and problem resolution

Education and/or Experience:

  • Typically more than 5 years of industry and product line experience
  • Recent High Net Worth Personal Lines experience required
  • Recent experience at a retail brokerage or independent agency required
  • Familiarity with major markets, such as AIG, Chubb/ACE, Cincinnati, Berkley One and PURE
  • Experience with Agency Management Systems; EPIC highly preferred

Certificates, Licenses, Registration:

  • P&C Insurance License required upon hire

What We Offer:

We're proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $70,000 – $100,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

Job Description

Product Security Engineering designs, builds, and operates enterprise security controls as software products that integrate directly into cloud platforms, the software development lifecycle, and core enterprise services. The organization applies modern software and cloud engineering practices to deliver scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly security capabilities that enable secure-by-default behaviors across the enterprise.

The Managing Engineer, Cloud Security Engineering is a hands-on engineering leader responsible for building and operating cloud security capabilities in production. This role combines people leadership, technical direction, and delivery ownership, including developing engineers, guiding architecture and design decisions, and ensuring the team delivers reliable, scalable, and effective security solutions. The Managing Engineer partners with digital product managers, cloud platform teams, application engineers, and security stakeholders to align priorities and integrate preventative, detective, and responsive controls into cloud platforms and developer workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop an engineering team delivering cloud security controls as software products, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development.

  • Set technical direction and drive high-quality execution across the design, implementation, deployment, and production support of cloud security capabilities.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through architecture and design reviews, technical decision-making, code reviews, and support for critical implementation work.

  • Own the reliability, performance, effectiveness, and continuous improvement of the teams products in production.

  • Partner with Digital Product Managers, platform teams, and engineering stakeholders to align roadmaps, priorities, dependencies, and delivery plans.

  • Build a strong engineering culture centered on modern delivery practices (test-driven development, pair programming), fast feedback, technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Translate complex cloud security needs into scalable engineering solutions, reusable patterns, and automated capabilities.

  • Lead effective agile execution while keeping the team focused on delivery outcomes rather than process or ceremony.


Essential Skills

  • 5+ years of professional software, cloud, platform, or security engineering experience, including ownership of production systems delivering measurable reliability, performance, or security outcomes.

  • 2+ years of experience leading and developing engineers through people leadership and hands-on technical guidance, including coaching, architecture reviews, design decisions, and code reviews.

  • Deep experience securing cloud environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including cloud-native services, architectures, and security controls.

  • Strong engineering proficiency with Python, Bash, Terraform, and cloud-native automation tools, with the ability to guide solution design, review code and infrastructure as code, and support the development of cloud security products.

  • Ability to translate security requirements and risks into scalable engineering solutions, reusable patterns, and automated controls.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex engineering initiatives, manage cross-team dependencies, and deliver measurable outcomes.

Desirable Skills

  • Designing or operating security controls embedded into CI/CD pipelines, developer workflows, or shared cloud platform services.

  • Familiarity with containerized environments, including Kubernetes and Docker, and the security considerations associated with them.

  • Proven ability to influence technical decisions and drive adoption of secure patterns, standards, and reusable capabilities across product areas.

  • Demonstrated success mentoring senior engineers and developing emerging technical leaders to strengthen long-term team capability.

  • Understanding of security and operational measures, such as control adoption, reliability, and risk reduction, used to evaluate engineering outcomes and guide priorities.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This role has supervisory responsibilities and serves as thefirst levelmanager for a team of engineers.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented/Litigation Bodily Injury Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

The individual selected for this role will join a team who primarily handles claims in the following states: Kentucky, Tennessee and/or Mississippi.

As a Represented/Litigation Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert you will live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator you will use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator you will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver you will utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder you will protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience handling represented third-party Bodily Injury claims.

  • Experience managing severe, complex, and litigated Bodily Injury claims.

  • Experience handling claims in Kentucky, Tennessee and/or Mississippi.

  • Extensive knowledge of Gross Tort Value and Risk Analysis, a plus

  • Experience using NextGen, Mitchell Decision Point, and Casualty Center, a plus

  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.

  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.

  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Remote Home-Based Work:

This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States.This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.

  • Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm CST.

When you work from home full time, youll need:

  • A home office a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.

  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.

  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).

  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented/Litigation Bodily Injury Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

The individual selected for this role will join a team who primarily handles claims in the following states: Texas, Louisiana, Arkansas.

As a Represented/Litigation Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert you will live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator you will use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator you will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver you will utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder you will protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

  • 3+ years of experience handling represented third-party Bodily Injury claims.

  • Experience using NextGen, Mitchell Decision Point, and Casualty Center, a plus

  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Job Description

This is a field adjuster role in Milwaukee, Wi area.

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on all property claims types, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

Previous experience in construction estimating or as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company

  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Job.JobTitle: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Represented, Moderate/Complex (NC/SC/AL) Remote
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster Moderate/Complex, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Represented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair and timely injury settlements with all parties involved.

***The ideal candidate will be able to handle a high-volume of pending cases and have experience with not only third-party casualty adjusting, but also first-party collision and third-party property damage claims.***

Candidates for this role must reside in the Eastern or Central Time Zones.

Qualifications

  • Prior represented third-party casualty claim handling experience is required

  • SC, NC, or AL claims experience highly preferred

  • FL, GA, NV, TX, CA claims experience also preferred

  • 2-5 years of moderate/complex Bodily Injury claim handling experience is preferred

  • Prior litigation claims experience a plus

  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.

  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.

  • Proficient knowledge of insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination and state regulations.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.

  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite a plus


Youll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.*

**Candidates who have previously worked for and are seeking to be rehired at Allstate and its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.

Allstate Benefits

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit https://www.allstate.jobs/benefits/ to learn more.

Skills

Business Communications, Critical Thinking, Demand Management, Fraud Investigations, Information Collection, Problem Solving, Time Management

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 53,500.00 - 84,625.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Pool Attendant is responsible for maintaining the cleanliness, safety, and overall presentation of the hotel pool area, including deck, towels, lounge chairs, restrooms, corridors, and other high-traffic guest spaces. This role plays a key part in in creating a welcoming and spotless environment for all guests experiencing Universal Kids Resorts onsite pool. Ensures that all pool areas are consistently clean, well-stocked, and guest-ready throughout the day.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Cleans and maintains all pool areas including deck, towels, lounge chairs, restrooms, elevators, and entrances to ensure a spotless and welcoming environment. Ensures the proper use of cleaning agents, equipment, and adherence to appropriate safety guidelines and procedures.
  • Responsible for the inventory, sorting, folding and distribution of towels. Monitors and replenishes pool deck and towel distribution area is fully stocked throughout the day. Transports soiled towels to hotel loading dock for third-party cleaning vendor collection while following all established procedures and safety standards.
  • Responds promptly to guest spills, trash, or cleanliness issues in pool area to ensure safety and guest satisfaction.
  • Works closely with the Front Office and Housekeeping team to support special requests or high-volume periods.
  • Reports maintenance needs, safety hazards, or damage in public areas to the appropriate departments. Collects lost and found items and delivers to Housekeeping Management for logging and storage in a timely manner.
  • Assists with light cleaning tasks in back-of-house or Team Member areas as needed.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Knowledge of basic cleaning procedures, chemical safety, and sanitation standards in a hospitality or public setting.
  • Ability to work independently and efficiently, follow cleaning schedules, and respond quickly to cleanliness and guest needs in high-traffic areas.
  • Experience in custodial, janitorial, or housekeeping roles preferred, especially in a hotel or resort environment.
  • Strong attention to detail, time management skills, and a positive attitude with a commitment to guest satisfaction.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ months of experience in janitorial, custodial services, or housekeeping is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Put your Insurance Experience to work – FROM HOME!

At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work. Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WAHVE

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We are passionate and determined about delivering the best customer service, preserving insurance industry knowledge, and making a difference by the work that we do.

WHAT WE ARE SEEKING

We have assignments available to help our insurance carrier or Third-Party Administrator (TPA) clients in Commercial Claims Adjuster or Examiner positions. Responsibilities include:

  • Handle General Liability / Bodily Injury, Property, Commercial Auto Liability and/or Physical Damage, Workers Compensation, Inland Marine, Professional / Management Liability, Business Interruption, Liquor Liability, Garage/Garagekeepers Legal Liability or Umbrella claims. Knowledge of any/all these lines is acceptable.
  • Set-up claim in claims management system.
  • Properly document claims files.
  • Review police reports, legal and medical bills, etc.
  • Litigation and Subrogation experience highly desired.
  • Set Reserves and draft Reservation of Rights letters – preferred.
  • Handle expense, indemnity, and vendor payments.
  • Conduct recorded statements from Insureds and Claimants.
  • Adjusters license a plus.
  • Current HIGH DEMAND for licensed NY Labor Law, Bodily Injury, Professional Liability, Medical Malpractice or Workers Compensation claim experience.

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE

  • 25 years of full-time work experience
  • 10 most current years of P&C commercial claims adjusting experience with insurance carrier or TPA

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT

  • Health insurance based on eligibility.
  • 401(k) with a 4% match based on eligibility.
  • Voluntary Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D).
  • Retire from the office but not from work.
  • Eliminate the office stress and the commute.
  • Choose the work you would like to do now.
  • Available in either full or part-time schedules.
  • Utilize your years of insurance industry knowledge.
  • Be part of our dynamic yet virtual team environment and connect with other experienced insurance professionals like yourself!

HOW TO GET STARTED

WE LOOK FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!
