Job.JobTitle: 2027 Early Careers: Summer Intern, Multinational – United States, Atlanta, GA & Miami, FL
Job.JobDescription:
AIG is reimagining the way we help customers manage risk. Join us as a Summer Intern in the Multinational department to play your part in that transformation with opportunities to learn and grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

About Us

At AIG, helping organizations and people discover new potential is our purpose. As a global risk leader, we do this for our clients every day. Through our deep expertise in their industries and our innovative solutions that help them smartly manage risk, we enable their growth in ways they never thought possible.

But we also do the same thing for our colleagues, because we know our people are our greatest strength – the source of every insight, every idea and every innovation. When we're working as one team to do what's right for our colleagues and our communities, we can achieve excellence together. We encourage colleagues to give back to the causes they care most about, supporting these efforts through our Volunteer Time Off and Matching Grants Programs.

Make your mark in Multinational

AIG's Multinational business is a dynamic area within General Insurance, helping clients navigate the complexities of operating across borders. As a trusted partner, we design and deliver tailored multinational insurance solutions that enable organizations to grow and manage risk with confidence around the world.

Working alongside a global network of underwriting, claims, legal, operations, and risk professionals, you will help implement compliant, seamless insurance programs that meet clients' evolving needs. Combining deep local market knowledge with global expertise, AIG Multinational delivers consistent, world-class solutions that help clients manage cross-border risks wherever business takes them

How you will make an impact

AIG's Summer Interns are immersed in the day-to-day operations of a fast-moving, global insurance company. During the 9-week program, you will gain valuable, hands-on experience and insurance industry knowledge, working with leaders on dynamic projects, with plenty of opportunity for challenges, learning and achievement.

Summer Interns join one of our key business teams, which offers a unique opportunity to obtain core technical knowledge and professional skills in a diverse environment. In addition to meaningful on-the-job experiences, interns will join instructor-led masterclasses, hear directly from senior leaders, and build meaningful connections through mentoring circles, networking events and volunteering.

Following completion of the internship program, interns may be considered for a role in the location where they completed their internship, with the Analyst program beginning in July 2028.

Responsibilities

  • Support the development and implementation of multinational insurance programs for clients operating across multiple countries and regions.

  • Collaborate with underwriting, claims, legal, operations, and other teams across AIG's global network to deliver coordinated insurance solutions.

  • Assist in reviewing client needs, program structures, coverage requirements, and local market considerations.

  • Coordinate with internal and external partners to help ensure programs are implemented accurately and efficiently across jurisdictions.

Minimum Qualifications

Our Early Careers programs are designed for students and recent graduates who are beginning their professional careers, generally within one year of completing their degree.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree to be received no later than June 2028 (unofficial transcript required upon application).

Program Requirements

  • Available for the complete Summer Internship Program from June 7 through August 6, 2027.

  • Summer Intern positions are in-person opportunities, requiring interns to work in the office at least four days per week.

Core Qualifications

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in a professional environment.

  • Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively, manage multiple priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preferred majors include Risk Management & Insurance, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, International Business, or a related field.

  • Bilingual or multilingual skills

  • Interest in global business, international markets, or cross-border operations

  • Cultural awareness and ability to collaborate with colleagues across different regions and backgrounds

Application Deadline

Applications will be accepted through October 31, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and we encourage candidates to apply early. We reserve the right to close this posting prior to the application deadline based on application volume.

For applicants in Colorado, Jersey City, and New York City the hourly pay range for this position is $25.78 - $28.64.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what's most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world's most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We're committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other's talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG's greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.

AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com.

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Strategic Communication Partner – Hybrid/In Person (Chicago, New York, Philadelphia, Atlanta, Denver, Phoenix, Los Angeles), or Virtual

As part of our Strategic Communication team within Aon's Human Capital business, the Partner in this role will be accountable for driving business growth, expanding client relationships, managing people, and enhancing market differentiation for our team and Aon. This role works with clients to develop communication and change strategies and high-impact creative communication in the areas of total rewards (compensation, benefits, and more), talent programs, and organizational change. This role can be on-site, virtual or hybrid, and will require travel.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Serving as a trusted advisor to clients, incorporating innovative communication, change, and engagement tactics in their HR, total rewards, and organizational change strategies
  • Leading client engagements and coaching project teams and external partners to develop and deliver innovative change communication strategies and solutions—while being willing and able to do the work, too (strategy, planning, advisory, content creation)
  • Owning multiple large-scale, complex client relationships and projects at once, across a variety of HR and total rewards topics, working both independently and collaborating with clients and Aon teams
  • Leading new business pursuits, expanding existing client relationships, and supporting strategic growth opportunities
  • Helping shape internal and external communication points of view and solutions, and translating emerging communication trends, such as AI, community building, and asynchronous communication, into practical tactics and opportunities
  • Building relationships with experts across Aon and partnering to shape innovative, market-facing approaches, offers, and solutions that integrate our communication expertise into Aon's broader Human Capital offerings

How this opportunity is unique

Our team works with leading organizations across a wide variety of industries to address their most challenging communication needs, helping their people feel connected, make better decisions, and adapt to changes big and small. In this role, you will have an opportunity to make an impact on our clients and their people right now, while also growing our team and shaping the future of employee communication.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 15+ years of experience in HR and total rewards communication, employee experience consulting, and related employee communication
  • Strategic change communication or change management experience
  • Proven track record in business development, client leadership, and revenue growth
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams
  • Excellent writing and storytelling skills, with subject matter expertise in compensation and incentives, performance management, total rewards, and other benefits programs
  • Behavior change acumen
  • Proficiency in using AI to enhance communication strategies and deliverables while maintaining strategic thinking, creativity, accuracy, client brand, and human voice
  • Ability to work in a collaborative, team-oriented, yet highly virtual environment

Required Skills: Strategic planning, talent management, team development, team management, training and development, brand management, business communications, business partnerships, campaign development, change management, client relationship management, communication management, consulting, content creation, content management, email marketing, marketing communications (MarCom), media relations, meeting facilitation, project management, public relations (PR), stakeholder alignment, communications strategy, business planning, conflict resolution, organizational leadership, organizational strategy, performance management (PM), and stakeholder management.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

The actual salary will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

A summary of all the benefits offered for this position:

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Job Description

Product Security Engineering designs, builds, and operates enterprise security controls as software products that integrate directly into cloud platforms, the software development lifecycle, and core enterprise services. The organization applies modern software and cloud engineering practices to deliver scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly security capabilities that enable secure-by-default behaviors across the enterprise.

The Managing Engineer, Data Security Engineering leads a team responsible for designing, building, and operating capabilities across DLP Policy, Data Intelligence, and Data Access. This role combines people leadership, technical direction, and delivery ownership, ensuring the team delivers automated, scalable, and measurable solutions that protect sensitive data while enabling appropriate business use.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-performing team accountable for engineering data security products and controls.

  • Set technical direction and drive execution across architecture, design, implementation, deployment, and production support.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through code and, solution design, key technical decisions, and critical implementation work.

  • Guide the engineering of capabilities across DLP Policy, Data Intelligence, or Data Access, including policy automation, data discovery and classification, and access controls.

  • Develop and advance policy-as-code workflows, reusable control patterns, detection logic, platform integrations, and automated testing and deployment.

  • Automate control lifecycle activities, including validation, configuration drift detection, reporting, alert enrichment, and operational health checks.

  • Own the reliability, effectiveness, adoption, and continuous improvement of the teams products and controls.

  • Translate complex data security requirements into scalable technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

Essential Skills

  • 5+ years of professional software, data, or security engineering experience, including ownership of production systems and technical products.

You will partner closely with analytics engineers, architects, data scientists, and product teams to transform complex data into business-ready information assets through effective data engineering, modeling, and governance practices.

The ideal candidate possesses deep experience in large-scale data processing, dimensional data modeling, and modern software engineering practices, including leveraging Agentic AI-assisted development tools to accelerate engineering productivity, code quality, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Develop andoptimizeETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, standardize, and curate data from diverse enterprise source systems.

  • Design and implement robustDimensionalmodels, including fact and dimension tables, to support reporting, self-service analytics, and business intelligence solutions.

  • Establish data quality, observability, and governance frameworks through automated validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting capabilities.

  • Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, and engineering standards that improve consistency anddeliveryvelocity across teams.

  • LeverageAgentic AI-assisted development capabilitiesto accelerate code generation, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and engineering productivity while adhering to enterprise governance standards.

  • Implement CI/CD pipelines andDevSecOpspractices to enable automated testing, deployment, release management, and rollback strategies.

  • Lead technical design reviews and provide mentorship to junior and mid-level data engineers.

  • Collaborate with data architects, business stakeholders, analytics engineers, and data scientists to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.

  • Partner with platform, security, privacy, and governance teams to ensure compliance with enterprise policies and regulatory requirements.

  • Drive continuous improvement across data engineering practices, architecture standards, and Agile delivery processes.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience as aData Engineer, building and supporting enterprise-scale data platforms and pipelines.

  • Strong hands-on experience withApache Sparkfor large-scale distributed data processing.

  • AdvancedproficiencyinPython,SQL, and modern data engineering development practices.

  • Experience designing and implementingLakehouse architecturesandMedallion Architecture patterns.

  • Strong understanding ofdimensional modeling, including star schemas, snowflake schemas, fact tables, dimension tables, and semantic data models.

  • Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, master data management, and data quality frameworks.

  • Cloud certifications or data engineering certifications in Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or related technologies.

  • Serve as a technical leader and trusted advisor for data engineering best practices.

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you willprovideexceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide,leveragingvarious platforms and software such as Xactimate andClaimsXVideo Collaboration. Yourexpertisewill be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'llwear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expertyoulllive into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you willaccomplishthat by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youllconfidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies todeterminecoverage.

  • The Effective Communicatoryoulluse phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process.Youllalso incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on theclaimprogress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants,in accordance withall legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solveryoullutilizemultiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, andadditionalsettlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorderyoullprotect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trainedin.Youllaccomplishthis by ensuringtimelyandaccuratedocumentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 2years'previousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Previousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Proficiencyin using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately andexpediteclaimssettlements.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

  • This position is not available for California, Alaska,Hawaiior Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch onaone to two-story roof.

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youreprovided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in yourday-to-daywork.

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

  • You willbe requiredto attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.

  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/orapplicableAppraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-onbonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership teamdeterminesthis based on annual work mileage for this location. You maybe requiredto use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as anAllstater,youllenjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Summit provides independent insurance agents and their clients with market-leading workers' comp insurance and elite customer service. We're growing and currently serve more than 7,000 independent agents and 31,000 policyholders across the South, Midwest, and Mid-Atlantic.

Our strength comes from a single-minded focus on workers' comp and a commitment to long-term customer relationships. Summit is who you turn to when you need a specialist who not only knows workers' comp but also gets to know your business and your priorities.

Our field team members are located in every state in which we operate.

Summit is a member of the Great American Insurance Group where our highest goal is for all employees to feel included, respected, and empowered to perform at their best.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

Summit's superregional growth continues. We currently serve 17 states. And in 2026, our expansion will include Pennsylvania, Delaware, Maryland, and Washington D.C., with Missouri and additional states to follow.

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities

  • The person in this role will work remotely in Missouri.
  • Develops strategic marketing plans, considering agency strengths, competitors, and market conditions.
  • Identifies and secures profitable new business opportunities in target markets and develops and implements strategic plans, resulting in a specified increase in market share.
  • Cultivates and maintains strong relationships with key agencies by providing tailored insurance solutions that meet their specific needs, leading to an increase in agency retention and satisfaction. Educates agencies on product features, market placement, and effective selling techniques.
  • Drives revenue growth by achieving or exceeding sales targets. May develop and execute cross-selling and up-selling strategies
  • Conducts market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats, informing strategic decision-making.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

#LI-Remote

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

Experience: Generally, a minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic business development, marketing, or a related role. Completion of or continuing progress toward certifications including Associate in Underwriting (AU), Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU), Certified Insurance Counselor (CIC), Program in General Insurance (INS) or Associate of Risk Management (ARM).

Proficiency in interpreting competitive data and industry trends. Ensures compliance with insurance laws and regulations, applying underwriting rules, guidelines, and rating manual standards. Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform decisions. Demonstrated decision-making ability and customer-centric mindset. SCI Summit Consulting, LLC

Job.JobTitle: Quick Service Associate - Part-Time - Universal Horror Unleashed
Job.JobDescription:
Universal Horror Unleashed is a terrifyingly unique experience that will bring haunts to Las Vegas year-round. Located at Area 15 is the heart of horror we would love to have you haunting alongside us! With the nature of this experience comes a unique working environment. You will find yourself working in dark environments around special effects including strobe lights, fog, artificial smells, and more. The working hours will be unique, typically spanning over late evenings/nights and weekends (holidays included). This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, and a variety of other discounts and perks.  

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for supporting the Food and Beverage operation including but not limited to operating the POS system, performing basic food preparation, providing exemplary guest service by greeting guests, helping with internal and external crowd control, and supporting mobile pick up. Assists with cleaning duties that include mopping floors, emptying trash, and wiping down tables and restocking condiments, bussing tables, and running food as necessary. Assists with the efficient flow of Team Member Dining for food and beverage orders, accurate pick-up dining process and queuing, and ensuring food station are properly stocked and maintained.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for basic preparation of light-bite food options, handhelds and/or preparation of food (i.e. operating fryers to handle fried food cooked on a timer or slicing meat carvings) for quick service locations within Universal Horror Unleashed.
  • Responsible for taking and filling orders of Food and Beverage requested by guests. Operates POS accurately and follows established procedures by properly processing credit card transactions, discounts, etc.
  • Supports Team Member Dining pick up by ensuring all food and beverage orders are correct, timely and all condiment stations are properly stocked and maintained. Assists with ensuring an efficient flow of dining options for Team Members during set pick up times.
  • Provides friendly and courteous assistance to guests while answering questions and directing guests within the venue. Maintains internal and external crowd control and line speed.
  • Assists with cleaning tables in the dining areas in an efficient and expedient manner. Maintain floors by sweeping and mopping. Empty garbage, stock and replenish condiment stand, and straighten chairs.
  • Ensures adherence to the Nevada State Liquor Statutes and food safety handling state requirements.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.
  • Must be able to obtain LVMPD Non-Gaming Work Card upon hire.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Must be familiar with various restaurant cuisines, basic menu offerings, dietary restrictions, and allergies. Maintains knowledgeable of the seating chart and manages the waiting list.

  • Welcomes and greets guests, accommodates guests with special needs, quotes wait times, maintains an efficient wait list, directs guests to appropriate waiting areas and takes reservations.  Escorts guests to table, reviews menu specials and provide guests with menus.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Underwriting Manager, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions
Job.JobDescription:
Description

With ride-hailing, on-demand delivery, and autonomous vehicles, options for transporting people and goods have never been so plentiful or presented so many emerging risks. Drawing on Libertys vast commercial and personal lines expertise, Liberty Mutual Mobility Solutions (LMMS) represents an underwriting model that brings a full range of tailored solutions and nuanced pricing approaches to the sharing economy and new mobility marketplace. This dedicated practice combines creative commercial underwriting with actuarial, product development, client, and claims teams to deliver a robust insurance experience. Join our expanding underwriting team to foster change and innovation and partner with brokers and sharing economy and new mobility businesses to help this segment grow and thrive.

As an LMMS Underwriting Manager, you will manage a team of underwriting professionals responsible for renewing and pursuing opportunities to achieve a balanced, profitable, and quality book while protecting company assets. In some cases, the accounts worked may be among the largest risk transfer opportunities or renewals in the company, with complex risk sharing structures and evolving coverage language.Responsibilities include risk assessment, coverage and pricing analysis, broker/partner communication and management, and industry thought leadership. This role requires strong analytical, communication, and negotiation skills in order to thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You will develop and maintain effective business relationships with internal and external partners. You will apply an advanced level of expertise and judgment to evaluate scenarios, data, and recommendations prepared by underwriters, actuaries, and or cross-functional partners and provide guidance for risk selection and acceptance, coverage, and price for casualty business in select sharing economy and new mobility sectors.

Responsibilities:

  • Leadership: Responsible for the retention, acquisition, and development of senior level underwriting talent. Formally manage, guide, mentor, and coach underwriters in both technical and professional skills. Foster an environment conducive to innovation, continuous improvement and product development.
  • Risk Selection: Responsible for developing and implementing a strategy to better evaluate risk quality and further underwriters skillset in qualifying, selecting and assessing sharing economy and new mobility risks. In addition to managing staff, may also be responsible for underwriting complex accounts.
  • Agent/Broker Relationships: Establish and maintain high level of relationship management with key Agents and Brokers. Develop underwriters technical, negotiation, communication and general deal making skills.
  • Portfolio Management: Evaluate portfolio performance based on profitability metrics, evolving risk scenarios, outcome and volatility ranges, reinsurance, opportunity metrics, and industry trends. Define UW team execution strategy and oversee execution of continuously improving portfolio in alignment with team objectives. Be the lead custodial of capital for your team.
  • Quality Audit and Account Review: Collaborates with the LMMS SUO and the OOU to ensure files meet regulatory requirements and internal documentation standards. Coach underwriters to articulate thought process, decision making within both account reviews and file documentation.
Qualifications

  • A minimum of 10 years progressive underwriting experience expected, including a minimum of 2 years of proven underwriting management experience, preferred
  • CPCU or professional insurance designation preferred
  • Proven analytical ability to evaluate high impact underwriting risks within scope of responsibility
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analyses and information
  • Demonstrated effective communication and interpersonal skills in dealing with internal and external partners required
  • Must possess the following skills, abilities and attributes: strong leadership skills, development of people, strategic thinking, sustained effective portfolio management and profitable growth, communications skills, decision-making skills, results-oriented, industrious, innovative, problem-solving skills, coaching and mentoring skills, and negotiating skills

We're focused on achieving profitable growth for US Retail Markets by building innovative products that meet evolving customer and agent needs, and we own the P&L for a niche but high-value part of the portfolio. This role will align to our Motorcycle, RV, Watercraft, and Classic Car products. Description

The North America (NA) Chief Reserving Actuary will lead the North America Reserving function. Position involves being responsible for the team performing thorough reserve analysis, maintaining reasonable and adequate reserves for this $20 Billion reserve base, clearly and transparently communicating results of reserve studies to key stakeholders, identifying elements of the reserve analysis that is particularly relevant to future business decisions by the NA business unit, effectively managing and leading a large team, and building strong relationships with business leaders and other key leaders throughout the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Provide an independent assessment of the NA reserves and associated reserve risks, ensuring the adequacy and accuracy of the NA reserves.
  • Ensure use of accurate, sound, and innovative approaches in projecting and setting reserving guidelines that are consistent with those of Global Risk Solutions (GRS).
  • Communicate the quarterly reserve analyses to the NA leadership.
  • Lead and develop a NA reserving capability that is technical and commercial-minded.
  • Be an inclusive leader committed to mentoring and developing team members to assume progressively senior actuarial and business leadership roles.
  • Provide proactive insights that are sought out by the business leaders.
  • Identify key trends, areas of uncertainty to monitor, and macroeconomic factors that are impacting the business.
  • Work in close collaboration with underwriting, pricing, claims and finance to develop a common view of the business.
  • Work in partnership with the various stakeholders to identify emerging trends that could impact results and propose corrective action in a timely manner.
  • Apply innovative approaches and leading-edge tools to analyze the business.
  • Ensure the quality of the data and its consistent application in the reserving process.
  • Foster a culture of technical rigor, transparency, and consistency.
  • Execute a governance framework that ensures that reserving guidelines are consistently applied and all processes comply with internal operational control requirements and all external regulatory and audit requirements.
  • Collaborate with the broader actuarial organization and other strategic business units to share knowledge and advance the business.
  • Seek opportunities to continuously improve and streamline processes.
  • Keep abreast of new reserving methodologies, trends and product/ tort reforms and other external issues.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • Insurance designations desirable
  • Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS) designation required, or comparable actuarial education/designation combined with relevant experience
  • Demonstrated expertise in financial management of a P&C business
  • Ability to participate effectively on the senior management team
  • Strong analytical skills with solid understanding of all casualty actuarial techniques, standards, and assumptions
  • Expert knowledge of insurance operations and P&C insurance business
  • Excellent management and communication skills
  • Strategic thinking and ability to set direction for team
  • Demonstrated ability to exchange ideas and convey complex information clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing
  • Demonstrated ability to anticipate areas of senior management concern, integrate different perspectives, and respond accordingly
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills required to establish and build effective relationships within and outside the organization
  • Ability to give effective training and presentations to senior management and other groups
  • Demonstrated ability to organize, lead, and get work done through others
  • Ability to develop staff and managers to support succession planning and address on-going talent needs
  • Ability to build and manage talent across the enterprise in conjunction with peers
  • Demonstrated ability to exert influence over senior managers, operating managers, and others on matters of importance to the SBU

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$67,000.00 - $110,600.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

This role is eligible for a sign-on bonus.

LOCATION REQUIREMENT: This position services Insureds/Agents in the San Gabriel Valley and Northeast greater Los Angeles area. The selected candidate must reside in or be willing to relocate at their own expense to the assigned territory. Ideal locations include El Monte, San Gabriel, Rosemead, West Covina, Covina, Glendora, Azusa, La Puente, East Los Angeles, Montebello, Burbank, Simi Valley, Santa Clarita, and surrounding areas.

As a Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will be responsible for managing, inspecting, evaluating, negotiating, and settling 1st party property claims in a timely and accurate manner which includes performing in-person inspections at customers' residences and properties to accurately assess damages. In this detail-oriented and customer-focused role, you will work closely with insureds and representatives to ensure claims are resolved efficiently while maintaining a high level of professionalism, empathy, and service throughout the claims handling process. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office. This position services a territory in <add location> areas of <add state(s)>. You must either reside in or be willing to relocate at your own expense to assigned territory.

What Will You Do?

  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under limited supervision. Typically, will handle personal insurance claims with limited supervision and higher authority and begin to handle business insurance claims with direct supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, and third-party vendors.
  • Investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for property damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilize as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates, with guidance from management.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, representatives, third-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Negotiate with multiple constituents, i.e., contractors or insured's representatives with guidance.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Assess and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, including roofs, attics, crawl spaces, and other confined areas. Ability to carry, set up, and climb ladders weighing approximately 38-49 pounds.
  • May require extensive travel, including overnight stays, to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Two years of property claim experience.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of property or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.

In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Job.JobTitle: Remote Construction Program Manager, Manufacturing Sector
Job.JobDescription:
Siemens Government Technologies (SGT) is a dynamic and rapidly growing organization, and we are seeking a self-driven individual to complement our growing team.


As a Siemens Advanced Manufacturing Sector Program Manager, you will lead and manage a cross functional program delivery team to scope, design, procure, install and commission an advanced, digitally integrated manufacturing capability. You will establish and communicate clear program priorities and program activities. This role is the primary point of contact to align the customer, stakeholders, and the multiple Siemens business unit delivery teams.

As part of the Advanced Manufacturing team, you will lead, guide and work with Facility (SGT) , Digital Software (DI-SW), and Automation (DI AUT) Project Managers, integrating their team's efforts to achieve a One Siemens result for the Customer.


Responsibilities:

•Manage the Anniston Advanced Manufacturing program through the Project life cycle, leveraging PM Siemens project management framework and the Siemens Delivery Framework

•Lead Program wide governance approach. Coordinate with scope specific Project Managers to execute project governance.

•Manage customer requirements and program scope to achieve program objectives, effectively coordinating project expectations with customers and stakeholders in a timely and concise fashion.

•Manage and combine individual subproject schedules into an integrated Master schedule, coordinating interdependencies between sub-projects to ensure on time delivery.

•Manage cross functional, multi-team configuration and deployment activities including software, industrial equipment manufacturers and Facilities experts. These team members will be coordinated to complete the design, procurement, installation, configuration, validation, and acceptance of the facility improvements and planned Manufacturing Capabilities.

•Work with third-party contractors to ensure overall program execution and success including site safety planning, material ordering coordination, and solution/system validation.

•Provide program management activities to control scope, cost, schedule, and quality across all sub elements.

•Define and execute required processes in alignment with stakeholders including appropriate communication to all levels. Lead Internal Steerco communication development and presentation with responsibility for results.

•Perform program quality management, ensuring that the solution meets contractual requirements and is to the appropriate quality and management compliance for industry or customer protocols, regulations, and standards.

•Perform program reviews and retrospectives regularly and present the results and lessons learned to the program and organization.

•Ensure the projects in the program are meeting the approved budget and agreed margin and are reviewed on a regular basis.

•Conduct Stakeholder meetings to manage and guide stakeholders through scope clarification, design review and installation activities

•Set the standard and maintain project artifacts such as status, risk, issues, opportunities (RIO), schedule or IMS, decision log, program management plan, safety plan, FMEA, CAP, or other artifacts as needed to support project rigor as required by customer, PM@ Siemens, or industry standards.

•Perform project risk management including planning, identification, analysis, mitigation planning and controlling to include FMEA and CAP as required.

•Confidence creating and presenting content to all levels of management, both internal and external.

•Coordinate difficult scope, cost, resource conversations with customers.

•Lead successful project closeout and successful user-acceptance and adoption of deployed project capability; or participated in customer witness tests or similar events, industrial equipment validation and start up procedures. Coordinate integration of all Systems

•Manage contract acceptance and handover of projects to the customer. Develop proactive closeout procedures to avoid extended on site durations.

•In conjunction with Engagement Management, identify, and create new opportunities and renewals for current projects/programs.

•Mentor and support the development of team members.

•Perform duties in compliance with SGT Project Management Standards.

Required Qualifications:

•Bachelor's degree from an accredited university/college in Engineering, Technology, or equivalent years of experience (8+) in technical fields of work.

•Eight to ten years in a project manager/leadership role, guiding a cross-functional team of project managers and consultants during significant facility or industrial equipment implementation.

•Eight to ten years of experience working in a US Federal Government customer-facing environment with a focus on USACE/NAVFAC Construction processes. Including US Federal Government projects, contracts, policies, procedures and quality and safety programs.

•Knowledge of Change Management processes.

•Product Scheduling experience with Critical path method schedules using MS Projects, Primavera or similar software.

•Demonstrated experience operating within an industrial setting such as a plant, shop, building infrastructure, shipboard, or other industrial setting.

•Proactive self-starter who can build a team to meet project delivery requirements, performing independently in high-pressure situations with little supervision.

•Leadership skills and proven track record of leading multi-disciplinary teams, including services

•Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

•Experience working with third party contractors.

•PMP Certification, with working knowledge of project management processes and tools is highly preferred.

•Experience building effective project teams from separate organizations, establishing program governance, organizational effectiveness and program data interchange.

•Use of Program/Project management software a plus.

•Experience implementing industrial equipment such as CNC machine tools, conveyers, PLCs, plant automation, manufacturing centers, SCADA, cabling, electrical, or other industrial infrastructure.

•Experience connecting cloud infrastructure with on-premise IT/OT networks

•Proven experience working with distributed, remote teams across multiple disciplines and time zones.

•Ability to promote complex solutions and drive acceptance with confidence.

•Working knowledge of using AI tools to support project management execution.

Travel:

•Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%

Security Clearance:

•Candidate must be US citizen and have the ability to obtain and maintain a US federal agency security clearance.

Our Siemens Grid Software team works to accelerate and secure the energy transition. We ensure a reliable, affordable energy supply in a decentralizing, decarbonizing, digitalizing, and all-electrifying energy world. No matter where power comes from or where it must go, we ensure it makes its way – every step of the way. Over 70% of the world's electricity flows through infrastructure planned or analyzed by Siemens Grid Solutions. This internship will allow you to work with experts in the energy industry who have developed the software, products, and services that electrify the world!


We are seeking qualified candidates for our Grid Software Internship Program as a Power Systems Technical Consultant beginning in May or June 2027. This Is a fully remote role.


You'll Make an Impact By:

  • Supporting the delivery of technical consulting solutions for industrial, commercial, and utility clients through power system analysis, modeling, simulation, and optimization projects.
  • Assisting in the modeling and simulation of electrical power systems using industry-standard tools such as PowerWorld, PSS®E, PSLF, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, and related platforms.
  • Analyzing system performance data and contributing to power quality, reliability, efficiency, and grid modernization initiatives, including exposure to energy automation and digital power system technologies.
  • Supporting the development of technical proposals, reports, presentations, and other client-facing deliverables.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to support project delivery and client engagements while staying current with industry trends, standards, and emerging power system technologies.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Energy Engineering, Energy Systems, or a closely related field and approaching completion of the required educational credentials for this opportunity.
  • Coursework and/or work experience in electrical power systems including generation, transmission, distribution, and protection.
  • Working knowledge of applications of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
  • Ability to work remotely full-time (40 hours per week) for the duration of the 12-week program.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship.
  • This internship is a structured experiential learning program for individuals currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree program who will continue their studies following the assignment. Current and continuing enrollment is a condition of participation. Applicants who have completed or expect to complete their educational program before or during the assignment period are encouraged to explore our Early Career Development Program opportunities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with power system simulation and analysis tools such as PowerWorld, PSS®E, PSLF, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, or MATLAB/Simulink.
  • Coursework or experience in power system analysis, protection, renewable energy integration, renewable generation, FACTS, or smart grid technologies.
  • Programming experience using tools such as Python, C++, or VBA for data analysis, automation, or tool customization.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, leadership, time management, and prioritization skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in diverse team environments.
  • Interest in sustainable energy, digital transformation, and emerging technologies within the power sector.

We are seeking a motivated intern to support SGT's Research, Development, Test & Evaluation (RDT&E) programs. This role provides hands-on experience with electrical distribution systems, sensor-based electronics, and engineering development activities. The intern will work closely with R&D laboratories to prototype circuits, integrate sensors, gather technical data, and assist in the execution of engineering projects.


Key Responsibilities:

• Assist in executing technical programs involving electrical distribution, protection, and control for low to medium voltage systems.

• Collect, organize, and analyze sensor data to support engineering development and system understanding.

• Develop basic signal conditioning systems such as filtering, amplification, and noise reduction.

• Prototype and test sensor based devices to ensure accuracy, reliability, and functionality.

• Build housings, fixtures, and component structures using CAD tools and rapid prototyping methods (e.g., 3D printing).

• Support RDT&E growth by collaborating with R&D laboratories on experiments, documentation, and iterative testing.

• Participate in requirement gathering discussions with technical leads and assist in proposing preliminary design concepts.

• Conduct basic research on market trends, emerging technologies, and competitor capabilities relevant to SGT programs.

• Assist with internal presentations, demonstrations, and technology reviews.

• Help prepare materials for industry events, technical conferences, and internal publications.

• Support brainstorming sessions related to innovative concepts and potential patentable ideas.


Requirements

• Currently pursuing a Bachelors in Electrical Engineering, Engineering Science, Physics, or related technical field.

•Programming Skills in Python, Solid Modeling and/or Circuit Design

•Hands-on experience with analog and digital circuit design and sensor integration

• Familiarity with MS Office and cloud-based tools such as SharePoint.

Sr. Fire Alarm Systems Design Leads create unique design solutions to meet specific customer requirements for commercial building fire alarm systems. This candidate will focus on data centers. This team member makes recommendations for productivity improvements and cost reductions to increase customer satisfaction and job profitability.


As a Fire Alarm Systems Design Engineer, you will:

  • Choose the appropriate mix of products and installation methods to provide the most cost-effective solution.
  • Prepare submittals and schedules; handle the ordering of products and equipment.
  • Participate in sales-to-operations turnover meetings to evaluate accuracy of the sales estimate and job layout.
  • Design fire alarm systems for buildings, including floorplan drawings for system device locations, riser diagrams, device wiring details, panel mounting and wiring details, bills of materials, and sequences of operations to meet the intent of the project plans, specifications, and contract documents.
  • Provide general electrical calculations, including battery calculations, voltage drop calculations, conduit fills, power supply sizing, etc. and prepare engineering re-estimates and follow up with appropriate sales and management to ensure understanding of and satisfaction with job scope.
  • Follow up with sales and management to ensure job scope, specifications, and schematics will meet customer needs and provide start-up and checkout documentation to the Project Manager for use in commissioning and validation.
  • Perform quality assurance; peer-review engineering documents and mentor, train, and direct the design activities of the engineering team.


You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or state-recognized GED
  • 5+ years of experience engineering fire alarm systems
  • Must be able to demonstrate:
    • Knowledge of engineering fundamentals of fire systems or equivalent field experience with fire system controls
    • Knowledge of the following fire alarm system components: fire alarm panels, strobe booster panels, spot detectors (smoke, heat, carbon monoxide), duct-mounted smoke detectors, projected beam smoke detectors, aspirating smoke detectors (VESDA), monitor modules, relay modules (form A and form C), manual pull stations, notification devices (speaker/strobes, horn/strobes, strobes, bells), Class A/Class B/Class X circuits, state and local fire codes, and NFPA 72 national fire code
    • The ability to read and interpret electrical circuit diagrams
    • Knowledge of fire alarm system components
  • NICET II- Fire Alarm Systems certification and ability and willingness to obtain NICET III within 1 years
  • 5+ years of proficiency in AutoCAD and design; proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate or Bachelor's Degree
  • Highly detailed oriented
  • Data Center design experience
  • VESDA Fire Alarm Systems experience
  • EIT, ASHRE, NICET III or IV - Fire Alarm Systems, or CISSP certifications

We are looking for a Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant to join Grid Software's Power Technologies International (PTI) team. PTI is our trusted advisor that takes a holistic approach, providing business advisory, technical consulting, and simulation software solutions. This role is critical to planning and integrating renewables, storage, large loads, and FACTS devices into the electrical grid. The Lead or Senior Power Systems Consultant will perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for Utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations, and energy asset owners to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations, while mentoring others on the team.

This is a remote position based in the contiguous U.S.

What you will be working on:

  • Performing and leading consulting engagements related to power grid analysis and design, system dynamics and transients, system interconnection, and grid code compliance.
  • Supporting and managing project execution, tracking project progress, and making necessary adjustments to maintain scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
  • Producing reports and presentations in collaboration with team members to communicate study results.
  • Maintaining relationships with clients to ensure satisfaction, analyzing clients' business requirements and identifying opportunities for further business.
  • Supporting and leading proposal preparation by developing project plans, budgets, and timelines.
  • Supporting technical reviews of ongoing studies and contributing to the mentoring and development of junior consultants.
  • Developing automation scripts to streamline repetitive tasks, reduce errors, and boost overall efficiency.
  • Delivering on-site consulting and training services.

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor's or postgraduate degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience performing transmission power systems analysis, with demonstrated ability to independently execute and interpret power flow and dynamic stability studies.
  • Professional experience with at least one of the following: electric utilities, ISOs/RTOs, developers, electrical utilities consulting company, or national labs, including work involving at least one of PJM, MISO, ISO-NE, NYISO, ERCOT, or SPP.
  • Experience analyzing power flow and dynamic stability using PSS®E, and experience with or working knowledge of at least one of TSAT™, TARA, PSLF™, or PowerWorld.
  • Working knowledge of NERC Reliability Standards and an understanding of RTO and other regional planning criteria, procedures, and practices.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and listening skills with demonstrated ability to write effective technical reports.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and internationally.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Prior relevant consulting and/or business development experience.
  • Experience in distribution planning, DER integration, or microgrids, and familiarity with or experience using CYME, Synergi, or OpenDSS.
  • Industry experience performing power system transient analysis using PSCAD™.
  • Experience leading studies, managing budgets and schedules, and mentoring or developing others professionally.

The Lead Account Executive serves as the primary relationship manager and trusted advisor for assigned clients, acting as the key liaison between client stakeholders and Assurant's cross-functional support teams. As an individual contributor, this role is responsible for managing a portfolio of MSO client programs, ensuring exceptional service delivery, client satisfaction, and long-term account growth.

Working closely with client leaders, the Lead Account Executive develops and executes strategic annual account plans, while coordinating day-to-day activities that strengthen partnerships, maximize program performance, and identify opportunities for expansion. This role proactively aligns internal resources and client objectives, drives issue resolution, and advocates for solutions that deliver measurable value to both clients and Assurant.

Success in this position requires strong relationship management, business acumen, and collaboration skills, with a focus on fostering trust, driving results, and contributing to the continued growth and success of key client accounts.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

Client Relationship & Business Management

  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for assigned clients, building and maintaining strong partnerships with key stakeholders and executive leaders to drive client satisfaction, retention, and long-term growth.

  • Lead strategic account planning by monitoring business performance, identifying growth opportunities, recommending program enhancements, and implementing solutions that optimize revenue, profitability, and operational effectiveness.

  • Conduct regular business reviews, analyze financial and operational metrics, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to clients and internal leadership.

  • Ensure service delivery commitments are met by proactively addressing issues, managing escalations, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive resolution and continuous improvement.

Compliance & Operational Governance

  • Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to implement business, regulatory, and compliance-related changes, ensuring adherence to company policies, contractual obligations, and applicable state and industry regulations.

  • Maintain the integrity of client business arrangements by overseeing accurate implementation and ongoing management of program requirements and operational changes.

Contract Management

  • Manage the full contract lifecycle, including negotiations, renewals, amendments, approvals, and issue resolution, while collaborating with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Sales, and executive stakeholders.

  • Ensure contractual terms are effectively administered and aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and client expectations

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in enterprise strategic account management and account development, with a demonstrated track record of building and expanding customer relationships, developing account growth strategies, driving revenue, and partnering cross-functionally to deliver business results.

  • Extensive knowledge of mobile and telecommunications products, services, and solutions is required.

  • Proven ability to lead and influence large groups, drive engagement, and achieve business results.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across various departments and organizational levels.

  • Highly adaptable and able to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment where priorities, direction, and resources may shift frequently.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Exceptional presentation, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex ideas to diverse audiences.

  • Mobile device program experience.

  • Direct experience managing mobile device trade-in and upgrade programs.

  • Reverse Logistics experience.

Job Description

The Office of the CISO Lead – Cybersecurity Operations & Engineering is a strategic advisor and operational leader within Aon's global security organization. The role drives execution, alignment, and organizational effectiveness across Cybersecurity Operations, Data Defense, and Counter Threat Engineering.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world! As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed

What the day will look like

Acting as an extension of the CISO leadership team, this leader partners closely with senior technology and business collaborators to translate strategic priorities into measurable outcomes, establish consistent operating rhythms, and ensure multi-functional initiatives are delivered with excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic execution: Translate CISO and cybersecurity leadership priorities into coordinated plans, measurable objectives, achievements, and accountable outcomes.
  • Operating cadence: Own executive planning, leadership governance routines, business reviews, portfolio checkpoints, and follow-through across Cybersecurity Operations & Engineering.
  • Portfolio and program leadership: Coordinate complex, multi-functional cybersecurity programs; manage dependencies, sequencing, resources, and delivery risk across multiple technical teams.
  • Executive decision support: Prepare concise briefings, dashboards, recommendations, and decision materials that enable timely, data-informed leadership action.
  • Performance and metrics: Work with Senior Leadership team to define and mature operational measures, key performance indicators, key risk indicators, and reporting routines that improve transparency and accountability.
  • Risk and issue management: Identify execution challenges, organizational risks, and critical dependencies; drive resolution or advance with clear options and recommendations.
  • Multi-functional alignment: Serve as connective tissue across security teams and collaborators including developers, infrastructure, and AI governance teams.
  • Operational readiness: Coordinate planning and readiness activities for global cybersecurity priorities, major changes, high-impact events, and evolving business requirements.
  • Organizational planning: Support workforce planning, talent priorities, budget activities, capacity management, and investment decisions across the organization.
  • Communications and engagement: Develop leadership communications, organizational updates, meeting materials, and narratives that create clarity, reinforce priorities, and support colleague engagement.
  • Continuous improvement: Establish repeatable operating practices, remove friction, and lead initiatives that improve delivery quality, organizational maturity, resilience, and efficiency.
  • Leadership priorities are clearly defined, sequenced, communicated, and consistently accomplished.
  • Executives receive timely, accurate, and decision-ready insight into performance, risk, investment, and delivery.
  • Multi-functional cybersecurity initiatives move faster with stronger ownership, fewer unresolved dependencies, and improved transparency.
  • Operating routines and metrics reinforce accountability, continuous improvement, and alignment across teams.
  • Cybersecurity Operations & Engineering demonstrates growing operational sophistication, durability, and measurable value to Aon.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 8 or more years of experience supporting CISO, CIO, technology executive, chief of staff function, transformation office, or enterprise security leadership team.
  • Experience working within a cybersecurity operations team or enterprise security team as a technical leader or leading security teams and programs.
  • Experience working across regions, cultures, and time zones in a matrixed global organization.
  • Significant leadership experience in cybersecurity, technology operations, engineering, enterprise program management, strategy, or a comparable complex global environment.
  • Proven success translating enterprise strategy into practical operating plans and measurable business outcomes.
  • Solid understanding of cybersecurity operations and engineering disciplines. Security operations, incident response, threat detection, threat intelligence, data protection, vulnerability management, identity, cloud security, and security platforms.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead large, multi-functional initiatives and influence senior collaborators across technical and business organizations.
  • Executive level proficiency in writing and speaking, including the ability to translate complex information into clear decisions, priorities, and actions. Data-driven mentality with the ability to use qualitative and quantitative insights to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and improve outcomes.
  • Experience developing executive reporting, portfolio governance, operating metrics, and performance management routines.
  • Exceptional judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive or confidential information. Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, global environment with competing priorities and ambiguity.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in cybersecurity, information technology, engineering, business, or a related field; an advanced degree is advantageous. Relevant professional certifications in cybersecurity, risk, program management, or technology leadership are beneficial.
