Are you passionate about shaping the future of power distribution and ensuring the reliability of next-generation electrical grids? Do you thrive on tackling complex engineering challenges and innovating at the forefront of DC system protection? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our dynamic team at Siemens Technology!

At Siemens, we're not just imagining the future; we're building it. Our commitment to innovation drives us to develop cutting-edge solutions for data centers, microgrids, and advanced MVDC/LVDC systems. As a Direct Current (DC) System Protection Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing robust protection architectures that safeguard these critical infrastructures.

Why Siemens?

  • Impactful Work: Contribute to projects that are revolutionizing energy distribution and sustainability.
  • Innovation Hub: Work with state-of-the-art technologies and collaborate with leading experts in the field.
  • Growth Opportunities: Siemens is committed to your professional development, offering continuous learning and career advancement.
  • Collaborative Environment: Join a diverse and inclusive team where your ideas are valued and your contributions make a real difference.

What You'll Be Doing (Your Responsibilities):

As a key member of our engineering team, you will:

  1. Architectural Design: Develop innovative Medium Voltage (MV) to Low Voltage (LV) integrated DC protection architectures tailored for critical applications like data centers, microgrids, and advanced MVDC/LVDC systems.
  2. Protection Scheme Development: Design, analyze, and rigorously evaluate DC fault detection, isolation, and interruption schemes to ensure optimal system resilience and safety.
  3. Advanced Studies: Conduct comprehensive DC short-circuit, fault current, and intricate protection coordination studies to inform robust system designs.
  4. Innovation: Develop sophisticated protection schemes for selective coordination and fault discrimination, and simulate AC-to-DC networks and protection devices using industry-leading tools such as PSCAD, MATLAB/Simulink, and other relevant platforms.
  5. System Validation and Testing: Develop and execute DC protection validation plans, including power-hardware-in-the-loop, controller-HIL, and laboratory testing for DC fault detection, protection coordination, fault clearing, converter interaction, and system-level performance under dynamic loads.
  6. Customer Project Support: Provide expert technical analysis and conduct thorough system design reviews to support our valued customer projects, ensuring successful implementation and performance.
  7. Thought Leadership: Contribute to the advancement of the field by generating patents, publishing technical papers, and actively shaping our technology roadmaps.

Qualifications:

  • Education: A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering is required. A Professional Engineer (PE) license or a Ph.D. in a related field is highly preferred and will be a significant asset.
  • DC Power Expertise: Strong knowledge and demonstrated understanding of DC power distribution systems, AC-to-DC networks, or DC microgrids.
  • Fault Studies & Coordination: Proven experience with DC fault studies and practical application of protection coordination principles.
  • Power Electronics Acumen: Working knowledge in power electronics, including familiarity with SiC MOSFETs, SiC JFETs, IGBTs, and GaN devices.
  • Simulation Proficiency: Hands-on proficiency with simulation tools such as PSCAD, PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, PSS SINCAL, or other relevant tools.
  • Testing Experience: Hands-on experience with high-power system HIL testing and troubleshooting power-electronic-based systems. Proficiency in RTDS, Opal-RT, or relevant tools.
  • Practical Experience: Familiarity with lab testing, hardware validation, and working with high-power electrical equipment is a plus.

Job.JobDescription:
Healthcare Mid Ticket Direct Originator, Siemens Commercial Finance

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

We are seeking a motivated Mid Ticket Direct Originator to join our Commercial Finance Healthcare Sales Team. The successful candidate will be responsible for originating, negotiating, and closing Mid-Ticket to lower Large Ticket Healthcare Equipment Customers in Florida. This role requires developed sales acumen, excellent organizational skills, and strong communication abilities in a fast-paced environment.

You will report to the Head of Sales of the Healthcare Finance team in the US. If you have a minimum of 10 years of equipment finance experience and are looking to take the next step in your career, apply and join us!

We are looking for a Healthcare Mid Ticket Direct Originator, Siemens Commercial Finance, and this is a remote position based in the state of Florida.

The Commercial Finance (COF) team is a business unit of SFS. We leverage our long-term relationship and technology know-how to create integrated financial solutions that complement Siemens as well as third-party vendors.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Identify and originate mid-ticket commercial equipment transactions
  • Maintain appropriate account information and an ongoing pipeline in our CRM.
  • Developing and growing relationships with healthcare providers across Florida.
  • Partnering with Siemens Healthineers sales teams to structure financing solutions that support customer objectives.
  • Identifying new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
  • Managing a portfolio of financing opportunities from prospecting through contract execution.
  • Building and maintaining a strong sales pipeline and accurate forecasts.
  • Collaborating with underwriting, operations, legal, and commercial teams to deliver customer-focused solutions.
  • Representing Siemens Financial Services at customer meetings, industry events, and executive briefings.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years' leasing/finance experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in account development, direct originations, or a similar role.
  • 10+ years of origination experience in the following equipment categories: Healthcare equipment and technology
  • 10+ years of experience with reviewing financial statements, leasing documents, and requirements.
  • Ability and willingness to travel, meet with clients/prospects, attend industry events and conferences, as needed.
  • Functional knowledge of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM systems.
  • 10+ years of experience with leasing pricing software such as Supertrump.
  • Must reside in the state of Florida.
  • Authorized to work in the US without the need for company sponsorship now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Strong problem-solving, organization, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
  • Ability to provide solutions and address customer needs.

At Farmers, we're not just known for unforgettable jingle – we're a team with a passion for purpose and making a real difference in people's lives. We deliver peace of mind when it matters most. Our results-driven, high-performance culture thrives on creativity, accountability and bold solutions. We tackle challenges head-on, learn from every experience and measure our impact on the customers who trust us.

Join an award-winning, equal opportunity employer, where you'll find more than a job – you'll find a supportive community. Enjoy competitive benefits, take part in meaningful volunteer projects, and help shape the future alongside talented colleagues across all backgrounds. At Farmers, helping others is at the heart of what we do.

Ready to make your mark? Discover our vibrant culture and explore career opportunities at www.Farmers.com/careers/corporate. Connect with us on Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok, and let's build something incredible together!

Workplace: Hybrid ( #LI-Hybrid ), Remote ( #LI-Remote )

Farmers believes in a culture of collaboration, creativity, and innovation, which thrives when we have the ability to work flexibly in a virtual setting as well as the opportunity to be together in person. Our hybrid work environment combines the best of both worlds with at least three (3) days in office and up to two (2) days virtual for employees who live within fifty (50) miles of a Farmers corporate office. Applicants beyond fifty (50) miles may still be considered.

Job Summary

Sales Trailblazer Wanted! | P&C licensed Sales Consultant | Uncapped Earnings + Career Growth

We're looking for sales-driven, enthusiastic experienced sales professionals to join our next classes of Sales Consultants beginning in November 2026.

In this role, you will respond to calls coming into our call center by positively promoting Farmers insurance products to prospective customers, consulting with customers to understand their needs, and selling those products which best fit the customer's needs. You may also make outbound calls to optimize sales potential. You will earn a competitive base salary in addition to monthly incentive earnings based upon your performance.

We provide a comprehensive paid training program, combining virtual classroom and hands-on learning with mentoring to ensure that you have the skills you need to succeed at Farmers. Ongoing coaching and training will remain a focus throughout your career to help you grow in your role and advance to new opportunities.

Join a team where your performance drives your paycheck! Our compensation package is designed to reward your success.

  • Our model includes guaranteed annual base pay of $40,000+ based on your experience.
  • A competitive benefits package PLUS an uncapped performance-based incentive, giving you the opportunity to increase your earnings on average up to an additional $27,300+ on top of the guaranteed base pay annually.
  • Many of our top performers who consistently meet and exceed their goals earn up to an additional $75,000+ on top of their annual base pay.
  • Experienced and licensed insurance sales professionals with 3+ years working in a competitive call center environment will be considered for higher salary grades - Senior or Lead sales roles, with starting annual base pay of $50,000+.

You'll thrive here if you are:

  • Self-motivated & goal-oriented – You set ambitious goals and chase them relentlessly.
  • Customer-focused – You build trust and tailor solutions with empathy.
  • Tech-savvy & adaptable – You navigate systems with ease and embrace change.
  • Coachable & curious – You welcome feedback and seek growth.
  • Accountable & reliable – You own your outcomes and show up ready.

If you're driven, competitive and ready to grow, this is the place to do it! Check out a Day in the Life of a Sales Representative!

You'll thrive in this position if you have:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a sales environment
  • Proven ability to meet quotas, metrics and goals
  • A drive to work in a fast-paced, high energy environment
  • Desire for a long-term career within the insurance industry
  • Proven ability to take initiative, solve problems, and prioritize tasks
  • Direct sales skills, and the aptitude to influence customers and close the sale
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; the ability to adapt communication style to each phone call, and explain complex policy and coverage information in understandable terms
  • Must be eligible to obtain resident/non-resident property and casualty license in all required states

Here's what you will accomplish as a member of our team:

  • Provide exceptional customer service and build strong relationships, while educating customers regarding coverages and cost so that the customer can select the most appropriate option

  • Navigate multiple computer systems while seamlessly interacting with the customer

Job.JobTitle: Travel Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Remote (Central or Mountain Time Zone)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration.

Candidates who live in Central, Mountain, Pacific Time Zones

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • Training will be Monday Friday and you will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX
  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

Schedule:

  • After training, Remote/Travel: 10 days on (include travel), 4 days off. Workdays range from 8 to 12 hours

Required Qualifications:

  • This field position requires up to 90% travel out of town
  • Valid driver's license
  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof
  • Must reside within a reasonable distance of a major airport to support the travel requirements of this role.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

  • 2+ years of experience preparing property estimates
  • Prior experience as a Property Adjuster
  • Proficiency with estimating software, such as Xactimate
  • Strong commitment to delivering exceptional customer service
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities
  • Proactive problemsolving skills with a positive, solutionoriented mindset
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask in a fastpaced environment
  • Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area will require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus

Job.JobTitle: Java Development Lead Identity Systems Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Lead Consultant typically provides expertise across all major functions in their area(s) of the business and delivers product features utilizing in-house and vended software, particularly web services and applications, by applying knowledge of the application functionality and client business processes. The person in the role creates technical and process designs and configures vendor and in-house software for new or existing complex enterprise-wide and business-unit applications and maintenance efforts. The Lead Consultant is also aware of roadmaps and understands how to navigate support processes and developer groups to gain insight and influence future direction.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Workforce Identity Lead Consultant to join our team. This role is ideal for professionals with developer experience who want to be at the forefront of designing and rolling out new automated access provisioning methods and tools. The candidate will be expected to work closely both with internal team members and other Identity teams to help provide a seamless experience for our customers. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting IAM solutions that align with Allstates security policies and business objectives.

***ALL CANDIDATES MUST BE IN THE CST OR EST TIMEZONES. NO EXCEPTIONS.***

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop overall product planning by contributing to stories for complex features in areas of responsibility, including guiding the story development for other team members who may be learning.
  • Organize, lead and finalize feature review sessions for complex business issues/requirements and document resulting decisions; provide coaching to less experienced team members on their features and delivery.
  • Create the functional design, using technical skills, to address complex business processes or issues or to address the requirements of a set of product features.
  • Configure or develop within vendor and in-house software; review and verify operation of new vendor or in-house release features. Use vendor and in-house defect resolution procedures and support tools to resolve issues.
  • Use knowledge of integrated requirements to evaluate proposed software products in line with strategic corporate and vendor direction.
  • Support the planning, conduct, and review of module and integration testing for all but the most complex projects.
  • Manage the issues and blockers for assigned features and stories.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve access related issues including reported problems to our applications, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
  • In partnership with the business groups and technical teams, provide knowledge and support for resolving technology issues in multiple areas of the business; acknowledged as a subject matter expert in multiple processes and applications.
  • Collaborate with various Product and Service teams to gather requirements and provide Identity solutions that meet performance, availability, capacity and resiliency targets for moderately complex systems.
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of Workforce Identity Roadmaps, bringing together business direction and infrastructure direction. Participate in review sessions with leadership.
  • Participate in audits and compliance activities by providing documentation and evidence of controls.
  • Provide visibility into current state performance and capacity through dashboards, reporting and review sessions with leadership.
  • Initiate tracks of work (ranked in priority) and ensure agreed timelines are met.
  • Provide projections of future capacity demand and identify potential recommendations for meeting projected demands, based on business and technology directions.
  • Participate in a rolling on-call rotation within the team.

Experience:

  • 5 or more years of developer experience (preferred).
  • Practical experience designing or operating security controls embedded into CI/CD pipelines, developer workflows, or shared platform services.
  • Java experience (preferred).
  • Python experience (desirable).
  • Experience of formulating and executing AD PowerShell Scripts.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex situations and provide actionable solutions.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

***ALL CANDIDATES MUST BE IN THE CST OR EST TIMEZONES. NO EXCEPTIONS.***

Skills

Active Directory (AD), Agile Methodology, CI/CD, Java Software Development, Microsoft PowerShell, Python (Programming Language), Python Software Development, Software Engineering

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 98,100.00 - 167,850.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating (Trainee) Los Angeles, CA
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you willprovideexceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide,leveragingvarious platforms and software such as Xactimate andClaimsXVideo Collaboration. Yourexpertisewill be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'llwear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expertyoulllive into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you willaccomplishthat by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youllconfidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies todeterminecoverage.

  • The Effective Communicatoryoulluse phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process.Youllalso incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on theclaimprogress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants,in accordance withall legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solveryoullutilizemultiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, andadditionalsettlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorderyoullprotect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trainedin.Youllaccomplishthis by ensuringtimelyandaccuratedocumentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • Previousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Experience providing customer service face-to-face. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to ensure exceptional customer interactions.

  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and efficiently manage claims.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

Required Qualifications:

  • Residency in/nearLos Angeles, CA is mandatory for this role.

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch onaone to two-story roof.

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youreprovided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in yourday-to-daywork.

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

Job Description

The Senior Claim Manager leads a Direct Claims team responsible for handling complex claims and latent injury exposures, including asbestos, pollution, PFAS, talc, and other long-tail matters. This role is responsible for strategic leadership, operational excellence, financial oversight, and team development to ensure high-quality claim outcomes, regulatory compliance, and alignment with business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and develop a high-performing team of claim professionals handling complex environmental, mass tort, asbestos, PFAS, and other long-tail liability claims.

  • Provide strategic direction on claim resolution, including coverage analysis, liability assessment, litigation management, reserving, reinsurance reporting, and settlement strategies for high-severity exposures.

  • Drive superior claim outcomes through sound financial stewardship, innovative disposition strategies, and a focus ontimely, effective claim resolution.

  • Oversee litigation and dispute resolution activities, including management of outside counsel, experts, consultants, and vendor partners.

  • Monitor claim performance, reserving accuracy, operational metrics, and emerging trends toidentifyopportunities for improved results and organizational effectiveness.

  • Partner with Legal, Actuarial, Reinsurance, Finance, and senior leadership to address complexclaimsand business issues.

  • Prepare and present claim strategies, exposure assessments, and operational updates to senior leadership.

  • Foster a culture of accountability, inclusion, continuous learning, and employee engagement through coaching, performance management, and talent development.

  • Build technical capability and succession strength within the team through coaching, knowledge transfer, and development planning.

  • Ensure compliance with claim handling standards, regulatory requirements, and organizational policies.

  • Leverage data analytics, technology, and AI-enabled tools to enhance decision-making, operational efficiency, and claim outcomes.

  • Identifyemerging claim trends and communicate potential financial, operational, and reputational impacts to key stakeholders.

  • Oversee third-party administrators and vendors to ensure contract compliance, service quality, and cost control.

  • Occasional business travel may berequired.

  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

  • 10+ years of relevant claims, insurance coverage, or reinsurance experience.

  • Proven leadership experience managing teams and direct reports.

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Advancedexpertisein environmental and mass tort claims, investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and settlement.

  • Strong knowledge of insurance,coverageinterpretation, and case law.

  • Deep understanding of claims processes, systems, and regulatory requirements.

  • Ability to analyze complex data, financial forecasts, and operational performance metrics.

  • Proficiencyin Microsoft Office, includingExcel, Word,andPowerPoint, as well asMicrosoft Copilot and AI-enabled technologies, withdemonstratedadaptability to new systems and tools.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership andpeoplemanagement skills, including coaching, mentoring, and team development.

  • Ability to influence and communicate effectively with senior leaders and diverse stakeholders.

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to translate complex issues into actionable solutions.

  • Proven ability to drive results, improve processes, and manage competing priorities.

Work Environment & Technology

  • Company-provided technology includeslaptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, and mouse.

  • Remote employees receive monthly connectivity reimbursement.

  • A dedicated, distraction-free workspace and reliable internet, withminimumspeeds of50 Mbps downloadand5 Mbps upload,arerequiredfor remote work.

Job.JobTitle: Manager, Security Systems & Investigations - Universal Kids Resort
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the protection, prevention, and recovery of company assets of Universal Kids Resort through the management of all operational activities related to loss prevention, investigations, e-Commerce including online ticket sales, and security systems. Provides leadership to all assigned Security Team Members, overseeing all shifts, including 3rd shift and non-operating days, and overseeing Loss Prevention educational and awareness training programs. Serves as a key partner to UKR Leadership as well as Frisco law enforcement, setting security standards in accordance with legal requirements and Universal Destinations and Experiences (UDX) standards. Oversees UKRs Command Center that supports resort-wide emergency management, communications, operational and technical downtimes and assigning support while aligning to UDX standards and procedures. Maintains a state of readiness in the event of an emergency and interfaces with UKR Leadership to identify resources, establish contingencies and develop training for emergencies and operational business continuity.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for the oversight for all operations of loss prevention, investigations, and security systems to ensure the protection and recovery of company assets. Manages the efficient and seamless operation of UKRs security systems of multiple video surveillance systems to ensure the safety of all Guests and Team Members. Partners with UDX Security and Digital & Technology to ensure all repairs and replacements are completed in a timely manner. Oversees operational budgets and coordinates financial reporting and the acquisition of technical resources and equipment.
  • Manages Universal Kids Resorts Command Center and dispatchers responsible for regular business as well as critical, operational communications, specific emergency incident notifications and updates, maintaining all critical internal and external emergency resource contact profiles, and maintaining the operational readiness of the Command Center. Oversees the planning and execution of resort-wide emergency management and communications, ensuring UKR leadership and all Team Members are notified according to established policies and procedures. Ensures alignment and timely communications across the theme park and hotel for emergency management initiatives.
  • Responsible for the hiring, training and development of leadership team. Directly oversees the Assistant Managers while leading coaching and mentoring hourly Team Members by providing feedback on performance. Ensures management team is meeting all objectives and accountabilities. Drives and executes plans for Security team that directly affect Team Member satisfaction (TSAT), Guest satisfaction (GSAT), and safety standards while utilizing existing tools to measure and monitor performance against targets. Develops appropriate action plans to achieve or exceed targets.
  • Reviews investigative theft and policy violation cases and assists with preparation of prosecution; conducts interview training and assists in undercover surveillance; plans, coordinates and schedules special operational VIP or dignitary protection details. Develops reports and summaries for leadership review of trends or results to support initiatives that detect, deter, respond to and recover company assets and reported loss.
  • Acts as a liaison between local, State and Federal Law enforcement agencies and other third-party agencies or vendors. Collects and assesses any relevant intelligence that may affect UKR operations or assets. Manages the partnership with third party civil recovery companies to ensure the successful recovery of restitution owed to the company due to theft. Acts as a liaison to industry counterparts and professional security associations.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Supervises an Exempt team

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.
  • Must be able to work a flexible and varying schedule based on business needs.
  • A background check is mandatory, and results must meet Universal Kids Resorts background check criteria.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Ability to compute rate, ratio and percentage; and to draw and interpret bar graphs and spreadsheets.
  • Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Required to successfully attend and pass all recurring mandatory/legal licenses and certifications as a condition of employment.
  • Wicklander & Zulawski interview/interrogation certification is preferred.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in a related field is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security or Investigations required, 3+ year of supervisory experience is required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Risk Control Consultant Boiler and Machinery
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$73,900.00 - $122,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Reports to Boiler and Machinery Field Manager. Conduct boiler and pressure vessel inspections in accordance with jurisdictional rules by performing thorough examinations, identifying hazardous conditions, applying appropriate codes and standards, and recommending corrective actions. Work cooperatively with Boiler and Machinery underwriting and claim groups, in support of helping them make informed decisions to maximize profit and growth. Primarily performs boiler and pressure vessel inspections on all accounts. Under close supervision, performs risk evaluations and claims investigations on less complex accounts as assigned. Participates in individual training opportunities to enhance/develop risk control and product/service knowledge.

What Will You Do?

  • Maintain a consistent field presence, spending approximately 20% - 50% of the time onsite with customers. Traveling to customers may entail long-distance, overnight travel, and/or multi-night trips depending on the needs of the business and alignment with territory and/or geography.
  • In this role, works with limited guidance and direction to manage jurisdictional inspection workload within an assigned territory. Take ownership of the territory and effectively prioritize, plan, and schedule work. Utilize provided technology resources for maximum efficiency. Respond to customer requests and helps customers understand and mitigate risks associated with equipment breakdowns.
  • Conduct boiler and pressure vessel inspections in accordance with jurisdictional rules by performing thorough examinations, identifying hazardous conditions, applying appropriate codes and standards, recommending corrective action and submitting required reports.
  • Under moderate supervision performs less complex risk evaluations, evaluate exposures and controls, develops meaningful loss estimates, and communicate findings to business partners.
  • Apply critical thinking to determine adequacy of controls preventing equipment breakdown, and overall insurability. Investigate less complex Equipment Breakdown claims as requested by the claim department. Evaluate elements of the breakdown, extent of damage, invoice review, and cause of loss.
  • Effectively document, communicate, and report findings.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in related field.
  • Technical Skills.
  • Demonstrates a basic level of understanding of mechanical and electrical principles.
  • Possesses a basic knowledge of predictive and preventive maintenance practices.
  • Demonstrates specific engineering/technical skills necessary to achieve established business goals.
  • Utilizes Risk Control workstation computer system applications to efficiently manage territorial workload, schedule and complete all job assignments.
  • Customer Service.
  • Identifies customer needs and takes appropriate action to meet those needs.
  • Acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to delivering an appropriate level of customer service.
  • Problem Solving.
  • Develops new methods or approaches to getting the work done.
  • Evaluates information and makes the right choice (decision).
  • Is resourceful in gaining information/resources to solve business problems.
  • Interpersonal Skills.
  • Results driven and takes responsibility for own decisions and actions.
  • Manages own work and seeks help as necessary.
  • Works independently and in a team environment.
  • Establishes and maintains effective work relationships.
  • Communication.
  • Clearly expresses ideas.
  • Listens to and understands what others are saying.
  • Shares information and maintains confidentiality.
  • National Board of Boiler and Pressure Vessel Inspector's Inservice commission.
  • Military Boiler or Nuclear Power operator certification.
  • Civilian Power Boiler Operation Certificate.
  • ANSI NDE Level II Examiner Certification.

What is a Must Have?

  • Two years of experience in the boiler and machinery industry or a related field, such as plant engineering, power generation, manufacturing operations or maintenance, or relevant military experience.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • Must obtain an Inservice Commission (IS) from the National Board of Boiler and Pressure Vessel Inspectors within six months of employment.
  • Must have or be able to attain appropriate certification to meet state-specific requirements, where applicable.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

As part of the Siemens Government Technologies Services management team, the Digital Solutions Business Manager leads a team of Operations and Sales Support Specialists in support of the total DS portfolio. This leader will be responsible for ensuring that the Siemens Government DS team is able to focus on best-in-class Sales and Services by coordinating and reporting on all aspects of the business activities.


This leader will also define and implement business process changes to improve the level of overall financial success, information consistency, contract compliance and team efficiency across the DS portfolio.


The following are primary tasks for this leadership position:

•Manage a team of Operations Specialists to provide business and contract Operations support for Services setup and delivery

•Manage a team of Sales Support Specialists to provide contract support for Software sales and maintenance delivery

•Develop strong business relationships with the key business stakeholders both internal and external to Siemens Government

•Develop strong business relationships with the key customer stakeholders in support of their overall Siemens investment value

•Oversee, support and ensure the consistent high quality of new opportunity development tasks including financial planning and proposal development

•Ensure the development of business metrics and key artifacts across the DS accounts portfolio

•Drive the monthly creation and review of routine financial reporting and escalations

•Lead the training and documentation of best practices and policies across the DS Business Management team

•Monitor the key business performance indicators (KPIs) to identify and address issues early with leadership stakeholders

•Work closely with the Finance team to ensure smooth and compliant business transactions across the DS portfolio

•Work closely with the partner Finance teams to ensure smooth and compliant business transactions through intercompany and 3rd party transactions

•Review team performance and provide on-going opportunities for development and growth



Requirements:

•Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance or equivalent years of experience in Government contracting or a related field

•Minimum of four (4) years in Project coordination or administration experience or equivalent Project Support Experience

•Three (3) years of experience working in a customer-interfacing environment

•Three (3) years of experience with Defense and/or US Federal Government projects, contracts, policies and procedures

•Working knowledge of the administration functions of the Services business including project setup, contract structure, progress reporting, revenue recognition and billing

•Experience in identifying and implementing cost savings measures within services projects

•Leadership skills and proven track record of supporting multi-disciplinary teams, including services delivery and project management

•Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

•Excellent written and verbal communications with the ability to present complex issues to multi-level audiences of company and government executives with a sense for urgency

Who are we?

Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.

By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.

Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy.

Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us!

We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Head of Product for Grid Planning to lead one of our most strategically important domains.

This role carries a dual mandate: to build on Siemens' decades-long legacy as a global leader in grid planning software, and to define what the next generation of planning solutions must become. The grid is fundamentally changing — driven by renewable integration, bidirectional power flows, and the rise of distributed energy resources — and utilities need planning tools that match this new reality.

You will set the product vision, own the roadmap, and work across engineering, UX, sales, and customer teams to deliver solutions that help utilities operate with greater confidence, efficiency, and resilience. This is a senior role with real strategic influence and visible impact.

This is a remote role based in the Central or Eastern U.S. Time Zones

You'll make an impact as you:

  • Define the product vision. Own the multi-year grid planning roadmap, grounded in deep customer understanding and aligned with Siemens' platform strategy.
  • Stay close to customers. Engage regularly with RTOs, ISO, utilities, and other industry stakeholders to surface genuine user needs and validate product direction before committing to build.
  • Drive the next generation of planning. Evolve our portfolio toward cloud-native, AI-augmented, and platform-integrated architectures — without sacrificing the analytical depth utilities rely on.
  • Shape the ecosystem. Define integration standards and API strategies that position Siemens Grid Software as the preferred platform hub for utility digital transformation.
  • Lead cross-functionally. Align engineering, UX, sales, and services around a clear and shared product direction. Drive prioritization with rigor and transparency.
  • Represent Siemens externally. Contribute to industry discourse at key events and customer forums as a credible voice in grid planning and utility technology.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic qualifications:

  • Solid knowledge, credibility, and vision on how Power Utilities plan and operate their networks.
  • Experience building or scaling SaaS products, ability to create products that strongly leverage AI to build value.
  • 10+ years in product leadership and critical-thinking roles with a proven record of designing & scaling technology products.
  • Bachelor's degree required, with a focus in business administration, finance, business informatics preferred.
  • Ability to travel minimum 50% (domestic and international)
  • Strong communication skills in business-proficient English and interculturally competent and proven track record of managing global multicultural teams.
  • Must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers.

Job.JobTitle: Commercial Counsel Arity Advertising and Marketing - Remote (IL, CA, NY)
Job.CustomJobTypeName: IT / Technology, Legal, Marketing / Communications / PR
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join Our Team as a Commercial Counsel Arity Advertising and Marketing.

Were looking for a creative, collaborative, and high-energy attorney who thrives at the intersection of law, business, technology, and data. This role sits within the Business Law division of Allstates Law and Regulation department and offers the opportunity to counsel Allstates mobility data and telematics business unit (Arity), advising its marketing solutions business on a wide range of commercial agreements, product counseling and related matters.

Key Responsibilities:

This position is ideal for someone with expertise advising in the advertising industry and who brings strong business acumen, embraces complexity, and enjoys partnering with cross-functional teams to navigate legal and regulatory challenges in innovative and evolving areas.

You will:

  • Provide real-time, strategic legal counsel on a wide array of business matters, including product development, marketing, sales, and emerging technologies.
  • Structure, draft, and negotiate commercial agreementsespecially those involving advertising, marketing, and data service arrangements.
  • Advise on legal risk management and evolving regulatory landscapes in areas such as technology, commercial contracts, privacy, and consumer protection.
  • Contribute to enterprise-wide strategies by collaborating across business units, policy, compliance, and legal teams.
  • Anticipate legal issues and offer practical, innovative solutions in fast-paced and dynamic business environments.
  • Conduct in-depth legal research and help assess the impact of emerging laws or regulations on business activities.
  • Help foster alignment between business goals and legal frameworks in regulated industries.
  • Navigate ambiguity with confidence and help shape emerging business models and opportunities.
  • Contribute to a culture of open dialogue and collaborative problem solving across a distributed, virtual team.
  • This is a remote role with travel required. While the position is open to remote candidates across the U.S., preferred home office locations include Chicago, IL; New York, NY; or San Francisco, CA due to team collaboration and business travel considerations.

What a Typical Day Might Look Like:

  • Partnering with product teams on a new technology within mobile applications, drive technologies etc, rollout or exploring a novel corporate structure.
  • Synthesizing insights from multiple legal experts to offer business-focused guidance in plain language.
  • Drafting complex data licensing agreements or leading the negotiation of commercial deals.
  • Leading the implementation of a compliance or risk mitigation plan in collaboration with other departments.

What Were Looking For:

  • Were proud to work alongside a team of talented, mission-driven professionals. Were looking for someone who:
    • Thrives in areas of law that are emerging, complex, and continually evolving.
    • Brings process-building skills and a desire to drive efficiency.
    • Contributes creative solutions and innovative thinking.
    • Balances both legal rigor and business pragmatism.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This job does not have supervisory duties over individual contributors, contractors, consultants, and temps

Education and Experience:

  • Juris Doctorate and active bar membership in good standing
  • A minimum of 7 years of legal experience, ideally within a law firm or the in-house legal department of a mid- to large-sized organization.
  • Proven expertise in one or more of the following areas: commercial law, privacy, advertising/marketing law, technology, artificial intelligence, intellectual property.
  • Experience working within a corporate parent company and across a family of affiliated entities.

Desired:

  • Experience supporting a commercial business unit and/or professional experience beyond traditional legal roles.

Key Competencies & Functional Skills:

  • Strong leadership capabilities with a focus on collaboration, team development, mentoring, and strategic guidance.
  • Executive presence with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experience managing departmental or legal budgets.
  • Solid project management skills, including the ability to prioritize and deliver across multiple workstreams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and other relevant legal or business technology tools.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
  • Demonstrated discretion and professionalism in handling sensitive and confidential information.
  • High business acumen, including the ability to assess and communicate legal risk in a commercial context and contribute to the development of business cases and return-on-investment evaluations.

#LI-PC1

Skills

Advertising Technologies, Artificial Intelligence Software, Artificial Intelligence Techniques, Cloud Software, Commercial Sales, Contract Agreements, Contract Negotiations, Counseling, Data Privacy, Digital Advertising, Marketing, Mobile Applications Design, Privacy Act, Privacy Compliance, Privacy Laws, Strategy Development, Transactional Sales

Compensation

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Lead the Business. Shape the Strategy. Drive Growth.

At Allstate, we're looking for a strategic and entrepreneurial leader to serve as the Senior Manager, State Manager, overseeing the performance and growth of assigned states. In this role, you'll operate as the "CEO of the State" with end-to-end accountability for executing and delivering SSPG (segmented, sustainable, profitable, growth) objectives while balancing customer needs, market dynamics, risk management, and business objectives.

This is an opportunity to influence critical business decisions, partner with senior leaders across the enterprise, and help shape the future of our product, pricing, and risk management strategies. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex business challenges, and are passionate about leading teams and driving results, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

1. Own State Strategy, Performance, and Business Outcomes

Serve as the business owner for assigned states, accountable for long-term growth, profitability, customer retention, and market position.

Own state performance by establishing strategic priorities, developing and executing plans, monitoring results, and continuously refining strategies to achieve growth, profitability, customer value, and risk management objectives.

Maintain a deep understanding of market trends, customer behavior, business drivers, regulatory environments, and competitive dynamics to identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and inform business decisions.

Lead the evaluation and implementation of product, pricing, underwriting, risk management, and distribution initiatives to achieve state objectives.

Serve as the primary business liaison with state regulatory bodies, partnering across functions to support filings, approvals, and regulatory engagement that advance state business objectives.

2. Lead Cross-Functional Execution and Enterprise Influence

Drive alignment and execution across multiple stakeholders to successfully deliver business results.

Build strong partnerships across Product, Actuarial, Legal, Claims, Finance, Distribution, Marketing, Operations, Technology, and other key stakeholders to advance strategic objectives.

Develop data-driven business cases and recommendations that influence decision-making and support state and enterprise priorities.

Lead cross-functional initiatives from strategy through implementation, aligning resources, managing dependencies, and ensuring successful execution.

Navigate competing priorities, influence stakeholders with diverse perspectives, and build alignment around critical business decisions.

Collaborate across business channels and organizations to maximize customer value, business performance, and enterprise outcomes.

3. Build Organizational Capability and Drive Continuous Improvement

Strengthen team effectiveness, foster innovation, and create a culture focused on ownership and results.

Lead by example coaching, mentoring, and developing talent to build a high-performing organization, strengthen leadership capabilities, and prepare future leaders.

Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, trust, innovation, continuous learning, and ownership that empowers teams to achieve business objectives.

Challenge existing assumptions, encourage data-driven decision-making, and identify opportunities to improve business processes, operational effectiveness, and customer outcomes.

Champion continuous improvement by promoting experimentation, knowledge sharing, and adoption of best practices across teams and functions.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of experience in insurance, product management, pricing, risk management, analytics, or a related business leadership role.

Proven ability to lead complex business initiatives and drive measurable results.

Strong financial acumen with experience interpreting P&Ls, business performance metrics, and market trends.

Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and gain alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

Experience leading and developing high-performing teams is a plus.

Skills

Accountability, Business Leadership, Business Performance, Business Results, Business Strategies, Influencing Others, Leadership, Product Management, State Management, Strategic Management, Strategy Development

Compensation offered for this role is 134,000.00 - 209,750.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will investigate and evaluate homeowners property claims from start to finish. You will confirm the facts of loss, determine coverage, assess damages, and negotiate settlements within your assigned authority. In this role, you will manage the entire claim lifecycle, including supplements, Additional Living Expense (ALE) claims, contents, and personal property losses. You will work closely with customers, contractors, and other partners to ensure claims are handled accurately and efficiently.

A key part of this position is delivering excellent customer service through clear, timely communication, keeping customers informed and supported throughout the claims process.

We are seeking an experienced Field Property Adjuster located near Hollis Center, ME/ York County or within a 1 hour radius. With proficiency in Xactimate and a strong foundation in claims handling, including supplements, ALE, contents and full claim ownership. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, a proactive approach, excellent customer service, and the ability to adapt in a fastpaced environment. Experience handling claims in both field and desk settings is strongly preferred. Holds an active adjuster license or possess a license that qualifies for reciprocity in the applicable states is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities

Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on the most complex 1st party homeowner losses of all severities

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers

Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files

Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

Recommends process improvements


Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.


Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designation

People who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Skills

Analytical Thinking, Communication, Insurance, Insurance Claims, Negotiation, Payment Handling, Property Claims, Relationship Building, Xactimate

Job.JobTitle: Territory Sales Manager (Southern Louisiana) - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Territory Sales Manager is responsible for consistently exceeding agreed upon new business production, direct written premium, and loss ratio goals, and other KPIs on an annual basis by effectively managing the agents of an assigned market to increase company market share by driving profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Position is responsible for product/user integration with industry technology and comparative rating platforms within market and assigned agencies

Positions and promotes full suite of National General Insurance products into Independent Agency Partners to include, multiple personal auto products, homeowners, commercial vehicle, flood, and recreational vehicle & key focus on household package coverages (based on state availability)

Develops and maintains the assigned markets new agency appointment pipeline, supports National Accounts & Alternative Distribution Initiatives to implement corporate agreements at the local market level with large Independent Agents driving package product growth & coach new TSMs

Consults with IAs by having a strong knowledge of the independent agency channel, including industry competitors, major brokers and national industry associations to gather market intel to help promote and position National General products and/or make market enhancement to align with industry opportunity

Delivers on the business units annual execution plan (growth, profitability, agency engagement, new appointments) for their market with focus on household package coverages under the guidance of a Regional Sales Manager and/or Director.

Role uses full suite of production data and reporting to identify trends, capitalize on opportunity and regularly address agency level performance including training / skill gap to execute on business plan, educating on package products to drive agency growth

Collaborates with IAs to assist with creation of agency-specific short term and long-term strategic business plans, periodically reviews and suggests adjustments as necessary to achieve results

Collaborates with Product, Pricing, Operations to perform stakeholder (agency) and risk analysis on market related issues

Territory Sales Manager handles increasing the quote and issuance flow of assigned market beyond the rate and underwriting trends filed and implemented in the market

Key company liaison within assigned market to both independent agencies and industry associations and must be field facing 4 days per week, driving key business initiatives, maintaining accurate records of these sales activities, client interactions, and follow-ups in CRM software


Candidates must reside in the Southern Louisiana area.


Education

4 year Bachelors Degree (Preferred)


Experience

5 or more years of experience (Preferred)


Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.


Skills

Client Relationship Building, Consultative Sales, Insurance Product Knowledge, Sales, Strategic Collaboration

Compensation

Base Salary: $90,000 - $105,000 plus incentives based on performance

Job.JobTitle: Inside Auto Claims Adjuster - West Zone
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Inside Auto Claims Adjuster is responsible for investigating basic and occasionally moderately complex auto insurance claims. This role may handle non-represented claims and requires evaluating coverage, determining liability, and negotiating settlements. The adjuster works directly with claimants, insureds, and other involved parties to ensure timely, accurate, and customer-focused claim resolution.

To support business and operational needs, candidates selected for this role must reside in one of the following states at the time of hire: AZ, ID, NV, CO, OR, MT, UT


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Investigate minor to moderately complex auto accidents and prepare clear, concise claim summaries.
  • Conduct recorded statements with claimants, insureds, and witnesses.
  • Evaluate auto claims to determine coverage, liability, and damages.
  • Negotiate and settle claims in alignment with established guidelines and best practices.
  • Maintain detailed and well-documented claim files, including notes, summaries, and decision rationale.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support efficient and customer-centric claim handling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of prior claim handling experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with solid critical-thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable using technology and learning claims-related software and tools.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington, and Hawaii residents.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters license in multiple markets.

  • This role offers a $1,000 sign on bonus if you have an active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state.
  • Current employees and former employees seeking rehire at Allstate or its affiliated companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

The Paralegal Specialist provides paralegal support for specific a practice area under limited attorney supervision. This role is to support the Arity Legal Counseling team within Business Law.

This individual serves as subject matter expert regarding contracts workflows and processes, contract templates and drafting, legal research and contract signing processes. The Paralegal Specialist proactively identifies, summarizes, and monitors relevant issues.

This role also manages intake of new matters and gathers matter related documents for the attorney to analyze and assists with contract preparation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage intake of new matters, review commercial contract deal sheets, enter new matter data and complete contract templates based commercial parameters provided

  • In a highly efficient and effective manner, serves as a subject matter expert when conducting legal research and transactions while possessing a high degree of competency in online legal research tools and transactional logistics
  • Independently determine if additional research is needed
  • Maintain corporate records and archives, in accordance with records retention requirements
  • Proactively identify and summarize relevant issues while continually monitoring them and updating the attorney with recommendations, as appropriate
  • Review new and proposed legislation and determine applicability
  • Gather matter related documents for the attorney to analyze

Education

  • Applicants must meet the regulatory and qualification standards applicable to the paralegal profession in the state where work is performed; OR an equivalent combination of education and a minimum of five (5) years of relevant paralegal experience.

Minimum Requirements & Experience

  • 4+ years of paralegal experience with a corporate legal environment
  • Experience supporting multiple attorneys within a high volume fast-paced legal environment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of corporate and/or compliance processes
  • Demonstrated expertise utilizing Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint
  • Extensive experience leveraging Microsoft 365 to support collaboration, communication, and workflow efficiency
  • Proficient in Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools

Professional Competencies

  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate professionally and effectively with attorneys and other team members
  • Highly self-motivated, resourceful, and proactive with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize work effectively and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through skills, ensuring accuracy and timely completion of assignments.
  • Proven collaboration and relationship-building skills with the ability to work effectively across legal teams and business partners

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties

Work Environment/Location & Travel Expectations

  • This position is primarily remote.
  • Minimaltravel may be required based on business needs, training sessions or team events, within Chicago, IL; Dallas, TX, Charlotte, NC; OR Scottsdale, AZ.
