Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Chicago, IL
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, you will be dedicated to providing exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 4-5 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 in losses.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access roofs with up to a 6/12 pitch.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youre provided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day to day work.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

** Please note, you will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Consultant II AI/ML Engineer - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

Company: National General

  • National General Insurance is an Allstate company, meaning it operates under the Allstate umbrella while maintaining its own brand identity and specialized insurance products
  • This relationship allows National General to leverage Allstates resources, technology, and financial stability while continuing to serve its customers with tailored insurance solutions.
  • Employee benefits same as that of Allstate US Corporation employees

About the Role


This role supports high-impact AI and data automation initiatives focused on improving data ingestion, transformation, and mapping processes across the organization. This position is responsible for advancing AI-assisted data mapping capabilities to reduce manual effort, enhance accuracy, and deliver scalable, maintainable solutions for development teams.


Initial responsibilities include building and optimizing intelligent import tools that leverage AI/ML techniques to parse, normalize, and validate structured and unstructured data from various sources. Core deliverables involve developing mapping logic, identifying data discrepancies, creating standardized ingestion templates, and producing load-ready outputs for downstream systems. The role also contributes to analytics and dashboarding efforts while supporting source-specific data rules and configurations.


Over time, the scope will expand to broader AI, data-layer, and automation initiatives aligned with evolving business priorities, with a strong emphasis on delivering solutions that improve operational efficiency and overall data quality in high-visibility workflows.


Key objectives: Reduce manual mapping effort, improve data accuracy and processing efficiency, deliver scalable, maintainable AI-driven pipelines


What Youll Do

  • Design and build AI-powered data pipelines to process and transform structured and unstructured data (PDF, Excel, CSV, etc.)
  • Develop and optimize LLM-based solutions (prompt engineering, mapping, extraction, and transformation)
  • Translate complex data and technical outputs into actionable insights for business stakeholders
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, business SMEs) to define and deliver solutions
  • Validate and improve solution accuracy through testing, iteration, and stakeholder feedback
  • Support integration of ML/AI solutions into enterprise systems and workflows (APIs, databases, cloud platforms)
  • Document solutions to ensure scalability, maintainability, and long-term adoption

How your day to day looks:

  • Analyze and process carrier and CMS datasets
  • Build AI/ML mapping logic using LLMs and prompts
  • Develop data pipelines (Python/C# data processing logic, SQL, APIs, Azure)
  • Validate outputs against expected results with business stakeholders
  • Troubleshoot accuracy, performance, and edge cases
  • Document pipelines and ensure production-readiness
  • Support integration into enterprise systems (C#, APIs, Azure)


Work Mix (exact mix will shift by project phase)

  • 40% ML/prompt and mapping logic
  • 35% data engineering / pipeline implementation
  • 25% stakeholder collaboration and validation

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of related experience

Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Large Loss Field Property Adjuster, you willprovideexceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide,leveragingvarious platforms and software such as Xactimate andClaimsXVideo Collaboration. Yourexpertisewill be particularly focused on fire & water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'llwear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expertyoulllive into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you willaccomplishthat by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigatoryoullconfidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies todeterminecoverage.
  • The Effective Communicatoryoulluse phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process.Youllalso incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on theclaimprogress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants,in accordance withall legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solveryoullutilizemultiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, andadditionalsettlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorderyoullprotect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trainedin.Youllaccomplishthis by ensuringtimelyandaccuratedocumentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 4yearspreviousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.
  • Experience handling claims with multiple trades and over $100,000 inlosses.
  • Proficiencyin using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately andexpediteclaimssettlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

Required Qualifications:

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license wheninstructed toby the licensing team. Byproceedingwith the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree tocomply.

Youreprovided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in yourday-to-daywork.
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.
  • You willbe requiredto attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place inDallas, TX.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/orapplicableAppraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

You maybe requiredto use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as anAllstater,youllenjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for monitoring the operation of assigned Food & Beverage location, including leading and training Team Members, ensuring Guest service standards are met, and operational readiness of indoor and open-air locations throughout Universal Kids Resort.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist Management and Supervisors with the consistent execution of Guest service and operational standards. This includes assigning and monitoring the Team Members breaks, jumping into position when necessary, de-escalating Guest situations, and seeking out ways to improve the efficiency and service being provided by Team Members at the venue.
  • Responsible for the consistent execution of world class Guest service, operational standards and motivating Team Members. Conduct daily shift meetings, engage in safety spot talks, and document Team Member performance. Aid in the dissemination of general company and venue specific forms of communication. Effectively apply the UDX service model to satisfy and resolve the needs of the Guests and Team Members. Monitor and report deficiencies in equipment and facility quality.
  • First point of contact for Team Members. Perform on-the-job training of new Team Members, working closely with Management to ensure that Team Members have successfully completed their training plan. Monitor trainees throughout their onboarding and training to ensure operational proficiency. Meet with Team Members to review their training progress, addresses concerns, document training-related issues, and ensure Team Member readiness for job responsibilities.
  • Perform all administrative duties related to the daily opening and closing of venues. Ensure daily staffing levels and rotation schedules are adjusted according to park attendance. Maintain daily reports, overtime reports, and safety checklists. Maintain operating supplies, review timekeeping to ensure that time is properly entered based on job code and functional area. Approve daily scheduling request changes.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 6+ months of leadership experience preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$52,600.00 - $86,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims. This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under close supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • In order to perform the essential functions of this role, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification may be required to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements. Generally, required Insurance License(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the role, and ongoing continuing education requirements must be maintained as mandated.
  • This position requires participation in our Catastrophe Response Program, which could include deployment to assist our customers in other states.
  • This position requires the individual to access and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, which is physically demanding requiring the ability to carry, set up and climb a ladder weighing approximately 38 to 49 pounds, walk on roofs, and enter tight spaces (such as attic staircases and entries, crawl spaces, etc.). While specific territory or day-to-day responsibilities may not require an individual to climb a ladder, the incumbent must be capable of safely climbing a ladder when deploying to a catastrophe which is a requirement of the position.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management and estimating software.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrated openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Outside Auto Appraiser, you are responsible for physically inspecting damaged vehicles, estimating repair costs, working closely with repair facilities, and determining and settling the actual cash value of total loss vehicles to ensure accurate and timely claim settlements. In this customer-facing role, you will need to have a high level of technical expertise in vehicle damage assessment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment. This position will serve as a technical resource for auto claim staff and will provide advice and direction to claim professionals on claim damages to achieve optimal outcomes. This position is based remotely with work at residential and/or commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

LOCATION REQUIREMENT: This role services Insureds and Agents in the New York City area. The selected candidate must reside or be willing to relocate at their own expense to the assigned territory.

What Will You Do?

  • Inspect and assess vehicle damage resulting from accidents, weather events, or other covered losses by conducting thorough virtual or on-site inspections at body shops or customer locations.
  • Perform estimate review work, conduct virtual inspections, and collaborate with repair facilities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality across claims.
  • Prepare accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating software to determine the cost of parts, labor, and materials required to restore vehicles to pre-loss condition.
  • Evaluate and settle vehicle total losses by determining actual cash value (ACV) through market research, comparable vehicle analysis, and application of appropriate valuation tools and methodologies.
  • Negotiate repair costs and settlements with body shops, customers, and third-party claimants to reach fair and timely resolutions while maintaining quality repair standards.
  • Identify and document pre-existing damage, prior repairs, and potential fraud indicators to ensure accurate claim evaluation and protect company interests.
  • Collaborate with claim representatives, body shops, and vendors to coordinate repairs, authorize supplements, and resolve coverage or repair-related issues.
  • Provide exceptional customer service by explaining the appraisal process, answering questions, assisting in moving claims towards timely resolution, and keeping vehicle owners informed throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Active adjuster license, where applicable.
  • Two years of auto physical damage appraisal experience.
  • Proficient in claims management and estimating software, with advanced skills in Microsoft Office and enterprise technology systems and platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for customers throughout the claim process.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated conflict resolution skills; ability to facilitate productive discussions and reach equitable outcomes.
  • Ability to manage stress, navigate difficult situations, and maintain composure and professionalism under pressure while always taking accountability for decisions.
  • Basic understanding of insurance principles and terminology, state insurance regulations and claim handling requirements.
  • Ability to quickly learn from experience and apply it to new situations with speed and flexibility.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • One year of auto physical damage appraisal or comparable claim related experience or successful completion of required Travelers Claim Representative training program.
  • Valid driver's license.

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. Our part-time Tellers are key ambassadors of our brand, providing friendly, efficient service that makes banking easy and enjoyable for our customers.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Part- Time Teller Role

Join our dynamic team as a Part-Time Teller, where exceptional customer service and operational excellence meet. Reporting directly to the Branch Manager, you'll play a vital role in delivering personalized banking experiences while ensuring the highest standards of security and compliance. If you're passionate about banking, detail-oriented, and eager to grow your career, we want to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Transactions: Accurately and efficiently process deposits, check cashing, and withdrawals, verifying cash and endorsements, and issuing receipts with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Product & Service Promotion: Cross-sell and educate clients on the Bank's diverse financial products and services, enhancing client relationships and fostering financial wellness.
  • Payment Processing: Handle credit card payments, issue money orders, bank checks, and accept loan payments, ensuring accuracy and security.
  • Secure Handling of Assets: Manage night deposit bags, admit clients to safe deposit boxes, and maintain confidentiality and security at all times.
  • Client Support & Inquiries: Respond promptly to customer questions, provide account balances, and assist with general banking needs, cultivating a welcoming environment.
  • Reconciliation & Record Keeping: Perform end-of-day balancing of transactions, verify cash totals, and reconcile Automated Teller Machines (ATMs). Maintain detailed reports and logs to ensure compliance and accurate record retention.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Prior experience in customer service and cash handling.
  • Strong verbal communication skills.
  • Highly organized with the ability to multitask effectively.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within small teams.
  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus
  • Access to reliable transportation
  • Willingness to participate in ongoing training and development.
  • Ability to lift 10–20 lbs., stand for extended periods.

Preferred

  • Previous banking or financial services experience.

Schedule

Part-time position with hours aligned to branch operations:

  • Mon–Fri: 12:30 PM – 5:00 PM
  • Sat: 8:30 AM – 12:00 PM (rotating schedule)
  • Sun: Closed

Employees may need to remain 15–30 minutes after closing.

About Smart Infrastructure – Electrification and Automation:

The EA Business Unit in Wendell, North Carolina, which is its U.S. headquarters, focuses on photovoltaic inverters, medium-voltage power distribution equipment including packaging and services, and solutions, including automation.

We are looking for a Sr Proposal Engineer. This Hybrid position will be based in Wendell, NC. Relocation assistance is available. This position could be fully remote for an experienced MV Switchgear Proposal Engineer.

We are seeking a Sr. Proposal Engineer to lead technical excellence, engineering strategy, and continuous improvement across our Solutions organization. In this high-impact role, you'll work closely with Siemens Sales to prepare offers supporting customers in the industrial, construction and utility markets on technical, contractual, and commercial issues.

This role may be converted to a remote position based on experience and qualifications, with occasional travel to Wendell for trainings, workshops, and key meetings

You'll make an impact by:

  • Translating customer requirements and specifications into innovative, cost-effective power distribution solutions.
  • Leading the development of complex proposals, including scope definition, equipment selection, and technical configurations.
  • Creating conceptual layouts and engineering deliverables that clearly communicate proposed solutions.
  • Partnering with engineering, procurement, and product teams to evaluate technical options and optimize solution design.
  • Developing project estimates, cost models, and customer-facing proposal packages for large-scale opportunities.
  • Supporting customer discussions and serving as a trusted technical advisor to sales and business development teams.
  • Driving engineering excellence through continuous improvement, technical mentorship, and successful project handoff to execution teams.

You'll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
  • 7+ years of application engineering experience supporting engineered-to-order solutions and customer proposals.
  • 3+ years of quotation, estimating, or front-end engineering experience.
  • Experience analyzing customer specifications, single-line diagrams, and technical requirements to develop optimized solutions.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to balance technical, commercial, and profitability objectives.
  • Ability to identify market trends and collaborate cross-functionally to drive product and process improvements.
  • Ability to travel up to 10-15%.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or developing engineering teams.
  • Background in power distribution, medium-voltage switchgear, transformers, or related electrical infrastructure products.
  • Knowledge of ANSI, IEEE, UL, and NEMA standards.
  • Experience reviewing single-line diagrams, schematics, protection and control systems, and communication network drawings.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and decision-making skills.
  • Experience within manufacturing, EPC, utility, industrial, or consulting engineering environments.

Reports to: Branch Manager
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt | Supervisory Role: Yes

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, make a positive impact in our community, and be rewarded for your success.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

Ready to lead with confidence and make a meaningful impact? Apply now and become part of our dedicated banking family!

About the Assistant Branch Manager Role

Join Our Dynamic Banking Team and Lead with Excellence!


Are you a motivated leader with a passion for delivering exceptional customer service and driving branch success? We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Assistant Branch Manager to support our Branch Manager in orchestrating the seamless operation of our branch, fostering a trusted environment, and elevating the customer experience. This pivotal role offers the chance to influence our community's financial well-being and grow professionally within a reputable institution.


As the Assistant Branch Manager, you will be the vital right hand to our Branch Manager, overseeing daily operations, supervising staff, and ensuring our branch functions with efficiency, security, and warmth. Your expertise in residential mortgages, IRA services, and personal banking products will empower you to deliver tailored solutions that meet our clients' needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operational Leadership: Stepping into the Branch Manager's shoes during their absence, managing staff, and maintaining smooth day-to-day operations.
  • Team Supervision: Overseeing Head Teller and Teller teams, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
  • Branch Branding & Growth: Building a strong branch identity, promoting sales initiatives, and championing exceptional customer service.
  • Customer Engagement: Personally, connecting with clients and prospects, resolving issues efficiently, and ensuring satisfaction aligns with our high standards.
  • Compliance & Accuracy: Reviewing and approving transactions such as large check cashing, bank checks, and ledger entries, while maintaining strict adherence to policies.
  • Performance & Standards: Striving to meet and exceed branch performance metrics, focusing on operational controls, security, and regulatory compliance.
  • Professional Development: Continually enhancing your banking acumen and sales techniques through training, workshops, and ongoing education.

Global Account Manager (Amazon)

Position Overview

This role is focused on Amazon Worldwide Operations, including fulfillment centers, material handling systems (MHS), warehouse automation, intralogistics, logistics engineering, and supply chain operations. The successful candidate will drive growth of Siemens Digital Industries automation, software, and digitalization solutions across Amazon's global operations organization while coordinating strategic initiatives with stakeholders worldwide. This position carries global responsibility and requires the ability to develop executive relationships, influence technology strategies, and coordinate opportunities across Amazon's worldwide operations ecosystem.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Global Account Manager (Amazon)

This position will be remote in the US with a preference in metro Seattle area.

Role Description

You'll make an impact by:

  • Delivering Integrated Siemens Solutions: Leverage the full breadth of the Siemens Digital Industries portfolio, including DI and SI resources, to architect and deliver innovative, impactful solutions. This involves driving specification influence, seamlessly coordinating across Siemens' diverse internal teams (e.g., Vertical Sales, SW Sales, Digital Sales, OEM Sales, Engineering), and actively managing relationships with strategic partners and integrators to ensure successful project execution and amplified market reach.
  • Delivering Measurable Customer Value & Sustainable Growth: Drive rigorous opportunity management and accurate forecasting, fueled by proactive demand generation and in-depth account research. Ensure every solution not only addresses customer challenges but also delivers quantifiable financial outcomes directly impacting their key performance indicators, thereby fostering robust, sustainable growth for both Siemens and our clients within their respective markets.
  • Shaping Market Presence & Strategic Insight: Establish Siemens as a recognized thought leader in the intralogistics sector. Actively engage with industry associations, conduct thorough market research to identify new opportunities, and provide critical feedback to inform our product and strategic direction.Driving Strategic Growth & Executive Engagement: Achieve significant sales growth and exceed revenue targets by developing and executing comprehensive strategic account plans focused on Amazon Worldwide Operations. Cultivate executive-level relationships across fulfillment, logistics, warehouse automation, and operations engineering organizations while influencing strategic technology direction and driving impactful business outcomes

You will win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in business development or strategic account management, with a proven track record of exceeding sales targets in complex solution environments.
  • 8+ years Industrial Acumen and strong understanding of the intralogistics industry with a focus on retail/distribution including market dynamics, key players, and business drivers.
  • 8+ years Channel Navigation: Proven success navigating diverse sales channels, including direct sales, distributors, and system integrators.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrated ability to engage senior leadership, build trusted advisor relationships, and influence strategic business and technology decisions within large enterprise organizations.
  • Mindset & Logistics: Entrepreneurial mindset, high sense of urgency, and willingness to travel up to 50%.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Relevant Academic Foundation: Bachelor's or Advanced degree in Engineering, Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related technical field, providing a strong analytical and problem-solving foundation.
  • Digital Transformation Expertise: Deep understanding of Discrete and Process Automation or Digital Transformation solutions, and their application within logistics processes.
  • Siemens Portfolio Knowledge: Fundamental understanding of the Siemens Digital Industries product, solutions, and service portfolio.
  • Complex Opportunity Strategy: Proven ability to develop and execute sophisticated opportunity pursuit strategies across complex ecosystems (e.g., end-users, engineering firms, system integrators)
  • Industry Expertise: Experience working with material handling systems, warehouse automation, fulfillment operations, intralogistics, logistics technology providers, OEMs, system integrators, or large end-user logistics organizations. Global Account Experience: Experience leading global accounts across multiple regions and coordinating cross-functional teams within complex enterprise environments.

Job.JobTitle: Business Development Underwriter - Dallas Metro Region
Job.JobDescription:
Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible.


Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here!


PURPOSE OF THE JOB

The purpose of this role is to develop and manage a profitable book of business within assigned line(s) of business, while building and maintaining strong agency relationships and driving production results. Business Development Underwriters are assigned primary underwriting responsibility for specific line(s) of business (e.g., Workers' Compensation or Commercial Package and its component coverages). In addition, this role supports broader Commercial Lines growth by identifying cross-sell opportunities and actively marketing all Company products in coordination with other underwriting partners. This role exists to ensure the Company achieves its underwriting profitability and distribution objectives through disciplined risk selection, pricing, and agency engagement.


Location: This is a remote/field role. Candidates ideally will reside in or near Dallas, Texas or the surrounding metro area or other nearby communities.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Underwriting & Portfolio Management

  • Underwrite, select, and price risks within assigned line(s) of business in accordance with Company guidelines
  • Maintain accountability for the profitability, growth, and retention of assigned portfolio
  • Evaluate risk characteristics including operations, financials, management, and loss history to determine acceptability
  • Apply appropriate pricing, credits/debits, and underwriting judgment to achieve target returns
  • Accept or reject risks within delegated authority while ensuring alignment with underwriting guidelines and profitability objectives
  • Monitor book performance and take corrective action as needed
  • Utilize underwriting authority to effectively price and manage business within assigned line(s)
  • Remain current on regulatory, rating, and coverage changes (e.g., WCIRB/NCCI, ISO/AAIS) impacting assigned line(s) of business

Business Development, Production & Distribution

  • Drive new business production and achieve growth objectives through proactive agency engagement, prospecting, and cross-sell execution
  • Develop, manage, and maintain a producer force capable of generating profitable business
  • Monitor production, quality, and profitability of assigned producers and hold producers accountable to expectations
  • Drive profitable sales of all Company products, including increasing penetration of existing products and supporting new product introductions
  • Actively identify and pursue cross-sell opportunities across all Commercial Lines products, regardless of primary underwriting assignment
  • Promote all Company Commercial Lines offerings in agency interactions, supporting a total account approach
  • Prospect, prequalify, and appoint new producers aligned with Company strategy
  • Set, communicate, and monitor production expectations with agency partners
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of assigned territory, including production sources, competitor activity, and market trends
  • Identify opportunities for growth, new distribution, and market expansion and provide feedback to leadership

Producer & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary Company contact and representative for assigned and prospective producers
  • Build and maintain collaborative relationships through regular agency visits, meetings, and presentations
  • Provide underwriting and production support, including participation in account strategy and marketing discussions
  • Provide responsive, high-quality service to agents and insureds, resolving inquiries and coverage decisions promptly
  • Maintain consistent communication through in-person visits, calls, and Company technology
  • Present agency performance insights, opportunities, and agency management strategies to internal stakeholders and agency partners

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree from four-year college or university with a major or emphasis in Business, Accounting, Statistics, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience. Minimum 1 year of related experience and/or training required.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Current driver's license required.


KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships with agents and brokers while delivering high-quality customer service
  • Ability to apply fundamental underwriting principles, concepts, and guidelines within assigned line(s) of business
  • Ability to evaluate and interpret submissions, financial information, loss control reports, and policy forms/endorsements
  • Working knowledge of commercial insurance products, including Workers' Compensation and/or Commercial Package and its component coverages (e.g., General Liability, Property, Commercial Auto, Inland Marine)
  • Ability to balance underwriting discipline within assigned line(s) of business with business development, production, and cross-sell expectations across Commercial Lines
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills
  • Ability to analyze risk, identify exposures, and make sound underwriting decisions aligned with Company objectives

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.
  • Role requires 40%-50% travel to meet with clients, attend industry events, and develop new business opportunities.
  • Travel is usually limited to automobile but occasional air travel is required.
  • Requires regular visits to outside locations such as producer's offices.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • This position operates in a home office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier and other standard office equipment.

This description is a general statement of essential job functions and responsibilities.

The position may include other duties as assigned.

Job Summary

Workplace: MEXICO - Remote ( #LI-Remote )

We are looking for a Predictive Analytics Manager to join a newly established, high-impact team focused on transforming enterprise decision-making. This team is at the forefront of delivering timely, accurate, and forward-looking financial and operational insights by combining advanced analytics, actuarial concepts, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities.

In this role, you will help build predictive analytics capabilities from the ground up in a fast-paced, “startup-like” environment within a large organization. You will play a key role in designing and implementing data-driven solutions that drive profitable growth, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen business intelligence across the enterprise.

This is an excellent opportunity for a data-driven professional who enjoys autonomy, thrives in ambiguous environments, and wants to influence how analytics is built and scaled.

Requirements

  • Years of experience in predictive analytics, data science, or related field
  • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field
  • Professional experience in insurance or pricing analytics is a strong plus
  • Strong experience with:
  • Python, R, and SQL
  • Experience with SAS is a plus
  • Advanced knowledge of:
    • Predictive modeling and machine learning techniques
    • Statistical analysis and data mining
    • Data preparation and feature engineering
  • Strong understanding of data ecosystems and ability to navigate complex data environments
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present analytical findings to diverse audiences
  • Problem-solving mindset with the ability to work independently in a fast-evolving environment
  • Experience contributing to or building analytics capabilities from scratch is highly valued
  • Collaborative and proactive approach, with a willingness to share knowledge and mentor others
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in data-driven environments

Essential Job Functions

  • Develop and implement predictive models using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques (e.g., regression, clustering, decision trees, neural networks)
  • Build and maintain programs for predictor and response variables, ensuring model accuracy and scalability
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand needs, translate them into analytical solutions, and communicate actionable insights clearly
  • Present analytical findings to non-technical audiences, explaining methodologies, data sources, and business impact
  • Explore, prepare, and structure large datasets (internal and external) to support model development and enhancement
  • Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of modeling frameworks, processes, and best practices
  • Ensure data quality and model integrity through rigorous validation and review processes
  • Develop a strong understanding of the data landscape, including sourcing, mapping, and integrating data across systems

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

This role is responsible for investigating and managing non-attorney represented bodily injury claims from initial report through resolution. You will evaluate coverage, determine liability, assess damages, and negotiate claims within your level of authority.

In this role, you will work directly with customers to gather information, explain the claims process, and provide a clear and supportive experience. You will also identify potential subrogation or fraud and partner with internal teams to achieve the best outcome.

We are seeking an Experienced Bodily Injury Adjuster to join our team supporting the Pacific Time Zone. In this role, you will handle non-attorney represented bodily injury claims, guiding customers through the claims process and ensuring fair and timely outcomes.

If you have a strong foundation in bodily injury claims, enjoy problem-solving, and are passionate about delivering a positive customer experience, this is a great opportunity to grow your career with National General, an Allstate company.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handles investigation regarding all aspects of bodily injury claims (coverage, damages, subrogation, litigation) with the exercise of discretion and independence within increased level of authority

  • Applies intermediate understanding of insurance policies written by the company, the industry, and organizational relationships within the company and department.

  • Determines subrogation or fraud potential and how to handle.

  • Identifies customer needs and works to meet those needs using appropriate customer service skills.

  • Recognizes and identifies body parts of a vehicle and understanding of other potential property damage.

  • For claims involving fraud or subrogation, partners with assigned reps from those areas to achieve best outcome.

  • Effective problem solving and analytical skills; ability to detect differences and issue recognition from multiple sources.

  • Proficient in Word and Outlook.

Job Description

We are seeking students for our Summer 2027 Internship Program. The Quantum Algorithm Development Intern will support research and development efforts focused on applying quantum computing to real-world optimization, machine learning, and analytics challenges. Working alongside technical experts, interns will develop and evaluate quantum algorithms, build simulations and prototypes, analyze quantum and classical approaches, and contribute to collaborative projects with industry and academic partners. This role is ideal for senior undergraduate students, graduate students, or recent graduates with a background in computer science, physics, mathematics, engineering, or a related field who are passionate about emerging technologies, problem-solving, and translating advanced research into practical applications.

This position is part of our Summer 2027 Internship Program.

This internship is designed for senior-level undergraduate students, graduate students, and recent graduates interested in applying quantum computing to real-world optimization, machine learning, and analytics challenges. Preference will be given to candidates in the Chicago, IL area.

As a Quantum Algorithm Development Intern, you will work alongside technical experts to explore emerging quantum technologies, contribute to projects collaborating with partners in industry and academia, and investigate how quantum and classical approaches can be applied to complex business problems.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, enjoys solving difficult problems, and has a strong foundation in computing, mathematics, analytics, or engineering. This role offers hands-on experience conducting research, developing technical solutions, and communicating findings in a rapidly evolving field.

Key Responsibilities

As an intern, you will:

  • Assist in the development and evaluation of quantum computing algorithms for optimization, machine learning, and related applications.

  • Build simulations and prototypes using quantum and classical computing tools.

  • Analyze and compare the performance of quantum and classical approaches through numerical experiments.

  • Investigate a defined technical or research question with guidance from members of the team.

  • Contribute to research studies, technical documentation, presentations, and proof-of-concept projects.

  • Collaborate with internal teams and, when applicable, external researchers from universities, national laboratories, and industry.

  • Help identify practical problems that could potentially benefit from future advances in quantum computing.

  • Learn and apply best practices in scientific computing, data analysis, and algorithm development.

  • Communicate progress, raise questions when support is needed, and incorporate feedback throughout the project.

Minimum Qualifications

Current undergraduate student entering senior year, current graduate student, or recent graduate pursuing a degree in:

  • Computer Science

  • Physics

  • Mathematics

  • Statistics

  • Data Science

  • Industrial Engineering

  • Operations Research

  • Electrical Engineering

  • Or a related quantitative or technical field

Coursework, research, or project experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Quantum Computing

  • Linear Algebra

  • Algorithms

  • Mathematical Optimization

  • Machine Learning

  • Scientific Computing

  • Experience programming in Python or a similar technical programming language.

  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

  • Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn by asking questions and tackling unfamiliar challenges.

  • Interest in emerging technologies and their real-world applications.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong candidates bring experience from a Quantum Computing track, in combination with a Classical Analytics track, or related fields. While some prior exposure to quantum computing is required, applicants are not expected to have experience in every area listed below.

Quantum Computing Background

One or more of the following:

  • Introductory coursework or project experience in quantum computing.

  • Familiarity with quantum circuits or quantum algorithms.

  • Experience with quantum software frameworks such as Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, CUDA-Q, or similar tools.

  • Coursework, research, or projects involving quantum information science.

Classical Analytics Background

One or more of the following:

  • Machine learning or predictive modeling.

  • Mathematical optimization, operations research, or decision science.

  • Data analysis, statistics, or scientific computing.

  • Experience with optimization libraries, machine learning frameworks, or numerical methods.

  • Experience applying analytical or computational methods to technical or business problems.

What Will Help You Succeed

Successful interns in this role will demonstrate:

  • Intellectual curiosity and an interest in investigating unanswered questions.

  • Ability to work independently while communicating when support is needed.

  • Comfort learning unfamiliar technical concepts.

  • Ability to explain complex work clearly and concisely.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Openness to feedback and collaboration.

  • Ability to connect technical findings to practical applications.

Compensation range for this role is between $32.69 and $36.54 an hour depending on experience and qualifications.

Skills

Algorithms, Machine Learning (ML), Physics, Python (Programming Language), Qiskit, Quantum Computing, Technical Research, Written Communication

Job Description

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will investigate and evaluate homeowners property claims from start to finish. You will confirm the facts of loss, determine coverage, assess damages, and negotiate settlements within your assigned authority. In this role, you will manage the entire claim lifecycle, including supplements, Additional Living Expense (ALE) claims, contents, and personal property losses. You will work closely with customers, contractors, and other partners to ensure claims are handled accurately and efficiently.

A key part of this position is delivering excellent customer service through clear, timely communication, keeping customers informed and supported throughout the claims process.

We are seeking an experienced Field Property Adjuster located in Houston, TX or surrounding areas with proficiency in Xactimate and a strong foundation in claims handling, including supplements, ALE, contents and full claim ownership. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong organizational skills, a proactive approach, excellent customer service, and the ability to adapt in a fastpaced environment. Experience handling claims in both field and desk settings is strongly preferred. Holds an active adjuster license or possess a license that qualifies for reciprocity in the applicable states is strongly preferred.


Key Responsibilities

Exhibits mastery estimating fundamentals in order to create estimates of damages on the most complex 1st party homeowner losses of all severities

Builds mastered relationships with both internal and external customers

Interprets regulatory compliance and fair claims practices

Negotiates settlements, makes settlement payments and documents all activities in the most complex of files

Applies mastered content in interpretations of all policy types written by the company and assists leadership in formal and ad hoc training

Recommends process improvements


Supervisory Responsibilities

Job.JobTitle: Litigation Attorney - Special Investigations Unit (Remote - New York)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and put your litigation and investigative skills to work protecting The Allstate Company against insurance fraud. The ideal candidate for this role will have a passion for combatting fraud against the insurance industry. In this role, you will utilize your litigation and investigative experience to help defend the company against medical and other types of fraud. The successful candidate will be responsible for bringing affirmative actions, including RICO-based litigation, on behalf of the Company. You will apply your well-developed legal writing skills and negotiate a variety of complex matters within the state of New York. This role offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by pursuing innovative legal strategies and helping protect the Company from fraudulent activity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the Claims/Special Investigation Unit (SIU) to combat fraudulent claims in No-Fault and other cases.

  • Research, prepare, file, and litigate fraud cases, including RICO and other Affirmative Actions.

  • Develop litigation strategies on legal matters.

  • Review case files and plan resolutions.

  • Draft discovery requests, motions, memorandums, and legal briefs.

  • Prepare for and conduct Depositions and Examinations Under Oath (EUOs).

  • Attend arbitrations, mediations, and trials.

  • Work with expert witnesses in the preparation of, or defense of litigation.

  • Represent the company in court appearances (conferences, hearings) in State and Federal courts.

  • Draft pre-trial and post-trial motions.

  • Negotiate settlements and prepare related documentation.

Education and Licensing

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the New York State Bar

  • Federal Court Admission or the ability to seek admission upon selection for this role

Experience

  • 4 or more years of experience

  • Ability to manage and oversee intermediate-level litigation matters.

  • Legal research and writing skills

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and related computer applications

  • Exercises discretion and maintains confidentiality

  • Demonstrates ethics and integrity

  • Knowledge of legal holds and discovery processes

  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with colleagues on a daily basis

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties

Explore the Benefits of Joining Allstate's Client Legal Services:

    • Exceptional Work-Life Balance:At Allstate, we understand the importance of achieving harmony between work and personal life. Our in-house litigation roles provide more predictable schedules and flexibility, allowing you to excel professionally while enjoying a fulfilling personal life.

    • Holistic Understanding of the Business:As part of the Allstate legal team, you'll gain invaluable insight into our diverse business operations, objectives, and culture. This comprehensive understanding enables you to align legal strategies closely with the company's goals, fostering impactful contributions and strategic partnerships across departments.

    • Direct Client Collaboration:Working in-house at Allstate means collaborating directly with internal stakeholders and business units. This close partnership cultivates deeper client relationships, facilitating a nuanced understanding of their needs and priorities. By providing proactive legal guidance and support, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the company's success.

    • Strategic Influence and Impact:As an integral member of our legal team, you'll have the opportunity to shape strategic decisions and risk management initiatives. Your insights and expertise will inform key business decisions, empowering you to mitigate risks effectively and drive positive outcomes that directly impact Allstate's bottom line.

    • Diverse Legal Challenges:In-house litigation roles at Allstate encompass a broad spectrum of legal work beyond traditional litigation, including regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and dispute resolution. This diversity of challenges ensures continuous professional growth and development, expanding your skill set and enhancing your career trajectory.

    • Professional Growth Opportunities:With ample opportunities for advancement and professional development, you'll have the support and resources you need to reach new heights in your legal career.

Job.JobTitle: Attendant, Ride Operations - Universal Kids Resort
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the safe operation of attractions, shows, and water and dry play areas at Universal Kids Resort theme park while delivering exemplary Guest service. Ensures Guest service recovery standards are met and policies and procedures are followed. Supports effective teamwork across Operations in support of a seamless Guest experience at Universal Kids Resort.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensures the proper use of safety practices and procedures while operating the attraction, show or play area in addition to opening and closing procedures. In a friendly and professional manner, discreetly screens Guests for ride requirements, special access needs, and ushers Guests as necessary. Loads and unloads ride or show, checks ride restraints and lap bars, provides safety instructions, operates control consoles, dispatches vehicles and observes ride monitors to ensure the safe operation of the attraction. Safely evacuates the ride in accordance with operating procedures.
  • Welcome and engage Guests by delivering themed narrations or story lines and providing attraction or show information/times. Monitors the queue, makes appropriate adjustments and measures attraction wait times. Ensures kid-focused Guest service standards are met and all IBCCES standards are utilized. Assists with Guest flow and crowd control for show capacity and weather conditions.
  • Maintains a clean and safe work environment by constantly monitoring the immediate area and/or surroundings. Responsible for ensuring a neat and organized work area, trash removal and keeping the area free of debris to include the proper maintenance of equipment and/or props.
  • Supports seasonal and special events at Universal Kids Resort by assisting with arrivals and check-in of event Guests and facilitates movement of groups throughout the park while partnering with other departments for a seamless Guest experience. Assists with projects, initiatives and sustainment efforts as directed.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Must be able to work a flexible and varying schedule based on business needs.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment and operate ride vehicles and moving machinery.
  • Regularly required to ride the attraction/ride to ensure show quality and that special effects are in the proper working order including lighting, sound, animatronics and general maintenance.
  • Responsible for evacuating the attraction/ride and assisting Guests through various evacuation methods.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Previous theme park experience or hospitality is preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Universal Kids Resort via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from Universal Kids Resort HR/Recruitment will be deemed the sole property of Universal Kids Resort. At WAHVE, we value significant insurance experience and want to revolutionize the way people think about phasing into retirement by offering qualified candidates the opportunity to continue their career working from home. As we say – retire from the office but not from work.  Our unique platform provides you with real work/life balance and allows you to choose a full or part-time work schedule while continuing to utilize your insurance expertise in a remote, long-term position which includes company benefits!

We created a welcoming place to work with friendly and professional leadership. We are known for the great care we take with our staff and our clients. We have assignments available to help our Property & Casualty insurance carrier clients in Commercial Lines Rater and Rating Technician positions.  Responsibilities include:

  • Perform required support functions for Underwriting. Tasks may include ordering MVR's, inspections and reviews, financial reports, calculating / building cost estimates and other similar tasks as requested.
  • New business submission clearance, data entry of new business submission information and Broker of Record requests.
  • Process new business and renewal related transactions in a timely manner. Transactions may include, but not limited to, quoting, rating, or pricing revisions, policy issuance, endorsements, premium audits, cancellations, and reinstatements for multiple commercial lines of business.  
  • Work with underwriters and other functional areas to resolve any discrepancies.

TO BECOME A WORK-AT-HOME VINTAGE EXPERT, WE REQUIRE

BENEFITS OF BECOMING A WAHVE VINTAGE EXPERT
