Job.JobTitle: SAP Accounting Master Data Senior Consultant
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Accounting / Finance / Banking, Human Resources, IT / Technology
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Drive the integrity of enterprise financial data and play a critical role in enabling accurate reporting, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making.

The SAP Accounting Master Data Senior Consultant serves as a subject matter expert overseeing the governance, maintenance, and optimization of financial master data within SAP. This role combines deep accounting knowledge with strong technical and business acumen to support enterprise-wide financial processes, system enhancements, and strategic initiatives. The successful candidate will partner across Finance, Technology, and Business Operations to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and effectiveness of key accounting structures and data frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary subject matter expert for SAP Accounting Master Data, ensuring the integrity and governance of critical financial structures.
  • Manage and maintain financial master data, including General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Global Hierarchies, Validation Tables, and other SAP accounting objects.
  • Leverage accounting expertise and business insight to align financial data structures with organizational objectives and evolving business needs.
  • Analyze complex accounting, financial, and system-related issues, identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions.
  • Lead and support SAP enhancements, testing efforts, system upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with Finance, Technology, and business stakeholders to drive process improvements and optimize master data management practices.
  • Develop and implement controls, standards, and governance processes that ensure data accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
  • Translate complex financial and technical concepts into actionable recommendations for diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Lead moderately complex projects and initiatives, coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve reporting capabilities, and enhance operational efficiency across the enterprise.
  • Provide expert guidance and support in resolving accounting system and technology-related issues affecting multiple business areas.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and enterprise financial systems.
  • Experience managing and governing master data within SAP or similar ERP environments.
  • Proven ability to solve complex problems and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Passion for continuous improvement, data quality, and operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in accounting, financial systems, SAP master data, financial reporting, or related disciplines.
  • Experience supporting SAP accounting processes, month-end close activities, testing, and system enhancements.
  • Knowledge of master data governance, internal controls, financial reporting structures, and process optimization.

Why Join Us?

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the facilities maintenance of Universal Kids Resort buildings and designated areas. Completes specific work orders, installations, routine/preventative maintenance and repairs as assigned including, but not limited to, masonry, tile, pavers, cubicle partitions, furniture, scenic paint, roofing, and woodwork. Handles daily repair and troubleshooting tasks from Technical Services leadership. Completes special projects and other shop work as directed by Facilities Management to uphold show quality and standards. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Responsible for the maintenance and repairs for rough in carpentry to include, but not limited to, framing, sheet goods, wood decking and dock work as well as repairing wood metal stud work, and trim work including various moldings, turnings, laminate application, cabinet work, and window and door installation. Consistently provides routine/preventative maintenance in efforts to minimize the number of major repairs required, escalating to Facilities Management to address any major venue concerns when necessary. Ensures work area is clean and safe with tools and materials stored in designated storage areas and materials properly disposed of.
  • Performs routine inspection and maintenance of seating, furniture, restroom stall doors and partitions. Completes repairs and finishing to various walkways and roadways throughout the resort. Manages the preparation and painting of designated areas across UKR by determining color, mixing paint, prepping surface by cleaning, scraping, caulking, applying, putty, and sanding and applying paint. Maintains scenic aesthetic through painting techniques to include brushing, rolling, blending, spraying, and faux finishing based off of original creative intent.
  • Responsible for the installation and repairs to exterior finishes including, but not limited to Dry-Vit, EIFIS and Stucco. Fabricates tooling (molds) when multiple parts are needed. Maintains the roof surfaces of buildings, performs roof, gutter/downspout, window leak and other water infiltration repairs and preventative maintenance, and completes specific work orders for masonry, tile, pavers, and woodwork.
  • Installs and makes repairs to interior wall, floor tiles, coverings made of various materials, and to various commercial hardware, including but not limited to, door closures, panic hardware, mortis and cylindrical locks. Assists with creating, installing and removing specialized signage throughout UKR which may require the use of a High Reach to access.
  • Enters follow-up work orders for all discrepancies found in a timely manner. Documents all findings and work performed throughout the process of troubleshooting and performing repairs. Reports on labor in Maximo for all work performed. Demonstrates the ability to acquire skills in additional disciplines to support a broader range of operational and project needs. 
  • Completes preventative maintenance and show quality checks across the theme park. Trains new Technicians to do work orders, recovery procedures, and processes. Assists with seasonal weather condition sustainment initiatives as directed. 
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

  • Individual Contributor

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Previous facility maintenance experience is preferred.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of experience in general carpentry, construction, or roofing is required, experience within a seasonal/regional theme park is a plus; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

              Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$52,600.00 - $86,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims. This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility. This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office. This is a field position with a territory in the Hudson area of Massachusetts.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under close supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • In order to perform the essential functions of this role, acquisition and maintenance of Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification may be required to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements. Generally, required Insurance License(s) must be obtained within three months of starting the role, and ongoing continuing education requirements must be maintained as mandated.
  • This position requires participation in our Catastrophe Response Program, which could include deployment to assist our customers in other states.
  • This position requires the individual to access and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, which is physically demanding requiring the ability to carry, set up and climb a ladder weighing approximately 38 to 49 pounds, walk on roofs, and enter tight spaces (such as attic staircases and entries, crawl spaces, etc.). While specific territory or day-to-day responsibilities may not require an individual to climb a ladder, the incumbent must be capable of safely climbing a ladder when deploying to a catastrophe which is a requirement of the position.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); willingness to learn claims management and estimating software.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgement and make effective decisions within established authority.
  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrated openness to continuous learning.

What is a Must Have?

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.
  • Valid driver's license.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job Description

The Division Vice President (DVP) of Assurant Dealer Services leads the strategic and operational direction of a defined geographic business. This executive is responsible for achieving and exceeding revenue targets, growing market share, budget management, and ensuring exceptional client satisfaction across a portfolio of automotive accounts. The DVP oversees performance of the regional sales team, drives new business development, and builds strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders.


What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Develop and execute sales strategies aligned with Assurant Dealer Services (ADS) goals based on expertise within the channel, participants, markets, products and competitive landscape (traditional and disruptive).
  • Drive revenue growth, margin performance, and cost management across the division, creating a roadmap for increased profitability and commercial excellence within their division.
  • Research and proposes innovative strategies for ADS sales strategic accounts growth for their division; monitor sales effectiveness in delivering points of difference to increase our position in value creation for AIZ and our partners.
  • Provides leadership in developing best practices for measuring and optimizing strategic activities to drive data-driven decision making and excellence in their division.
  • Proactively analyze segments of customer data to uncover insights and key takeaways that inform strategic planning, increase revenue and drives business value in their division.
  • Synthesize and present data on account performance, identify areas of potential income improvement, and implement strategies to cross-sell products in their division.
  • Ensures any service gaps are addressed quickly and effectively and in situations of conflict with the client, leads the management team(s) to resolution looking to accomplish a win-win situation. Measures client satisfaction and uses findings to identify and address areas of opportunities as well as build upon success stories in their division.
  • Collaborates with risk management team related to current clients to mitigate regulatory risk and manage client compliance and oversight requirements in their division.
  • Lead, mentor, develop and performance manage regional sales managers and support staff. Build a high-performance, results-driven culture.
  • Monitor division sales performance/pipeline metrics and provide coaching.
  • Creating a roadmap for increased profitability and excellence within their division.

Team Leadership:


Direct reports

  • 8 Regional Managers

Number of direct and indirect reports

  • Approx. 20-35


What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Marketing or related field.
  • A minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in retail automotive space with concentration in the F&I arena, with demonstrated experience showing progression and increasing scope of responsibility.
  • 15 or more years in the Automotive Insurance experience and/or training industry.
  • Proven track record of strategic goal setting and personnel oversight, development and managing large, complex accounts.
  • Strong knowledge of the automotive ecosystem—OEMs, tiered suppliers, dealers, or fleet/aftermarket services.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
  • Change Management - Develops workable implementation plans; Communicates changes effectively; Builds commitment and overcomes resistance; Prepares and supports those affected by change; Monitors transition and evaluates results.
  • Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Demonstrates knowledge of market and competition; Aligns work with strategic goals.
  • Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values.
  • Strategic Thinking - Develops strategies to achieve business goals that support the overall organization's goals; Understands business strengths & weaknesses; Analyzes market and competition; Identifies external threats and opportunities; Adapts strategy to changing conditions.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Master's degree in Business Administration preferred.​

How much should I expect to travel?

Job Description

Aon is looking for a Privileged Access Management (PAM) Engineer to help strengthen and evolve our identity and privileged-access security capabilities.

In this role, you will engineer, implement and support PAM solutions, with a strong focus on CyberArk Cloud. You will work with engineering, architecture and business partners to onboard applications, maintain access policies, automate processes and deliver secure, scalable solutions.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

  • Engineer, implement and support security technologies focused on Privileged Access Management.
  • Implement and integrate PAM solutions, with a strong focus on CyberArk Cloud, and support endpoint privilege capabilities using technologies such as BeyondTrust or CyberArk EPM.
  • Onboard applications, accounts and credentials into PAM platforms while maintaining appropriate access controls and security policies.
  • Maintain and enhance CyberArk policies and support endpoint privilege policies for workstation environments.
  • Contribute to the architectural design of access controls, user entitlements, application credentials and user access policies.
  • Partner with architecture and engineering teams to advance the Identity and Access Management strategy and related roadmap.
  • Develop automation using scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python to improve privileged-access processes and capabilities.
  • Configure and support API or programmatic access to managed credentials.
  • Troubleshoot PAM, authentication and access issues, identify root causes and implement practical solutions.
  • Use relevant security and SIEM data to support troubleshooting, monitoring and informed decision-making.
  • Keep technical documentation current as platforms, configurations and environments evolve.
  • Contribute to new PAM capabilities and product features while working within an Agile delivery environment.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering, architecture and business partners.

How this opportunity is different

You will help protect critical systems and identities by improving how privileged access is designed, managed and secured. Through thoughtful engineering, automation and collaboration, you will help make PAM capabilities more secure, scalable and effective for the teams that rely on them.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in privileged access, identity security or related security engineering.
  • Hands-on experience implementing, developing or supporting CyberArk, with experience in CyberArk Cloud strongly preferred for this role.
  • Experience with PAM operational activities such as credential onboarding, access administration, policy configuration and API-based credential access.
  • Experience with endpoint privilege management technologies such as BeyondTrust EPM or CyberArk EPM.
  • Hands-on experience supporting Windows and/or Linux infrastructure.
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory, including users, computers, groups, Group Policy and trusts.
  • Understanding of broader Identity and Access Management concepts such as authentication, access certification and public key infrastructure.
  • Experience developing automation with scripting tools such as PowerShell, Python or comparable languages.
  • Familiarity with SIEM technologies and querying security data.
  • Understanding of web traffic and the ability to troubleshoot authentication flows.
  • Experience contributing to technical projects in an Agile environment.
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with both CyberArk and BeyondTrust technologies.
  • Exposure to emerging privileged-access use cases involving non-human identities (NHI) or AI-related security scenarios.
  • Broader experience across Identity and Access Management platforms and security technologies.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent years of relevant industry experience.

Are you passionate about building secure, seamless authentication experiences? Do you enjoy solving complex identity challenges while partnering across technology and the business?

Join Aon and help design, enhance, and support identity and access management solutions that strengthen security while creating a reliable experience for colleagues and clients.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

In this role, you will help design, implement, and support authentication capabilities across Aon's identity environment. You will partner with technology and business stakeholders to develop practical solutions that balance security, reliability, and user experience.

You will:

  • Design, integrate, test, and support Identity and Access Management (IAM) authentication solutions, with a focus on Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
  • Partner with technology, security, and business stakeholders to understand authentication needs, recommend appropriate IAM patterns, and guide solution implementation.
  • Configure and maintain authentication platforms such as Okta and Microsoft Entra, including policies, workflows, and integrations.
  • Help ensure authentication platforms remain secure, reliable, current, and well supported through effective monitoring, maintenance, and patching.
  • Design and refine SSO and MFA policies and controls that strengthen security while supporting a seamless user experience.
  • Develop and extend identity-platform capabilities using REST APIs, JSON, and customizable settings.
  • Analyze authentication and authorization logs to diagnose issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.
  • Create clear IAM documentation, architecture diagrams, and process flows that support solution design and ongoing operations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve authentication controls, processes, and platform capabilities while balancing security, reliability, and user experience.

How this opportunity is different

This role gives you the opportunity to work at the intersection of identity, cybersecurity, technology, and user experience. Your work will directly contribute to protecting Aon's technology environment while enabling secure and reliable access for colleagues and clients.

You will serve as an IAM subject-matter resource and trusted partner, collaborating across teams to solve complex authentication challenges and continually improve identity capabilities.

  • Professional experience designing, implementing, or supporting IAM solutions.
  • Experience implementing and integrating SSO and MFA technologies for workforce and/or external user environments, including platforms such as Okta or Microsoft Entra.
  • Working knowledge of identity and authentication standards and protocols such as SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM, LDAP, RADIUS, and Kerberos.
  • Experience analyzing authentication and authorization logs and troubleshooting complex identity issues.
  • Working experience with REST APIs and JSON.
  • Familiarity with applicable security and compliance frameworks, such as GDPR, SOX, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and develop practical solutions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate across technology and business teams, manage competing priorities, and contribute effectively in a team environment.
  • Ability to create clear technical documentation, diagrams, and process flows.
  • 3 + years of relevant professional experience designing and implementing IAM solutions, including experience with SSO and MFA technologies.
  • Equivalent combinations of relevant experience, skills, and education may also be considered

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

Summary:We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Compensation Manager to lead the design, execution, and governance of our compensation programs. This role will partner closely with HR and business leaders to ensure competitive, equitable, and data-driven pay practices that support organizational growth and talent strategy.

What You'll Do

Own Compensation Strategy & Program Design

  • Partner with the CPO to define and evolve the company's compensation philosophy and pay practices.
  • Design, implement, and continuously refine compensation structures including base pay, incentive plans, bonus programs, and special pay arrangements.
  • Develop and maintain salary structures, pay grades, and job architecture frameworks.
  • Conduct market benchmarking and external salary survey analysis to ensure competitiveness and alignment with business strategy.
  • Evaluate and recommend enhancements to compensation programs based on workforce trends, market conditions, and organizational growth.

Lead Annual Compensation Cycles

  • Own the end-to-end annual merit, bonus, and promotion cycles — including planning, modeling, budgeting, system configuration (Workday), manager enablement, and final approvals.
  • Develop compensation modeling scenarios and provide executive-ready analytics and recommendations.
  • Ensure timely and accurate implementation of approved changes within HRIS and payroll systems.
  • Partner with Finance on budget alignment and accrual forecasting.

Ensure Pay Equity & Governance

  • Conduct internal equity analyses to prevent compression and ensure fairness across functions and levels.
  • Analyze compensation data to identify disparities, trends, and risk areas; provide data-driven recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including pay transparency requirements.
  • Maintain documentation and governance standards for compensation processes and decisions.
  • Establish internal controls to mitigate risk and ensure consistency in pay decisions.

Support Talent Acquisition & Offer Governance

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partners to evaluate offers, sign-on bonuses, and promotional increases.
  • Review and approve compensation packages to ensure alignment with internal equity and market positioning.
  • Provide guidance on job leveling, salary bands, and offer strategy.
  • Verify compensation-related components of offer letters and ensure accurate system entry.

Oversee Compensation-Related Payroll & Adjustments

  • Partner with Payroll to ensure accurate processing of compensation changes, where applicable.
  • Review payroll data to validate compensation-related changes prior to final disbursement (e.g, mass merit uploads)
  • Collaborate with HR and Legal on severance modeling and payment processing.

Deliver Data-Driven Insights

  • Develop executive-level reporting and dashboards related to compensation trends, budget utilization, pay equity, and workforce analytics.
  • Conduct scenario modeling to support workforce planning and strategic decision-making.
  • Maintain data integrity within Workday and ensure alignment between HRIS and payroll systems.

Drive Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to streamline compensation workflows and enhance automation within Workday.
  • Develop SOPs and documentation to ensure consistency and audit readiness.
  • Stay current on compensation best practices, regulatory changes, and emerging market trends.
  • undefined

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, or related field preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive compensation experience, including ownership of compensation cycles.
  • Experience designing and managing salary structures and incentive programs.
  • Strong expertise in market benchmarking and salary survey analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting pay equity and internal compression analyses.
  • Advanced analytical skills with strong Excel and data modeling capability.
  • Experience working within Workday Compensation module or similar HRIS platforms preferred.
  • Strong understanding of payroll processes and compensation compliance requirements.
  • Exceptional discretion and ability to manage highly confidential information.

As an IT Analyst - Business Systems Analysis, you will identify business needs, examine processes, and turn requirements into effective technical solutions across various applications and functions. You will work closely with business collaborators, build improvements with development, testing, and functional teams. Your tasks include gathering requirements, evaluating impacts, defining solution scope, fixing defects, and supporting system improvements from planning to rollout. This role fits someone who is analytical, cooperative, and confident leading requirements and solution efforts throughout the project lifecycle.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we build decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, and traceability activities.
  • Consult with business partners and aligned technical and functional teams to define, analyze, and document business and system requirements.
  • Conduct business process analysis, impact assessments, and solution prioritization for proposed changes and initiatives.
  • Evaluate and recommend technical solutions that meet business objectives and operational needs.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration between business partners, development teams, quality assurance, and other cross-functional teams.

Job Description

Aon – Energy Risk Engineer- Remote US !

Location: Flexible / Remote with travel — Preference for candidates based along the U.S. Gulf Coast or within reasonable proximity to a major airport as this role is 50% travel.

Business Unit: Global Natural Resources – Energy Risk Engineering

Position Type: Full-Time

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

What the day will look like

Aon's Global Natural Resources practice is seeking an experienced Energy Risk Engineer to support our expanding portfolio of downstream, midstream, petrochemical, refining, LNG, and specialty chemical clients. This role bridges real-world operational experience with insurance risk engineering, helping clients reduce loss exposures, strengthen reliability, and align with insurer expectations for complex energy risks.

Key Responsibilities

Risk Engineering & Loss Control

- Conduct property risk engineering surveys at refining, petrochemical, gas processing, midstream, terminals, and specialty chemical facilities.

- Evaluate fire, explosion, natural catastrophe, mechanical integrity, and business interruption exposures.

- Assess process safety, asset integrity, reliability programs, and management-of-change systems.

- Develop clear, prioritized risk-improvement recommendations aligned with NFPA, API, OSHA PSM, CCPS, and other global standards.

Insurance & Technical Advisory

- Translate complex plant operations into insurance-ready engineering reports, including EML/MFL/BI exposure analyses.

- Support Aon brokers and client teams on renewal strategy, risk positioning, and market presentations.

- Communicate risk insights and mitigation strategies directly with underwriters and client leadership.

- Quantify the financial impact of risk improvements and support clients in decision-making.

Client Engagement & Thought Leadership

- Build and maintain strong relationships with facility leadership (PSM, maintenance, reliability, operations).

- Deliver training and guidance on loss prevention, emergency response, and reliability optimization.

- Contribute to Aon thought leadership: technical articles, benchmarking, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.

- Collaborate with Aon's global engineering community on complex risks and emerging technologies.

How this opportunity is different

You will support underwriting submissions, conduct global site assessments, prepare property loss-control recommendations, and partner closely with Aon brokers and clients to deliver industry-leading risk insights.

Skills and experience that will lead to success

Required

- 10+ years of engineering experience within petrochemical, refining, midstream, LNG, ammonia/fertilizer, polymers, or specialty chemical operations.

- Background in Process Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Reliability Engineering, or Process Safety/PSM.

- Strong understanding of PSM, RMP, mechanical integrity, rotating/fixed equipment, utilities, emergency systems, and reliability methodologies (RBI, RCM, LOPA/SIL).

- Ability to produce structured, client-ready technical reports.

- Willing and able to travel domestically and internationally (circa 80 days / year).

Who Succeeds in This Role

- Engineers who enjoy plant operations but want a more strategic, consultative path.

- Professionals who thrive on variety—no two clients or risks are identical.

- Strong communicators who can bridge operations language and insurance language.

- Self-driven, curious thinkers with a passion for safety, reliability, and loss prevention.

Why Aon

Join a globally recognized Natural Resources engineering team supporting some of the world's largest and most complex energy assets. You'll collaborate with engineers, brokers, and analytics experts while helping clients strengthen their resilience and operational performance. Aon offers exceptional professional development, global mobility opportunities, and exposure to diverse, high-impact projects.

For positions in San Francisco and Los Angeles, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction record in accordance with local Fair Chance ordinances.

Aon is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. If you are a search firm, you will not be compensated in any way for your submission of a candidate, even if Aon hires that candidate.

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Pay Transparency Laws

The salary range for this position (intended for U.S. applicants) is $150,000 to $170,000 annually. The actual salary will vary based on applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location.

This position is eligible to participate in one of Aon's annual incentive plans to receive an annual discretionary bonus in addition to base salary. The amount of any bonus varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan.

A summary of all the benefits offered for this position:

Aon offers a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and regular part-time colleagues, including, but not limited to: a 401(k) savings plan with employer contributions; an employee stock purchase plan; consideration for long-term incentive awards at Aon's discretion; medical, dental and vision insurance, various types of leaves of absence, paid time off, including 12 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 15 days of paid vacation per year, paid sick leave as provided under state and local paid sick leave laws, short-term disability and optional long-term disability, health savings account, health care and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee and dependent life insurance and supplemental life and AD&D insurance; optional personal insurance policies, adoption assistance, tuition assistance, commuter benefits, and an employee assistance program that includes free counseling sessions. Eligibility for benefits is governed by the applicable plan documents and policies.

Plan Administration & Compliance

  • Be responsible for the full administration cycle for a block of defined contribution retirement plans

Analysis & Communication

Professional Development

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in business administration, business analytics, mathematical economics, finance, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

High school diploma required.

Experience

Three to five years of directly related experience in retirement plan administration and consulting.

Credentialing (one or more preferred):

  • ASPPA: Qualified 401(k) Administrator (QKA), Qualified Plan Specialist (QKS), Qualified 401(k) Consultant (QKC), and/or Qualified Pension Administrator (QPA)

Technical Skills

Experience with Stax.ai, FT William, and PensionPro strongly preferred; familiarity with ASC a plus. Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and Teams. High degree of technical and legal knowledge, including familiarity with the Internal Revenue Code and ERISA as they apply to qualified plans.

Skills You'll Use Every Day

  • Collaboration – ability to work independently and within a team, bringing a positive, proactive, and entrepreneurial mindset

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to support and enhance enterprise access management platforms that secure critical applications and digital services across the organization. This role will serve as a lead responsible for designing, configuring, implementing, and supporting commercial IAM solutions while partnering with business and technology teams to deliver secure, scalable access management capabilities.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with web access management and identity platforms such as IBM Verify Identity Access, IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar enterprise IAM technologies. This individual will play a key role in product strategy, solution design, vendor management, application integrations, troubleshooting, testing, issue resolution, and mentoring team members.

The Allstate job title for this is role is Vended Application Lead Consultant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and guide the design, configuration, enhancement, and support of enterprise Identity and Access Management solutions, with a focus on vended access management platforms.

  • Develop technical and functional designs that address complex business requirements, application access needs, and security objectives.

  • Configure, develop within, and maintain IAM platforms that support authentication, authorization, single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access control capabilities.

  • Partner with business stakeholders, security teams, infrastructure teams, application owners, and vendor support teams to deliver secure access management solutions.

  • Contribute to product planning by creating, refining, and guiding user stories for complex features, including coaching team members who may be learning the platform or process.

  • Facilitate feature review sessions for complex business issues and requirements, document key decisions, and ensure alignment across business and technical teams.

  • Create functional designs using moderate technical skills to address complex business processes, product features, and application integration needs.

  • Support the planning, execution, and review of module, integration, and system testing for assigned features and product stories.

  • Manage issues, blockers, defects, and implementation risks through resolution for assigned features and product stories.

  • Review and validate new vendor release features, assess impact, and identify opportunities to improve platform capability and reliability.

  • Use vendor defect resolution processes, support tools, product documentation, and developer groups to troubleshoot issues and influence future product direction.

  • Evaluate proposed vendor software products and enhancements in alignment with strategic corporate direction, platform standards, and vendor roadmaps.

  • Provide knowledge and support for resolving technology issues across multiple business areas and application processes.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for access management processes, vended IAM platforms, and related application integrations.

  • Provide training, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to strengthen team capability and bench strength.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, process documentation, support procedures, and implementation guidance.

Essential Qualifications

  • 5 years or more of experience implementing, configuring, administering, or supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions. (Or Equivalent)

  • Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise web access management or IAM platforms, such as IBM Verify Identity Access (IVIA), IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), IBM Verify Access Appliance or related earlier versions, Okta, ForgeRock, PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar vended access management tools. (Or Equivalent)

  • Experience configuring or developing within vendor software to support access management, application authentication, authorization, and secure application access.

  • Experience implementing and supporting single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access management solutions for enterprise applications.

  • Experience writing automation scripts to complete the integration mapping automation using scripting languages, such as JavaScript, Python, Groovy, YAML or PowerShell. (Or Equivalent)

  • Knowledge of common identity and access standards and protocols, including SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and federation concepts.

  • Experience gathering complex business requirements and translating them into functional and technical designs.

  • Experience supporting module testing, integration testing, issue resolution, and production troubleshooting for enterprise applications or platforms.

  • Ability to lead technical discussions, organize requirements or feature review sessions, and document resulting decisions.

  • Experience working with vendor support processes, product documentation, defect resolution procedures, or developer support groups.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, identify blockers, drive issue resolution, and support delivery of assigned product features.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder partnership skills.

  • Ability to mentor, coach, or train team members and share knowledge across technical and business teams.

  • Equivalent combinations of technical training, certifications, and relevant work experience will be considered.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience supporting large enterprise IAM or access management environments.

  • Experience with cloud-based identity platforms, SaaS application integrations, or hybrid identity environments.

  • Knowledge of directory services such as Active Directory, LDAP, or related identity stores.

  • Experience with API security, access gateways, reverse proxies, policy configuration, or application onboarding for access management platforms.

  • Familiarity with Identity Governance Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), adaptive authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), or related security technologies.

  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Product Engineering, or similar delivery environments.

  • Experience evaluating vendor roadmaps, testing new release features, and recommending platform enhancements.

  • Relevant identity, security, cloud, or vendor certifications.

  • Experience in creating technical documentation, operational procedures, training materials, or platform standards.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

In this role, you will help design, build, and deliver the next generation of operational claims systems supporting Allstate Dealer Services. This platform is a strategic investment in the future of the business, enabling more efficient operations, faster service delivery, improved customer experiences, and long-term cost optimization.

As a technical leader on the team, you will contribute to the architecture, development, and delivery of modern backend services and applications that support key business capabilities. You will partner closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to translate complex operational needs into scalable, reliable, and maintainable technology solutions.

This role includes ownership of applications in production, driving engineering best practices, and helping shape the technical direction of a platform that will modernize how Dealer Services manages claims operations. Your work will directly contribute to reducing operational complexity, accelerating delivery of new capabilities, and improving outcomes for customers and the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and APIs supporting enterprise payment solutions.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including iteration planning, standups, and retrospectives, helping drive continuous improvement across the team.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver customer-focused solutions.
  • Contribute to the architecture, development, and operation of scalable microservices and distributed systems.
  • Apply engineering best practices including clean code principles, test-driven development, code reviews, and automated testing.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes that support reliable software delivery.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and support applications in production environments.
  • Contribute to the codebase while ensuring adherence to coding standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices.

Essential Skills

  • 4+ years of software development experience using Java and J2EE technologies, including Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring IoC, Spring Security, Spring AOP, and related Spring frameworks.
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, including API documentation (Swagger/OpenAPI), versioning, service discovery, testing, and microservice architectures.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented design principles, software design patterns, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience with relational databases, including schema design, indexing strategies, query optimization, and SQL development.
  • Experience with automated testing and Test Driven Development (TDD) using frameworks such as JUnit, Selenium, JBehave, or similar tools.
  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices using tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, SonarQube, Gradle, Maven, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience deploying and operating containerized applications using Kubernetes, Docker, or similar platforms.
  • Experience developing and supporting production services with observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog or equivalent.
  • Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or XP environments.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience building and operating high-volume, distributed systems with a focus on reliability, performance, and scalability.
  • Experience with messaging and event-driven architectures using Kafka or similar technologies.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, PCF, Azure, or equivalent cloud environments.
  • Experience with application security and quality tooling such as SonarQube, Fortify, Contrast, or similar products.
  • Exposure to modern front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, or Angular. While this role is primarily focused on backend engineering, the ability to collaborate across the full stack is a plus.

Experience

  • 5 or more years of experience (preferred)

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

$106,300.00 - $175,400.00

What Is the Opportunity?

We're pleased to announce that our Staff Counsel virtual office in Tulsa, Oklahoma is expanding. We are currently seeking a candidate for a fully remote position based in the Tulsa area.

This position handles liability cases. The ability to manage some Workers' Compensation cases is a plus.

Travelers offers the strength of a national legal organization committed to your professional development while maintaining a local focus, positioning you as a strong business partner and trusted advisor who delivers exceptional value through local expertise and outstanding client service. We handle litigation arising from claims asserted against policyholders or the company and take cases from inception through trial and appeal. As a Counsel with Travelers you will be responsible for high quality, proactive case handling and will have the opportunity to use your legal expertise and litigation skills to handle a caseload of predominantly low to moderate complexity and deliver optimal results for Travelers' insured customers.

What Will You Do?

  • In the handling of a caseload of predominantly low to moderate complexity, your responsibilities will include:
  • Develop and apply effective use of litigation skills and techniques to try cases to verdict or negotiate resolution.
  • Conduct legal research and demonstrate strong and persuasive legal writing and presentation skills.
  • Draft pleadings, motions, briefs, discovery and other documents.
  • Attend court events, depositions, and other appointments independently.
  • Provide case analysis and recommendations to insured clients and claim partners on file handling strategies.

Description

Working under moderate direction, this role manages a book of specialty lines claims across the full claim lifecycle from initial investigation through settlement and closure. The Claims Specialist conducts thorough investigations, recommends appropriate reserves, and resolves claims efficiently and cost-effectively within established authority limits for the line of business.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyzes, investigates, and evaluates losses to determine coverage and appropriate claim disposition
  • Documents claims and sets diaries for follow-up and key events using CMS
  • Establishes appropriate indemnity and expense reserves within assigned settlement authority, reviewing regularly to ensure adequacy; recommends reserve levels for claims exceeding authority
  • Prepares comprehensive claim reports as required
  • Identifies emerging claim trends and account or policy issues, communicating findings to management and underwriting
  • Manages the litigation process, including retaining counsel and overseeing case resolution
  • Ensures adherence to line-of-business litigation guidelines, including budget management, bill review, and payment
  • Actively participates in mediations and arbitrations within assigned settlement authority
  • Participates in the claims audit process
  • May support claims marketing efforts by engaging with brokers, risk managers, and reinsurers
  • Maintains required insurance adjuster licenses

If the selected candidate lives within 50 miles of a GRS office, then the selected candidate must come into the office two days/month.

Qualifications

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred
  • 5+ years of experience in claims handling, legal, or a related field
  • Strong working knowledge of claims handling concepts, practices, and techniques, including coverage issues and product line expertise
  • Solid understanding of insurance law and regulations across multiple jurisdictions
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to resolve claims effectively within authority limits

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience handling HMO and Provider Excess Claims

Description

Who We Are

Liberty Mutual's Global Legal & Compliance (GL&C) organization is in a defining period of transformation. Executing against our 2030 vision, we serve as both a protector of the enterprise and an accelerator of Liberty Mutual's ability to win in the markets where we compete.

GL&C sits at the intersection of risk, regulation, capital, and execution. As our industry faces increasing pressure around AI governance, consumer data privacy, digital claims transformation, cybersecurity resilience, and evolving global insurance regulations, we are choosing to lead.

To fulfill our vision, weare reshaping how legal work is performed, by whom, and with what technology, as generative and agentic AI fundamentally alter legal service delivery. We are deliberately positioning legal and compliance expertise as a strategic differentiator that helps Liberty Mutual adapt faster, operate smarter, and lead confidently in a rapidly changing global landscape.

About the Role

Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer as a full member of the GL&C Leadership Team, you will lead GL&C's operational engine: the shared legal services teams, centralized Home Office paralegal organization, business process outsourcing, performance intelligence, and work evolution capability that make the department scalable, measurable, and continuously improving.

You will oversee an estimated 46 senior leaders and approximately 50100 professionals across shared services, the Home Office paralegal organization, and outsourced delivery and serve as co-architect of how GL&C evolves.

Key partners include: Strategy, Intelligence & Integration (SII) Leader; GL&C Leadership Team; GL&C Data Office Leader; and People, Purpose & Brand.

What You'll Do

  • Own and operate the work evolution decision engine. Design and continuously run the framework that decomposes GL&C work by intrinsic characteristics, assesses technology maturity, selects the optimal delivery model, and governs re-evaluation triggers as the landscape evolves. Maintain a single, coherent view of how the department's work gets done, ensuring delivery model decisions are data-driven, defensible, and continuously updated.

  • Lead scaled shared services delivery and the centralized Home Office paralegal organization. Own and operate GL&C's centralized legal shared services, outsourced delivery programs, and Home Office paralegal organization as a unified operating model driving volume, quality, cycle time, and cost outcomes from a single platform. Define and enforce consistent professional standards, career architecture, and AI adoption requirements across the paralegal population, ensuring a single bar for quality, development, and performance. Expand the scope and sophistication of centralized delivery as technology and organizational readiness allow.

  • Drive productivity and affordability outcomes. Own accountability for productivity improvements within the Performance & Execution portfolio, contributing toward GL&C's sustained 34% annual productivity improvement. Translate affordability commitments into operational plans that harvest savings through work model shifts, technology adoption, and optimized leverage across delivery models. Provide credible, measurable evidence of value delivery, connecting operational execution to financial impact with the rigor expected by the CLO and enterprise leadership.

  • Build and govern performance intelligence. Establish the measurement infrastructure that gives GL&C leaders visibility into delivery performance, capacity utilization, cost to serve, and work evolution progress enabling leaders to manage with data rather than anecdote. You will define what GL&C measures and the standards behind it.

  • Partner with advisory, litigation, and compliance groups to transform work. Serve as the enterprise-wide partner to practice groups in identifying work suitable for delivery model shifts AI automation, paralegal leverage, BPO, shared services, and self-service challenging inertia constructively with data and an outside-in perspective. Develop deep understanding of peer priorities and business rhythms so that shared delivery teams continuously meet, adjust to, and anticipate practice group needs while driving transformation forward.

  • Integrate and scale technology-enabled delivery. Ensure the function is AI-native, embedding generative and agentic AI into core processes as standard practice. In partnership with SI&I's Data Office, identify and operationalize automation that measurably accelerates process time, reduces cost to serve, or frees capacity for higher-judgment work. Define and advocate for the technology enablement priorities of the portfolio technology or funding decisions affecting delivery models or productivity commitments do not move forward without this function's sign-off on operational feasibility and sequencing.

  • Build a high-performing, integrated organization. Integrate previously separate teams into one cohesive function with shared vision, aligned KPIs, and a unified operating model. Serve as the department's performance truth-teller, surfacing delivery data, productivity trends, and capability gaps with clarity and candor. Build leadership capability within the function, recruit operational, analytical, and change management talent, and drive work evolution as a leadership requirement across GL&C.

  • Establish governance and decision rights. Define clear decision rights for delivery model selection, work migration, shared service delivery, paralegal standards, and performance measurement governance that allows teams to move at pace while remaining rigorous enough to be defensible. Operate shared prioritization governance with SI&I, with neither portfolio making material decisions without the other's input.

What You'll Bring

  • Operational rigor and execution discipline at scale. You think and operate as a scaled delivery leader building systems, processes, and measurement frameworks that produce repeatable results, managing through metrics, and connecting operational decisions to financial impact. You are skilled at integrating previously separate teams into a unified operating model, and at managing the dynamics of professionals who are organizationally centralized but operationally deployed to client groups.

  • Performance measurement and data-driven leadership. You use data as the primary language of leadership for prioritization, performance management, and investment decisions. You design measurement infrastructure, define the standards and quality thresholds that create consistency at enterprise scale, and translate complex performance data into executive-ready narratives that drive action.

  • Change leadership and cross-functional influence. You credibly challenge how work has always been done, using data, constructive framing, and respect for domain expertise. You are particularly skilled at moving service delivery from embedded to centralized while building trust that centralized models can meet practice group needs earning the right to drive change through demonstrated results, including with groups outside your reporting line.

  • Workforce development. A track record building career architectures, development programs, and professional communities that attract, retain, and grow paralegal, operations, and analytics talent as a strategic workforce asset.

  • Legal industry fluency and technology depth. You do not need to be a lawyer, but you must be credible enough to distinguish work that carries genuine legal, regulatory, or reputational risk from work that can be safely delivered through alternative models earning the trust of senior legal professionals who will scrutinize those decisions. You bring an operator-level understanding of how generative and agentic AI reshape legal work delivery, translating capability into operating model decisions, along with regulated-industry experience in financial services or insurance.

  • Partnership and interdependent leadership. You are comfortable with shared accountability and mutual dependency, maintaining clear lanes while collaborating deeply as one half of a leadership dyad.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, J.D., or equivalent) preferred
  • Generally requires 15+ years of progressive experience in operations, shared services, business process outsourcing, transformation or professional services delivery leadership,
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizations of comparable scale, including managing leaders-of-leaders
  • Proven experience owning a scaled service delivery operation shared services, managed services, BPO, or centralized professional services delivery with accountability for cost, quality, and cycle time outcomes
  • Demonstrated experience leading operating model transformation and AI-enabled work evolution in a large, complex, matrixed organization
  • Experience in a regulated industry financial services, insurance, or legal services strongly preferred
  • Legal industry experience valued (not required)

Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance. Liberty Mutual Insurance is actively searching for an experienced System Support Analyst. In this role you will use business and technical knowledge to participate in the re-engineering of business operations to improve business results. Evaluate business requirements and models data and/or system requirements. Analyze and document business problems of moderate complexity. Develops test plans and tests and approves new system behaviors. Coordinates upgrades and rollouts of moderate scope.

As a Systems Support Analyst (SSA) supporting the Forms & Output Delivery portfolio , you will serve as the essential domain and technical liaison across Personal Lines product programs. In this space, you will specialize in pre-bind and post-bind form generation, output publishing pipelines, and regulatory/statistical data integrity. Working closely with Product Owners, Compliance, Forms Analysts, and Engineering squads, you will analyze state and countrywide rule rollouts, troubleshoot print and data distribution pipelines, and validate policy outputs from quote creation through issuance and reporting.

Key Responsibilities & Core Work in this Space:

  • Pre-Bind Forms Modernization & UI Integration: Support quote-and-bind platforms across current rating programs by defining and testing print logic, screen displays, and dynamic templates for Quote Summaries, Applications, Package Selection forms, and Endorsement Coverage Confirmations (ECC).

State Rollout & Compliance Implementation:

  • Translate state regulatory mandates and product feature rollouts into precise form triggers, suppression rules, and variable tag requirements.

Output Publishing & STAT Data Investigation:

  • Research and resolve discrepancies in downstream statistical and regulatory data feeds, analyzing underlying payload logic and maintaining publishing mapping documentation.

Forms Generation & Distribution Pipelines:

  • Partner with engineering squads on vehicle and property forms generation services (forms-api, Forms-Batch, Vehicle-Orchestrator), ensuring accurate form edition versioning, binder generation, and proposal distribution without downstream delivery exceptions.

Payload Analysis, Defect Triage & Test Data Enablement:

  • Conduct root-cause investigations on production print errors (e.g., XML payload mismatches, regex validation failures) by querying policy data, creating non-prod test scenarios, and providing verified test policies for developer and QA validation.

This is a remote position for candidates who reside within 50 miles of a hub office, will be required to go in office 2 days per week. Please note this policy is subject to change.

  • General knowledge of business operations, objectives and strategies as well as business process and information flow.
  • General knowledge of IT concepts, strategies and methodologies.
  • General knowledge of diverse technologies and new and current architectures.
  • General understanding ofre-engineering issues and challenges.
  • Skills in object, data and/or process modeling; financial analysis and planning; business process design.
  • Negotiation skills; oral and written communication skills.

Description

This is an exciting opportunity to join our rotational Actuarial Development Program as an experienced professional!

In this role, you will be a key piece of the team that provides full economic and analytical support and drives the profitable growth of the multi-billion personal specialty lines of business. Specifically, you will lead the actuarial work of the newly launched Pet Insurance line by working closely with a wide range of stakeholders throughout the organization. The key responsibilities of this role are to perform actuarial rate indications of the pet insurance products, provide external actuarial support to Departments of Insurance, construct rate strategies, evaluate and monitor product performance, and provide other analytical services with actuarial and line-of-business expertise. As a member of the Specialty Economics organization, you will also work with a group of talented analysts on impactful crossline initiatives and develop subject matter expertise.

**This position may have in-office requirements dependent upon candidate location. **

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain status in Actuarial Development Program
  • Produce Actuarial rate level indications for the Pet Insurance products.
  • Research and identify drivers of performance and trends and develop actionable rate and non-rate recommendations to drive profit improvement and profitable growth.
  • Provide actuarial support for pet insurance filings for rate and other new initiatives
  • Develop line-of-business expertise for the pet products and deliver robust profitability views that reflect the latest opinions on experience, trends, and initiatives.
  • Effectively communicate project/analysis findings and recommendations to team members and stakeholders throughout the organization.
  • Build effective stakeholder relationships and influence decisions and actions on recommended product strategies.
  • Retrieve, understands and manipulates data as it relates to assigned and related actuarial projects.
  • Lead and support crossline initiatives and other ad hoc projects as necessary.
  • Proactively identify and act on method and process improvement opportunities.
  • Practice and promote analytical, documentation, and other actuarial best practices.
  • Positive progress towards pursuing and passing of required actuarial exams.

Qualifications

The person hired into this role will become a part of our Actuarial Development Program and will rotate within the first two years of hire as part of the Development Program. A requirement of this program is to make positive progress towards achieving ACAS/FCAS.

As an Actuarial Development Program participant, youll be a valued member of a collaborative community of actuarial teammates. In this entry-level rotational program, youll complete two rotations across a variety of disciplines, including reserving, pricing, modelling, and analytics. This role will count as your first rotation.

  • Proven math and analytical skills, as normally acquired through the pursuit of a bachelors degree in mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science, or related field.
  • Commitment to achieving Associateship in the Casualty Actuarial Society.
  • Passing grades on a minimum of 2 Casualty Actuarial Exams is required (MAS I, MAS II, Exam 5, Exam 6).
  • Minimum 2-4 years relevant experience required.
  • Prior experience and knowledge of basic actuarial techniques and standards and insurance operations.
  • Solid oral and written and presentation communication skills.
  • Solid interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a team environment as well as independently.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and apply independent judgment and critical thinking skills in execution of assignments.
  • Ability to balance multiple projects with some direction.
  • Intermediate MS Office Excel and SAS skills
  • Ability to build simple models; Programming skills are desirable.

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$52,600.00 - $86,800.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Outside Property, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage 1st party property claims. This program is typically 9-12 months and upon successful completion of this program you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility. This position is based remotely with work at residential and commercial locations with a combination of mobile work, work from your primary residence, or the nearest Travelers office.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Review, investigate, and document 1st party property claims under direct supervision.
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third-party providers.
  • Learn to investigate and evaluate all relevant facts and information (including but not limited to analyzing leases, contracts, by-laws and other relevant documents which may have an impact). Determine and apply coverage for building damages per policy terms.
  • Establish accurate scope of damages for building and contents losses and utilizes as a basis for written estimates and/or computer assisted estimates.
  • Provide timely and professional communication to customers, claimants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning, particularly in AI and digital transformation.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) and/or a UAS Remote Pilot Certification to comply with federal, state, and Travelers requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Assess and inspect all areas of a dwelling or structure, including roofs, attics, crawl spaces, and other confined areas. Ability to carry, set up, and climb ladders weighing approximately 38-49 pounds.
  • May require extensive travel, including overnight stays, to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.
