The Senior Growth Marketing Manager will help shape how Global Housing communicates with consumers through the customer lifecycle. This hands-on role blends B2C growth marketing, customer experience, lifecycle communications, digital strategy and disciplined execution. You will serve as a key partner for stakeholder requests, map communication journeys, recommend the right channels and coordinate work across Marketing, CX, Product, Technology, Analytics, Creative, Operations and Legal/Compliance.

The near-term focus is to help stabilize and strengthen customer communications as ownership transitions into Marketing, initially supporting Renters and Specialty. Over time, the role can help define a broader Housing communication journey and establish scalable processes, governance and optimization practices.


Why This Role?

  • Influence a developing operating model as Marketing takes on broader responsibility for customer communications.
  • Bring B2C and customer journey expertise to a team that is actively building new processes rather than inheriting a mature playbook.
  • Own visible, cross-functional work that connects customer experience, communication strategy, digital execution and measurable performance.
  • Help improve how consumers experience communications across the full lifecycle, with room to expand impact across Global Housing over time.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

  • Own and coordinate intake for new and changing customer communications, translating stakeholder needs into clear briefs, timelines and executable plans.
  • Map and manage communications across the customer lifecycle, including acquisition, onboarding, transactional, engagement, cross-sell/up-sell, retention and other key touchpoints.
  • Apply a consumer-first lens to requested tactics. Challenge assumptions when appropriate and recommend the channel, timing and approach most likely to improve the customer experience and business outcome.
  • Coordinate content, creative, digital/email deployment, technology, analytics, operations, sales/client partners and Legal/Compliance to move communications from concept through approval and launch.
  • Build and maintain communication inventories, journey maps, ownership documentation, approval workflows, calendars and repeatable governance processes.
  • Monitor campaign and communication performance, interpret engagement and customer data, and present clear findings, recommendations and next steps.
  • Identify gaps, redundancies and pain points across communications and recommend opportunities for optimization, personalization, testing and improved digital experiences.
  • Support consumer websites and portals, including the e-commerce experience, by identifying conversion, content, customer experience, SEO and AI-search visibility opportunities in partnership with digital and development teams.
  • Explore practical uses of marketing technology, automation and AI to improve communications, analytics, personalization, content development and marketing efficiency.
  • Manage projects end to end in an evolving environment, creating structure where processes are still being established.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of progressive B2C marketing experience focused on digital marketing, consumer marketing, e-commerce, customer communications, and/or market research.
  • Proven experience developing and executing multi-channel B2C marketing campaigns, promotions, and customer lifecycle marketing strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to map customer journeys, leverage customer insights, and translate findings into effective communication and marketing strategies.
  • Experience partnering with clients, business leaders, and stakeholders to develop and implement successful marketing initiatives.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • 8+ years of relevant marketing experience with depth in digital, e-commerce, consumer marketing, research and analytics.
  • 5+ years of experience supporting customer experience, lifecycle marketing, customer communications and/or customer journey mapping.
  • Deep Customer Experience expertise with demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a marketing environment.
  • Experience using consumer, campaign and market data to identify insights and influence marketing decisions.
  • Knowledge of marketing technology and analytics tools, including Google Analytics (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.
  • Experience with omnichannel communications, CRM, retention/engagement, marketing automation or digital optimization.
  • Self-directed approach with strong accountability, curiosity and the ability to build from ambiguity.
  • Bilingual capability.

Job.JobTitle: Full Stack Software Engineer Senior Consultant II
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

About Law & Regulations
Law & Regulations delivers expert legal services that protect Allstate and its customers while ensuring compliance with evolving regulatory and ethical standards. We provide comprehensive support across claims litigation, complex corporate transactions, and enterprise wide compliance programs, enabling the business to confidently navigate todays legal landscape.
By leveraging innovative legal strategies and modern technology, we promote seamless collaboration, proactive risk management, and effective problem solving across the organization. We demonstrate our core values through integrity, accountability, collaboration, and excellence. We are trusted legal advisors who place the needs of our customers and business partners at the heart of everything we do. We value each other, seek feedback, and take meaningful action to continuously improve.
Our collective success is enabled by collaboration across all areas of responsibility within Allstate and by upholding the legal and ethical foundation that drives business performance.
What We Deliver
Exceptional Legal Support: Expert counsel and representation that safeguard Allstates interests and support our customers.
Compliance & Ethical Governance: Oversight of enterprise wide privacy, regulatory compliance, and ethics programs.
Innovative Legal Operations: Use of agile processes and modern technologies to enhance operational efficiency and service delivery

The Full Stack Developer is a hands on, full stack engineer responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications and integrations that enable critical business operations. This role spans backend systems, frontend UI, and integration layers, delivering secure, scalable, and high quality solutions that meet business needs.
The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical execution, effective problem solving abilities, and the ability to work successfully within a large scale enterprise environment that requires adherence to governance, compliance, and security standards. The role includes partial ownership of technical solutions and active participation in design and architectural discussions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications and cloud-native microservices.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
  • Actively contribute to software development efforts by writing, reviewing, and maintaining high-quality, scalable, and secure code.
  • Design and implement solutions leveraging LLMs, Generative AI, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)architectures.
  • Collaborate with product managers, architects, and cross-functional teams to define technical solutions and deliver business outcomes.
  • Integrate AI/ML services and APIs into enterprise applications while following engineering and security best practices.
  • Troubleshoot, optimize, and enhance application performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Functional Skills

  • Hands-on experience architecting, designing, implementing, and delivering cloud-native applications and distributed systems.
  • 4+ yearsof software development experience, preferably using Java, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and React.
  • Experience building and integrating AI-powered applications and services.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, RESTful APIs, databases, and security best practices.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and managing REST APIs.
  • Knowledge of web and API security frameworks.
  • Experience with relational databases (MS SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DocumentDB), vector databases, Kafka, caching, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and data pipeline design.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • UI development experience using React and modern front-end frameworks.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute effectively within a cross-functional team.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (Preferred)
  • 4+ years of software engineering experience (Preferred)

Skills

  • Cloud Platforms:Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, ADLS), AWS
  • Containerization & Orchestration:Kubernetes, Docker, AWS EKS, Linux
  • Programming:Java, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React
  • DevOps & Automation:Jenkins CI/CD, MLOps, Pipeline Orchestration
  • Data & Databases:SQL Server, MongoDB, DocumentDB, Vector Databases
  • AI/ML & LLM Tools:LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI

Job.JobTitle: Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental -
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Take your complex claims expertise to the next level in a highly specialized role focused on some of the most challenging exposures in the casualty space.

As a Senior Claims Consultant Mass Tort & Environmental, you will independently manage sophisticated legacy and long-latency claims involving asbestos, environmental contamination, talc, PFAS, and other mass tort exposures. You will apply advanced coverage analysis, strategic claims handling, negotiation, and litigation management skills to claims arising from historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.

This is an opportunity to join a specialized team where your judgment, technical expertise, and ability to navigate complex coverage issues will have a direct impact. The role supports claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and Canada and offers significant autonomy in managing complex matters from evaluation through resolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Complex Claims & Coverage Analysis

  • Independently manage complex, high-exposure casualty claims involving historical CGL, umbrella, and excess liability policies.
  • Analyze historical policy language, underlying facts, applicable law, and long-latency exposures to determine coverage positions and claims strategy.
  • Manage legacy runoff claims arising primarily from policies issued during the 1970s through the mid-1980s.
  • Develop thoughtful, well-supported strategies for resolving complex coverage and liability issues.

Mass Tort & Environmental Claims

  • Handle complex asbestos bodily injury, talc, PFAS, environmental contamination, and other mass tort claims.
  • Evaluate environmental exposures involving soil and groundwater contamination and remediation.
  • Manage claims involving large commercial and industrial insureds with significant liability exposure.
  • Navigate complex, multi-jurisdictional claims across the U.S. and Canada.

Litigation, Negotiation & Resolution

  • Manage litigated claims and coverage actions involving Allstate.
  • Partner with internal and external counsel to develop effective litigation and resolution strategies.
  • Participate in mediations, arbitrations, settlement negotiations, and other dispute-resolution activities.
  • Serve as a witness when required.

Financial & Strategic Management

  • Establish, document, and adjust case reserves and financial projections based on evolving claim exposure.
  • Develop and execute strategic action plans designed to move complex claims toward resolution.
  • Provide clear, well-supported analysis and recommendations to key stakeholders.

Caseload & Operational Excellence

  • Independently manage a diverse portfolio of complex claims while maintaining accurate and thorough documentation.
  • Ensure claim files comply with applicable internal guidelines and standards.
  • Work effectively across multiple claims systems and adapt to evolving technology and AI-supported workflows.
  • Communicate complex coverage and claim issues clearly and effectively in both written and verbal settings.

What You Bring:


Preferred Experience

  • 3+ years of experience handling mass tort, asbestos, environmental, or other long-latency claims.
  • Casualty claims experience involving complex coverage analysis, excess liability policies, or legacy runoff portfolios strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing claims across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and/or Canada.
  • Experience with litigation, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, or complex claim resolution.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong knowledge of complex casualty claims and coverage analysis.
  • Ability to interpret and apply historical insurance policy language.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven negotiation and settlement capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage complex, high-exposure matters and competing priorities.
  • Comfort working across multiple systems and adapting to new technology and AI-supported processes.
  • High level of ownership, sound judgment, and accountability in a remote environment.

Why This Role

This opportunity is ideal for a seasoned claims professional who enjoys digging into complex coverage questions, sophisticated litigation, historical policies, and high-exposure claims. You will have the autonomy to own challenging matters while collaborating with experienced claims professionals and legal partners on issues that require both technical expertise and strategic thinking.


Work Environment

  • Remote-friendly opportunity within a highly specialized claims team.
  • Independent role suited for a self-starter who is comfortable taking ownership of complex matters.
  • Collaborative environment with exposure to legal partners and sophisticated casualty claims.

Skills

Claims Administration, Claims Resolution, Complex Claims, Mass Torts, Settlement Negotiations

Compensation

Compensation offered for this role is 0.00 - 0.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

Job.JobTitle: Large Loss Risk Adjuster - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Senior Consultant II is responsible for granting settlement authority on highly complex claims valued in excess of Market Claim Office (MCO) and Regional Claim Office (RCO) limits, providing recommendations on requests to go to trial on cases where the gross exposure is in excess of MCO authority, and general oversight of all large losses for a specific CSA or CSAs. The individual may also provide discretionary referrals on coverage issues, opinions and research. In addition, the Sr Cons II may provide approval on Closed Without Payment (CWP) requests where liability is disputed, and the value is in excess of Field authority.

We are seeking Large Loss Risk Adjusters to join our growing team! This team manages complex, high exposure claims involving policy limits up to 100/300, including rejected tenders and extra-contractual exposures claims. Claims often involve severe injuries, such as catastrophic impairments, amputations, comas, and fatalities. The ideal candidate will have prior experience handling large loss claims, navigating complex liability issues, and managing litigation through resolution. Strong investigative, negotiation, and risk assessment skills are essential for success in this role. We are open to candidates in the eastern time zone states.








Key Responsibilities

Performs file reviews for various complex projects or for cases in litigation, analyzes data, and reports findings

May review cases to determine if CWP is appropriate given gross tort value exposure

Supports the Field with discretionary referrals on complex coverage issues and engages Home Office Claim litigation for involvement and direction as needed

Reviews coverage, liability, and/or damages on highly complex cases referred for authorization and collaborates with Field leadership on addition steps to be taken and other feedback and direction

Collaborates with Frontline Performance Experts (FPEs), Frontline Performance Leaders (FPLS), and Claim Process Specialists (CPSs) to share experience and trends identified in referred cases

Works with Product, Protection, Law, and Claims on new products introduced to the Field and the sales force, and develops Claim Bulletins to provide new forms and/or endorsements that impact claim handling practices



Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.



As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Job.JobTitle: Privacy Counsel, Law & Regulation (IL, NC, TX, AZ, NY, CA)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated, business-minded attorney with deep privacy expertise who is excited to work at the intersection of law, technology, data, mobility, and consumer innovation. This is a unique opportunity to join Arity's legal team and help shape the future of data-driven products and services in an increasingly complex and evolving regulatory landscape.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted legal advisor to Arity, Allstate's mobility and technology subsidiary, providing practical, real-time, and strategic counsel on a broad range of privacy, data governance, emerging technology, and regulatory compliance matters. You will partner closely with business, product, technology, marketing, and data teams to enable innovation while effectively managing legal and regulatory risk.

As a recognized subject matter expert in state privacy laws and emerging privacy regulations, you will play a key role in developing scalable compliance strategies, advising on novel business initiatives, new data models and products, and influencing cross-functional decision-making. The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and has a proven ability to drive solutions, build consensus, and deliver results across diverse stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities & Core Competencies


  • Serve as a trusted privacy advisor providing strategic counsel on U.S. state privacy laws, GDPR, and other global privacy frameworks. Conduct complex legal analysis to determine the applicability of laws, regulations, exemptions, and compliance requirements across evolving business models and technologies.

  • Partner proactively with privacy program leads to ensure ongoing compliance with existing legal and regulatory requirements while supporting the implementation of emerging privacy, data governance, and artificial intelligence (AI) regulations.

  • Provide legal counsel to advertising, marketing, and product teams across the audience lifecycle, including audience creation, activation, measurement, attribution, and the deployment of tags, pixels, SDKs, and related technologies. Advise on consent management, consumer choice mechanisms, and regulatory requirements governing data collection and use.

  • Advise on Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) matters related to the collection, use, and sharing of consumer report data, including permissible purpose requirements, notice obligations, and disclosure considerations.

  • Lead privacy support for complex data-driven transactions and commercial arrangements, including data licensing agreements, data supply agreements, clean room agreements, strategic partnerships, and other transactions where data rights and regulatory considerations are critical.

  • Counsel business stakeholders on data strategy and governance matters, including data provenance, permitted use rights, consumer-facing disclosures, data sharing practices, licensing rights, retention requirements, and data lifecycle management.

  • Collaborate effectively across Law & Regulation, product, technology, marketing, data, compliance, and business teams to support strategic initiatives and deliver practical, business-oriented legal solutions.

  • Anticipate legal and regulatory developments, identify potential risks, and develop creative, solution-oriented approaches that enable innovation while appropriately managing legal exposure.

  • Conduct risk-benefit analyses of key business initiatives, considering enterprise-wide implications and providing actionable recommendations to support informed decision-making.

  • Advise business partners on emerging legal, regulatory, technology, and risk management issues affecting the organization.

  • Play a key role in executing legal strategy, driving action plans, and fostering effective communication and alignment across business units and legal stakeholders.

Location & Travel Requirements


  • This role is fully remote and includes travel as needed to support business objectives and team collaboration. We welcome candidates from across the United States, with a preference for those located in Illinois, North Carolina, Texas, Arizona, New York, or California.

Education & Experience


  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree required; active license to practice law and in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive legal experience within a law firm and/or in-house legal department supporting a mid-sized to large organization.

  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more of the following areas: privacy, advertising technology (AdTech), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), technology transactions, commercial contracting, data governance, and/or other highly regulated industries.

  • Experience advising within corporate structures, including parent companies and affiliated entities, with the ability to navigate diverse business and regulatory environments.

  • Proven ability to provide strategic legal counsel that balances risk management with business objectives.

Key Competencies


  • Leadership capabilities, with experience building, developing, mentoring, and guiding high-performing teams.

  • Executive presence with strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and translate complex legal concepts into practical business guidance.

  • Demonstrated business acumen with the ability to assess legal and operational risks, develop business cases, and quantify return on investment for strategic initiatives.

  • Effective budget management and resource planning experience.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

  • High degree of professionalism, integrity, and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and other technology tools relevant to the practice of law and business operations.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This job does not have supervisory duties

Advertising Technologies, Advertising Technologies, Business Initiatives, Collaboration, Consultation, Counseling, Cybersecurity, Data Privacy, Data Privacy Law, Data Privacy Standards, Data Protection Privacy, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Global Privacy, Legal Advisory, Legal Consulting, Legal Research, Negotiation, Prioritization, Privacy Awareness, Privacy Compliance, Privacy Laws, Privacy Management, Privacy Protection, Privacy Regulations, Strategic Collaborations {+ 4 more}

Job.JobDescription:
Become an integral part of our technical team as an Animations Technician, where youll play a vital role in maintaining and ensuring the safe operation of ride systems and show-quality elements across the theme park. Reporting to the Animations Foreman/Gang Boss, youll collaborate closely with team members to monitor technical equipment, conduct daily inspections, perform repairs, and complete preventative maintenance on show characters, effects, ride vehicles, and other animation elements.In this role, youll be responsible for maintaining the accuracy of parts and ensuring accountability while adhering to strict safety protocols, guidelines, and quality control standards. Your problem-solving skills will be essential for troubleshooting technical issues, resolving conflicts, and addressing challenges in high-pressure situations. Additionally, youll support the team by organizing and allocating resources, completing administrative tasks, and providing timely and precise communication to internal departments and external partners. A strong working knowledge of technical disciplinesincluding mechanical/structural, hydraulic/pneumatic, electrical/electronic systems, and program logic controllersis essential. Your dedication to teamwork, precision, and delivering exceptional results will ensure immersive and memorable experiences for guests of all ages.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in all attraction maintenance functions assigned. Respond and resolve maintenance issues that affect show quality of all characters, effects and ride vehicles in a timely manner.  Allocate resources as needed.  Ensure that work is performed correctly and follows approved procedures for ride system safety, show quality, operation and compliance of all rides, shows and effects in the park. 
  • Communicate accurately matters regarding the operational status of all attractions and show venues to the Gang Boss and/or Foreman as well as department heads as it pertains to the Animations department.
  • Support animations requests of all operating groups/departments within USH in a timely and professional manner.
  • Adhere to all Standard Operating Procedures within Technical Services and USH at large.  Understand and demonstrate the proper use of safety practices and ensure department standards are maintained and safety policies for the Park upheld. 
  • Maintains machines and equipment in safe, operating order. Complete daily inspection sheets and related repairs.  Ensure that work performed is correctly documented. Ensure that unscheduled work performed is correctly documented
  • Assist in the development and implementation of processes which enhance system efficiencies and increase productivity
  • Maintain proficiency in all areas as it pertains to his/her area(s) of responsibilities assigned.
  • Maintains and controls inventories at levels adequate to sustain efficient operations. 
  • Promote and provide extraordinary guest service for both internal and external guests; answer questions and offer information in a courteous manner.  Seek to provide assistance to guests, where appropriate.
  • Assist other technical staff in assessing and resolving technical failures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Desired Characteristics

  • Theme Park Operations knowledge and experience
  • Excellent organizational, verbal and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work with all levels of employees and management, and willingness to give assistance to co-workers.   Strong team player.
  • Strong interpersonal and analytical skills
  • Strong time management skills
  • Ability to multi-task and be flexible is essential

Requirements:

  • Eligible candidates must be fully available to work early mornings, mid-day, afternoon, evening, late night, and/or overnight shifts, including weekdays, weekends, and holidays.
  • College degree or Technical School Certification and/or Specialized Technical training in applicable disciplines
  • Must possess a broad knowledge of the following disciplines: Electrical/electronic, Hydraulic/pneumatic, Mechanical/Structural, Welding/Fabricating, Program Logic Controllers (PLC), Machining, Inventory Control Inspection, Quality control procedures
  • Experienced in metal fabrication, designs and technical blueprints for all the disciplines listed above
  • Must possess excellent interpersonal communication skills both verbal and written on a technical level
  • Flexible to daily/weekly schedule changes
  • Able to work independently
  • Requires moderate to heavy physical exertion
  • Must be able to lift, carry, push, pull heavy materials and objects up to 50lbs.
  • Must be able to stand, walk, bend, stoop, climb, etc. for extended periods of time
  • 1-3 years technical and trade experience
  • Basic understanding of the disciplines related to Electrical/Electronic Hydraulic/Pneumatic Mechanical/Structural and Program Logic Controllers (PLC)
  • Basic understanding of metal fabrication, designs and blueprints
  • Ability & willingness to work overtime, weekends and holidays.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint

Pay:

  • The pay rate for this role is $32.78 per hour

 

Additional Information:

Job.JobTitle: Lead/Sergeant, Security Officer - Universal Kids Resort
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Supports leadership in directing and coordinating safety and prevention activities for Guests and Team Members at Universal Kids Resort (UKR). Oversees the daily Security Operations and serves as the first point-of-contact for Uniformed Security Officers, Guests, and interdivisional partners. Responds to situations and manages reporting of incidents, ensuring accurate information is represented. Accountable for Security Officer on-the-job training, daily placement, and feedback on security services performance.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assists in overseeing multiple shifts for Uniformed Security Officers who oversee security operations at Universal Kids Resort. Provides work direction to Uniformed Officers to respond and direct personnel during routine or emergency situations ensuring appropriate response and correct information is gathered for reporting purposes. Utilizes approved programs/technology for accountability of equipment, attendance, position assignment, and other functions as directed.
  • Serves as the first point-of-contact for Uniformed Officers and Guests, responding to escalated Guest situations, emergency situations, etc., and completing accurate reporting. Escalates to Security leadership for resolution as necessary. Communicates performance, behavior standards, and expectations; provides feedback for recognition and performance improvement. Completes and maintains daily incident reports for Guest situations/incidents, accurately representing witness statements documented throughout the operation and resort.
  • Responsible for the consistent execution of world-class Guest service, operational standards and motivating Team Members across Universal Kids Resort. Conducts daily shift meetings, engages in safety spot talks, and documents Team Member performance. Aids in the dissemination of general company information and resort-wide procedural changes. Effectively applies the Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) service model to satisfy and resolve the needs of Guests and Team Members.
  • Conducts on-the-job training, working closely with Management to ensure that Team Members have successfully completed their training plan. Monitors trainees throughout their onboarding and training to ensure operational proficiency. Meets with Team Members to review their training progress, addresses concerns, documents training-related issues, and ensures Team Member readiness for the job responsibilities.
  • Performs all administrative duties related to the daily operation including monitoring daily staffing levels and rotation schedules, ensuring they are adjusted according to park attendance, completing opening and closing checklists, safety procedures, and maintaining operating supplies. Maintains overtime reports and ensuring accurate daily incident reporting procedures are being met. Reviews timekeeping to ensure that time is properly entered based on job code and functional area and approves daily UKG scheduling request changes.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.
  • Must be able to work a flexible and varying schedule based on business needs.
  • A background check is mandatory, and results must meet Universal Destinations and Experiences background check criteria.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Ability to administer CPR and/or First Aid with proper operation of an AED (Automated External Defibrillator).
  • Basic computer proficiency and strong communications skills.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES:

  • Required to successfully attend and pass all recurring mandatory/legal licenses and certifications as a condition of employment.
  • Level 2 (Non-Commissioned) Security License is required.

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years of relevant security or military experience is required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Responsible for the management of Security Operations for Universal Kids Resort (UKR), including the theme park and hotel. Provides leadership to all hourly Team Members and Uniformed Officers, oversees all shifts, including 3rd shift and non-operating days. Acts as a liaison between Frisco law enforcement, fire and medical agencies and third-party security for shared intelligence and coordination for emergency response and planning in partnership with UKR Leadership and UDX stakeholders.

Provides administration and management of automated and technical security systems and equipment designed to monitor, control, and safeguard Guests and Team Members, their property, and physical assets of UKR. Job.JobTitle: Technician, Ride & Show Maintenance - Universal Kids Resort
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Construction & Skilled Trades, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for attraction recovery, preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Universal Kids Resort attractions, show and water play areas. Responsible for troubleshooting all ride and show mechanical aspects and systems of the attractions following OEM specifications and requirements. Assists with repair of animation, special effects, and water elements.  

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responds to and assists in the recovery and repair of attractions, show effects, and water play areas. Troubleshoots down to failed components using schematics, leak detection equipment, vibration analysis, and other specialized tools and equipment.
  • Performs preventative and predictive maintenance as prescribed by OEM or engineering team, both internal and third-party specifications. This would include changing time-limited parts, calibrating equipment per OEM specifications, filtration systems, and cleaning, lubricating, and maintaining equipment. Responsible for the disassembly and required repairs and replacements for mechanical components during annual inspections on ride vehicles. Verifies all quality control and NDT requirements have been met prior to assembly.  
  • Completes inspections and creates necessary work orders for discrepancies found. Follows correct chain of command to notify Ride & Show Management when necessary. 
  • Performs repairs to equipment due to safety, reliability, or show quality issues found during preventative maintenance, daily inspections or downtimes to improve ride reliability and show quality. Performs modifications per engineering team, both internal and third party or OEM specifications. 
  • Enters follow-up work orders for all discrepancies found in a timely manner. Documents all findings and work performed throughout the process of troubleshooting and performing repairs. Reports on labor in Maximo for all work performed. Demonstrates the ability to acquire skills in additional disciplines to support a broader range of operational and project needs. 
  • Completes PQS qualification across UKRs attractions, shows, and water play areas. Trains new Technicians to do venue-specific PM work orders, recovery procedures, and processes. Assists with seasonal weather condition sustainment initiatives as directed. 

  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities. 

  • Perform other duties as assigned. 

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY

  • Individual Contributor  

ADDIITONAL INFORMATION

  • Must be willing to work varying hours, including evenings and weekends, to support seasonal maintenance initiatives.  

  • Training is required and will be provided prior to performing the inspections. 

QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Ability to work in a team environment.  

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement. 

EDUCATION

  • High School Diploma or GED is required; Associates or Technical degree in related field is preferred.

EXPERIENCE

  • 3+ years of experience in troubleshooting and repair of electro-mechanical systems, as well as hydraulic and mechanical systems either in the theme park industry or other industrial industries; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobDescription:
Description

If youre looking for a claims role where you can make a real impactnot just manage a deskthis is it. Our Construction Liability team handles moderate to high-exposure 3rd party bodily injury and general liability property damage claims for some of the largest owner/developers, general contractors, and subcontractors across the country. From NY Labor Law and OCIP/CCIP programs to auto accidents, road construction losses, underground utility strikes, and major liability exposures tied to active job sites across the Country, the work is challenging, fast-moving, and meaningful.

The Senior Claims Specialist works within a Claims Team navigating some of the most challenging construction claims in the industry. You will work in a team of claims professionals who may work in office or remote depending on their location. You will partner with a strong leadership team that values accountability, collaboration, and growth. If you enjoy working along top talent, making tough decisions, and being part of a team that takes pride in doing the right thing at the right time, this is a place where you can build something bigger than just your next role.

This includes making decisions about liability/compensability, evaluating losses, negotiating settlements and managing an inventory of commercial property/casualty claims involving bodily injury or property loss. The Senior Claims Specialist may also assist the Claims Team Manager with assigning new claims to team members, providing technical direction, and monitoring caseloads.

This is a remote position. You will be required to go into the office twice a month if you reside within 50 miles of one of the following offices: Boston, MA; Portland, Oregon; Plano, TX or Hoffman Estates, IL and Lake Mary, Florida. Please note this policy is subject to change.

Responsibilities:

  • Plans and conducts investigations of multi-party construction bodily injury and property damage liability claims across jurisdictions. Independently manage moderate to high exposure claims involving Commercial General Liability policies including OCP, OCIP, CCIP and Self-Insured Retention programs. Conduct timely liability investigations, evaluate risk transfer opportunities, and develop defense strategies in coordination with counsel to drive efficient, outcome-focused resolutions.
  • Drive proactive claim outcomes through early investigations and strategic decision making. Own the full claim lifecycle from coverage analysis and reserving to negotiation and resolution by making timely, well-supported decisions. Actively manage litigation, set clear expectations with clients and counsel, and pursue early resolution strategies to reduce cycle time, legal spend, and overall claim severity.
  • Acts as senior technical professional on team, mentor and elevate team performance through coaching. Serve as a resource for less experienced adjusters by providing real-time guidance on coverage, liability, and investigation strategy. Reinforce best practices in documentation, reserving and communication, contributing to improved QA outcomes and consistent execution across the team.
  • Participates in conducting Suit Committees, Roundtables, Arbitrations, Mediations, field investigations and may assist in conducting closed file reviews.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Moderate technical expertise handling commercial auto and general liability bodily injury and property damage claims preferred. Demonstrated ability to handle multi-part litigation, contract interpretation, and risk transfer (additional insured and indemnity) preferred. interpersonal skills to communicate and negotiate with customers and conduct investigations required.
  • 4-6 years experience in managing 3rd party bodily injury and property damage litigated claims for both insured and self-insured clients, including directing defense counsel, evaluating exposure, and negotiating settlements.
  • Demonstrated leadership ability and time management skills to delegate work appropriately and organize resources effectively.
  • Licensing required in some states

Job.JobTitle: Assistant Regional Vice President Personal Lines
Job.JobDescription:
Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That's the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$161,400.00 - $266,300.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

With broad oversight, the Assistant Regional Vice President (ARVP) assists the Regional Vice President in strategic management of the agency plant and has primary responsibility for marketing strategy and business development driving profitable growth for the assigned territory.

This position manages others (RSDs, Sr. Sales Executives, and Sales Executives).

What Will You Do?

  • Leadership:
  • Responsible for hiring, coaching and mentoring Regional Sales Directors, Sales Executives and Sr. Sales Executives to achieve Regional goals.
  • Coaches and trains staff in agency managements, sales, PI business, and financial management.
  • Applies effective performance management practices.
  • Provides coaching and management to Regional Sales Directors to meet performance results.
  • Holds Regional Sales Directors accountable for managing business partnerships with Claim, Business Centers, other Travelers and PI distribution channels, and Home Office business units.
  • Develops a strong distribution network for PI products through the independent agency system and related systems.
  • Explores feasibility of alternative distribution channels.
  • Drives the development and execution of strategies to produce profitable Personal Insurance business.
  • Develops overall sales and distribution strategy for Personal Insurance, consistent with overall Personal Insurance objectives and initiatives.
  • Ensures that staff and agency development strategies are executed to achieve business objectives.
  • Monitors and influences the regulatory and competitive environment and adjusts strategies to appropriately reflect the interest of the PI business.
  • Provides input into rates and product pricing in light of sales initiatives and results.
  • Responsible for ensuring that appropriate processes are in place to define, monitor and measure key results of PI sales distribution staff.
  • Makes decision adjustments based on the data and environment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Experience in Personal Insurance Lines.
  • Bachelor's degree in Sales/marketing or equivalent experience.
  • Master ability to Influence the Sale: ability to convince current and prospective agents to represent and promote Travelers products and services.
  • Master ability to deliver results: ability to focus on the bottom line and push self and others to meet set goals.
  • Master Relationship Management skills: superior interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with internal and external customers.
  • Master Communication skills: strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Master ability to adapt to change.
  • Demonstrates master problem solving skills and ability to exercise decisive Judgment.
  • Demonstrates Integrity.
  • Advanced ability to Lead and motivate others: Ability to direct and provide guidance to others.
  • Empowers others.
  • Creates a positive working environment.
  • Advanced ability to Coach and Develop Others: Ability to collaborate, provide constructive feedback and actively listen.
  • Advanced Strategic thinking: Ability to anticipate future consequences and trends accurately.
  • Broad knowledge and perspective and Is future oriented.
  • Advanced Distribution Focus.
  • Advanced ability to Plan and organize.
  • Ability to organize self and others.
  • Advanced ability to focus on Continuous Improvement.
  • Demonstrates advanced Courage of Convictions.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office products with ability to manipulate data in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint quickly and accurately.
  • Definition of Advanced Skills/Competencies: Demonstrated advanced knowledge and ability and can apply the competency in new or complex situations.
  • May guide other professionals.
  • Definition of Master Skills/Competencies: Demonstrates expert knowledge and ability, and can apply the competency in the most complex situations.
  • Develops new approaches, methods or policies in the area.
  • Is recognized as an expert, internally and externally.

What is a Must Have?

  • Minimum of 8 years of insurance sales experience, with experience in agency sales, product management, underwriting, operations.
  • A minimum of 5 years of management experience.
  • Ability to travel up to 75% of time.
  • Must be able to relocate.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Job Summary


Workplace: MEXICO - Remote ( #LI-Remote )

We are seeking a strategic and data-driven Learning Measurement & Analytics Lead to establish and execute the organization's learning measurement strategy. This role is responsible for ensuring learning and development programs are evaluated based on measurable business outcomes, enabling data-driven decision-making and demonstrating the value of learning investments across the organization.

As a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, you will partner with Learning & Development leaders, business stakeholders, and executive teams to design evaluation methodologies, conduct advanced analyses, and translate complex findings into actionable business insights. This role focuses on measuring behavior change, business impact, and return on investment (ROI), moving beyond traditional learning metrics to demonstrate organizational value.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in learning analytics, organizational research, and statistical analysis with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate insights in a compelling, business-focused manner.

Essential Job Functions

  • Develop and lead the organization's learning measurement and analytics strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and performance outcomes
  • Define and maintain standards for evaluating learning programs, including data collection methods, measurement frameworks, and reporting requirements
  • Ensure learning measurement, evaluation, and analytics practices comply with organizational policies, governance standards, regulatory requirements, and applicable data privacy guidelines
  • Conduct regular compliance and quality checks on measurement methodologies, data collection, reporting processes, and learning analytics outputs, identifying discrepancies or risks and recommending corrective actions
  • Design and implement scalable evaluation methodologies to measure behavior change, business impact, and learning effectiveness using frameworks such as Kirkpatrick Levels 3 and 4 and Phillips ROI
  • Build and manage learning analytics infrastructure and measurement platforms using tools such as Performativ, Qualtrics, or similar solutions
  • Integrate learning data with operational, talent, and business performance metrics to provide a comprehensive view of learning effectiveness
  • Conduct ROI analyses and advanced evaluation studies to assess the value and impact of learning initiatives
  • Design and execute structured evaluations, pilot programs, controlled experiments, and outcome studies to support evidence-based decision-making
  • Define evaluation methodologies, sampling approaches, comparison groups, and success metrics to ensure analytical rigor and validity
  • Perform statistical analyses using tools such as SPSS, Python, R, or equivalent analytical platforms
  • Develop executive-level dashboards, scorecards, and reports that communicate learning outcomes, business impact, and value realization
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, concise recommendations and business insights for senior leaders and stakeholders
  • Establish consistent measurement language and reporting standards focused on outcomes, performance improvement, and business value
  • Partner with stakeholders during project planning to define success measures, evaluation strategies, and business impact goals
  • Provide consultation and guidance on measurement design, data collection strategies, and interpretation of analytical findings
  • Develop reusable tools, templates, frameworks, and best practices to standardize learning measurement across the organization
  • Conduct external benchmarking and research to compare learning effectiveness against industry standards and leading practices
  • Build organizational capability in learning analytics and measurement through coaching, knowledge sharing, and stakeholder education
  • Influence leaders and business partners on the effective use of data, evidence, and measurement practices to support decision-making

Experience Requirements

  • Experience in Learning Analytics, People Analytics, Organizational Research, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, or a measurement-intensive Learning & Development role
  • Experience designing and executing advanced evaluation studies, business impact assessments, and ROI analyses
  • Strong expertise in learning measurement methodologies, including Kirkpatrick Levels 3 and 4, Phillips ROI, and outcome-based evaluation frameworks
  • Experience building and implementing analytics infrastructure, measurement platforms, and automated reporting solutions
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent platforms
  • Strong knowledge of research design, statistical methodologies, experimental design, sampling strategies, and data interpretation
  • Experience integrating learning data with business performance, operational, and workforce metrics
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into executive-level insights and recommendations

Benefits

This position offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work–life balance. The Learning Experience Coordinator is a key operational partner supporting University of Farmers learning, training, and leadership development programs. This role ensures that the logistics and administrative activities behind learning programs are organized, accurate, and delivered on time.

You will coordinate training schedules, learning cohorts, facilitators, learner registrations, leadership development events, workshops, credentialing programs, and stakeholder meetings. As a central point of contact for learners, facilitators, vendors, and business partners, you will help create a seamless learning experience while ensuring program details, communications, calendars, materials, and records are properly managed.

This is a highly collaborative role that requires strong organization, attention to detail, communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced learning environment.

Essential Job Functions

  • Coordinate the day-to-day logistics and administrative activities for learning, training, leadership development, credentialing, and special learning programs
  • Manage complex training calendars, cohort schedules, facilitator availability, learner registrations, workshops, and leadership development events
  • Coordinate multiple programs and activities simultaneously, ensuring timelines, schedules, and deliverables remain on track
  • Serve as a central point of contact for learners, facilitators, business partners, vendors, and other stakeholders
  • Manage learner communications, including invitations, confirmations, reminders, schedule updates, and program-related information
  • Coordinate facilitator schedules, session logistics, meeting arrangements, training materials, and other delivery requirements

  • Prepare and distribute learning materials, communications, agendas, and other program resources
  • Monitor program timelines and follow up on outstanding actions, ensuring deadlines and commitments are met
  • Coordinate meetings and events, including scheduling, logistics, participant communications, and follow-up activities
  • Partner with learning, leadership development, training, and business teams to understand operational needs and coordinate effective solutions
  • Support vendor coordination and administrative activities related to external learning providers and facilitators
  • Use learning management systems, scheduling tools, Microsoft Office, and other administrative platforms to manage program information and workflows
  • Conduct quality and accuracy checks on schedules, learner records, communications, and program materials
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, operational issues, or missing information and proactively coordinate solutions
  • Maintain organized documentation and records in accordance with organizational policies and program requirements
  • Support reporting and tracking of program participation, attendance, completion, and other operational metrics
  • Contribute to process improvements that make learning program coordination more efficient and improve the learner experience
  • Ensure program administration and learner information are handled accurately and in accordance with applicable policies, confidentiality requirements, and data privacy standards

Experience Requirements

  • Experience in program coordination, learning operations, training coordination, administrative coordination, project coordination, or a related field
  • Experience managing complex calendars and coordinating multiple concurrent programs or events
  • Strong organizational and scheduling skills, with excellent attention to detail and follow-through

Job Summary

The Direct modeling team is focused on creating models to guide enterprise marketing decision that will help to promote brand awareness as well as boost sales through direct channel. This role will help the team to design, set up, and monitor the data ecosystem that's needed to support the modeling needs. Tasks include, but not limited to, setting up data pipelines and design efficient data storage solutions.

Data infrastructure development:

  • Pipeline Design and Development; Architects and builds scalable data pipelines using modern ETL (Extract, Load, Transform) tools and frameworks such as DBT (Data Build Tool), or similar.
  • Automates data ingestion processes from various sources including databases, APIs, and third party services.
  • Data Storage and Management - Designs and implements data warehousing solutions using platforms like Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery.
  • Optimizes storage solutions for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability.

  • Data Modeling - Develops and maintains logical and physical data models to support business analytics.

  • Data Quality Assurance - Conducts data validation and consistency checks to ensure the accuracy and reliability of data. Implements data quality monitoring and alerting mechanisms.

Collaboration and stakeholder management:

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration - Works closely with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and understand their data needs.
  • Acts as a liaison between technical teams and business units to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

Data governance and security knowledge:

  • Defines and manages data access, controls, permissions, and audit trails.
  • Security Measures - Monitors and enforces data security measures to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access and breaches.
  • Ensures compliance with industry standards and regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, or HIPAA and others as applicable.

You will oversee Medium to large-scale data initiatives, align cross-functional engineering teams, and deliver robust data infrastructure that powers actionable business insights and advanced analytics. The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise with a solid understanding of modern data ecosystems, cloud technologies, and analytics platforms. You will partner closely with engineering, architecture, data science, business intelligence, and business stakeholders to deliver impactful, data-driven solutions that enable informed decision-making and business growth.

  • Develops and manages business certification of all analytic related data projects.
  • Manages assigned direct reports and functions as a data/code trainer for the department.

  • Manage nearshore and offshore teams

Job.JobTitle: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Atlanta/Lawrenceville/Marietta, GA
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you willprovideexceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide,leveragingvarious platforms and software such as Xactimate andClaimsXVideo Collaboration. Yourexpertisewill be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'llwear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expertyoulllive into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you willaccomplishthat by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

  • The Investigator youllconfidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies todeterminecoverage.

  • The Effective Communicatoryoulluse phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process.Youllalso incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on theclaimprogress.

  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants,in accordance withall legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

  • The Problem Solveryoullutilizemultiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, andadditionalsettlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

  • The Recorderyoullprotect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trainedin.Youllaccomplishthis by ensuringtimelyandaccuratedocumentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 3years'previousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Previousexperience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

  • Proficiencyin using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately andexpediteclaimssettlements.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

  • This position is not available for California, Alaska,Hawaiior Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

  • Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch onaone to two-story roof.

  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Youreprovided with comprehensive training:

  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in yourday-to-daywork.

  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

  • You willbe requiredto attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing anadditionalbackground check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you willbe requiredto secure license(s) within60 daysof hire.

  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/orapplicableAppraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-onbonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership teamdeterminesthis based on annual work mileage for this location. You maybe requiredto use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as anAllstater,youllenjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job.JobTitle: Inside Auto Claims Adjuster - Midwest Zone
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Inside Auto Claims Adjuster is responsible for investigating basic and occasionally moderately complex auto insurance claims. This role may handle non-represented claims and requires evaluating coverage, determining liability, and negotiating settlements. The adjuster works directly with claimants, insureds, and other involved parties to ensure timely, accurate, and customer-focused claim resolution.

To support business and operational needs, candidates selected for this role must reside in one of the following states at the time of hire: MD, OH, KS, WV, VA, IN, MN, NE, IL, WI, IA, ND, SD, MI, OK, KY, MO

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Investigate minor to moderately complex auto accidents and prepare clear, concise claim summaries.
  • Conduct recorded statements with claimants, insureds, and witnesses.
  • Evaluate auto claims to determine coverage, liability, and damages.
  • Negotiate and settle claims in alignment with established guidelines and best practices.
  • Maintain detailed and well-documented claim files, including notes, summaries, and decision rationale.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support efficient and customer-centric claim handling.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of prior claim handling experience preferred.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with a demonstrated commitment to excellent customer service.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail with solid critical-thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Comfortable using technology and learning claims-related software and tools.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Washington, and Hawaii residents.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, you may be expected to obtain an adjusters license in multiple markets.
  • All required licenses must be obtained within 60 days of hire.
  • You must maintain all licensing required for your role. This includes any continuing education and/or other state-affiliated requirements for licensing renewal.
  • This role offers a $1,000 sign on bonus if you have an active adjuster license in TX, FL, or your resident state.
  • Current employees and former employees seeking rehire at Allstate or its affiliated companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Schedule:

  • Training Schedule: Monday-Friday 8:00AM-4:45PM.

  • The hours of operation are MondayFriday, 7:00 AM to 5:30 PM, with occasional rotational Saturdays. Shift assignments are confirmed following training completion.

What You Need:

  • A dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What Allstate Provides:

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitor, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset a portion of your internet costs.

Allstate Benefits:

Allstate cares about you and your wellbeing. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that includes pay, benefits, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. You can choose whatever benefits are most important you. Here are some of our benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Allstate pension plan and 401(k) savings plan
  • Ayco financial coaching
  • Spring Health mental and emotional wellbeing resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Adoption reimbursement
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Wellness incentives
  • Allstate Foundation donation match and grant opportunities

Skills

Auto Insurance Claims, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Multitasking

Job.JobTitle: Attorney Repped Bodily Injury Adjuster (EHBI) - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

In this role, you will be responsible for investigating and resolving attorneyrepresented bodily injury claims within our Extended Handler Bodily Injury (EHBI) Casualty Unit. This includes confirming the facts of loss for complex automobile accidents, determining coverage, liability, and damages, and negotiating settlements within assigned authority limits. The role also includes mentoring and supporting junior team members, helping to drive consistent, highquality claim handling and development across the team.

We are seeking an experienced Attorney-Repped Bodily Injury Consultant. The ideal candidate will be comfortable navigating technology and thrive when juggling multiple priorities efficiently. Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and adaptable, with effective verbal and written communication abilities. Experience handling AL injury claims is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

Determines subrogation or fraud potential and how to handle for complex cases

Applies advanced understanding of insurance policies written by the company, the industry, and organizational relationships within the company and department

Handles investigation regarding all aspects of complex auto claims (coverage, liability and damages) with the exercise discretion and independence within increased level of authority

For claims involving injuries (if handled), learns how to review, evaluate, and negotiate moderate to complex injury claims

Recognizes and identifies body parts of a vehicle and understanding other potential property damage

Identifies customer needs and works to meet those needs using appropriate customer service skills

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties.

As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.
