At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates sales organization is growing its virtual workforce, and we are looking for highly motivated individuals that thrive in a fast-paced sales environment and enjoy being rewarded for their efforts. At Allstate, we are committed to offering a reputable product suite that protects people from lifes uncertainties so they can realize their hopes and dreams.

As a full-time Insurance Sales Representative, you will:

  • Engage with active insurance shoppers via inbound/outbound calls, live chat, SMS, and more in a work from home call center environment.
  • Use your insurance expertise to uncover customer needs, identify coverage gaps, and recommend tailored solutions from Allstate products and products within the Allstate family of companies.
  • Convert warm leads into customers using a proven consultative sales strategy no cold calling required.
  • Work from home to drive sales growth while delivering an exceptional, customer-first experience.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Pay: $18/hour
  • Average Total Compensation: $52,730$76,480/year (base + uncapped performance-based incentives)
  • Incentives are productivity-based and governed by the applicable bonus plan, which is subject to change at Allstates discretion.

Full suite of employee benefits starting day one, including:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match and pension plan
  • Tuition reimbursement and career development
  • Wellness programs

Additional Benefits

  • Paid training from day one (classroom and hands-on)
  • Licensing support: study materials, exam reimbursement, and assistance
  • Monthly internet reimbursement
  • Home office equipment provided by Allstate

Why Join Allstate

  • No Prospecting: Warm leads delivered directly to you
  • Career Growth: Develop your skills within a dynamic, supportive Fortune 100 company
  • Supportive Culture: Learn from best-in-class leaders and motivated teammates
  • Trusted Brand: Be part of a company with 90+ years of industry experience
  • Diverse & Reputable Product Suite: Sell from a wide portfolio that meets every customers needs

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales or customer service (with a sales focus)
  • Active Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license in your state of residence (preferred)
  • If unlicensed, ability to obtain a Personal Lines or Property & Casualty Producer license with Allstates support
  • Sales Representatives are required to obtain and maintain all required resident and non-resident Producer licenses necessary to sell insurance products in any state designated by Allstate. This includes obtaining non-resident Producer licenses in all states as required for the role.
  • If hired, Sales Representative must relinquish all non-Allstate insurance carrier appointments and may not hold active appointments with other carriers while employed in this role, in accordance with Allstate licensing and appointment policies.
  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Reliable high-speed internet with wired connection (Ethernet)
  • Dedicated, distraction-free home workspace (equipment provided)
  • Comfortable working evenings and weekends
  • Receptive to feedback and performance coaching
  • Strong communication, critical thinking, and multitasking skills
  • Competitive, highly self-motivated and enjoys being rewarded for your efforts
  • Able to work independently and hold yourself accountable for your performance
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously

Essential Job Functions

  • Handle inbound and outbound customer calls as the primary method of customer engagement.
  • Maintain availability during assigned work hours to meet call volume and service expectations. This function is particularly crucial during an employees first 90 days of employment.
  • Deliver consultative sales conversations and complete transactions during live customer interactions.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, including evenings and weekends, based on business coverage needs.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and performance standards.
  • Navigate multiple computer systems simultaneously while actively engaged with customers.

This position is only available within theUS, but notcurrently available for Puerto Rico, California, New York, Alaska, Hawaii, or Washington state residents.

Candidates who reside in locations where the local minimum wage exceeds the base pay for this position are also not eligible for consideration. This is due to compliance with wage regulations and internal compensation practices.


Reasonable Accommodation Statement

Allstate provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of their role. During the first 90 days of employment, reasonable accommodations generally do not include removing essential job functions, creating new positions, or lowering performance or productivity standards.

Job Summary

Exhibits the fundamental qualities of a servant leader and demonstrates the fundamental principles and benefits of the Agile framework in an effort to improve team performance in the areas of quality, predictability, flow and velocity. Assists teams in meeting their delivery goals through enforcing team working agreements; communication techniques, coordination and cooperation; identifying and eliminating impediments; and ongoing coaching and development.

Essential Job Functions

  • Acts as a servant leader for a single team and stakeholders.
  • Aids the team and Product Owner in efforts to manage and sequence the backlog.
  • Leads less complex teams with work contained with limited external team impact or dependencies.
  • Works generally with internal systems involving few system integration points requiring occasional support from senior level Scrum Master.
  • Eliminates impediments and resolves issues with frequent support from Release Train Engineer or other resources.
  • Resolves and manages dependencies with frequent guidance from Release Train Engineer or other resources to support team improvement and promotes high performance.
  • Manages team performance in the areas of quality, predictability, flow and velocity and identifies SAFe anti-patterns and resolve with frequent support.
  • Utilizes beginner coaching capabilities to influence the team and help coach on practices and procedures.
  • With frequent support from RTE guides the team through the decision making process and teach techniques on how to problem solve, improve communication, self-manage and self-organize.
  • With frequent support from RTE Scrum Master, builds a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised.
  • Help manages interpersonal conflicts, challenges and opportunities for growth within the team.
  • Participates, facilitates and manages the outputs of all agile ceremonies including daily Stand Up meetings, Sprint review, sprint r etrospective, sprint planning, backlog refinement sessions, prepare for Program Increment Planning Sessions.
  • Participates in the Scrum Mastery Sync Sessions and Agile Release Train Sync Sessions.
  • Demonstrates ongoing desire for knowledge and continuous improvement by pursuing continuous education with regards to everything Agile (e.g. visit user groups, attend conferences, read books, write blogs, etc.).
  • Continuously works with the Scrum Master Community of Practice to ensure standard procedures are in place and ultimately improve the organizations' product delivery capability.
  • Seeks advice and works closely with other Scrum Masters and Release Train Engineers to establish best practices and resolve challenging issues, risks, conflicts or impediments.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Physical Environment

Bachelor's degree preferred.

Experience Requirements

  • 1+ year experience in an Agile environment or equivalent
  • 2+ years of experience as a Project Manager/Scrum Master
  • Experience working with stakeholders and working with nearshore and offshore teams.
  • Excellent communication skills

Job Summary

An SAP Data Analyst bridges the gap between raw data and business operations. They manage, extract, and interpret data within SAP environments to optimize performance, ensure data integrity, and support executive decision-making.

Essential Job Functions

  • Provides high level of expertise in the design and functionality of business applications
  • Understands the business objectives and how best they can be supported by IT
  • Responsible for the conceptual design of business applications
  • Reviews and validates the technical design for business applications provided by the supplier
  • Performs quality review checks on project deliverables
  • Validates suppliers estimates
  • Performs impact analysis of application changes across various components
  • Reviews and validates the detailed technical design for business applications provided by the supplier to ensure alignment with business requirements
  • Performs quality review checks on project deliverables
  • Supports the implementation activities, troubleshooting system environmental issues, training as required
  • Query SAP modules (such as SAP HANA, SAP BW, or SAP S/4HANA) to pull and compile actionable business datasets.
  • Maintain, audit, and update system master data to ensure accuracy across cross-functional enterprise systems
  • Transform raw SAP metrics into visual insights using enterprise tools like Power BI, Tableau, or SAP Analytics Cloud.
  • Investigate system anomalies, data drift, and data quality issues, implementing fixes to prevent operational disruptions.

Physical Environment

High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent, relevant experience.

Job Summary

Responsible for developing and supporting reporting, analytics, and data solutions across on-premises and cloud platforms. Primarily focuses on building, enhancing, and maintaining reporting solutions and datasets, while also supporting data pipelines, integration, and data platforms. Ensures data is reliable, governed, and available in a ready-to-use format for reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases. Translates business requirements into scalable reporting and data engineering solutions, including data modeling, connectivity, and production support

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and maintain reports, dashboards, and datasets to support business reporting and analytics needs.
  • Support preparation and transformation of structured and unstructured data for analytics, natural language processing, and AI-driven use cases.
  • Collaborate with business, reporting, and analytics teams to understand requirements and deliver reporting solutions aligned with business needs.
  • Support preparation and transformation of structured and unstructured data for reporting, analytics, and AI-driven use cases.
  • Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines to integrate data from multiple sources into enterprise platforms such as Snowflake or Lakehouse environments.
  • Configure and support data connectivity including gateways, service accounts, and secure access to data platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve reporting and data issues such as refresh failures, data discrepancies, and connectivity problems to ensure reliability.
  • Apply performance optimization techniques across reports, datasets, and data pipelines to improve efficiency and user experience.
  • Ensure adherence to data governance, security, and compliance standards, including access management and standardized processes.
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications and support delivery of reporting and data initiatives within defined timelines.
  • Create and maintain documentation for reports, datasets, data pipelines, and support processes.
  • Support data validation, cleansing, and enrichment to ensure accuracy for reporting, analytics, and AI/ML consumption.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Physical Environment

  • Strong experience working with PowerBI (Power Query and DAX)
  • Strong knowledge in SQL

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Join the legal frontline and champion the defense for both the insured and Allstate! As a Senior Trial Attorney, you'll independently manage a complex litigation caseload involving bodily injury, property damage and PIP/No-Fault lawsuits, subrogation matters, and uninsured/underinsured motorist claims.

You'll lead trials, arbitrations, mediations, and high-exposure negotiations while providing strategic counsel to business partners and collaborating across legal teams. Stay ahead of the game by monitoring new laws and regulations, ensuring our litigation strategies remain sharp and effective. Embrace the excitement of challenging cases, courtroom advocacy, and meaningful victories in this dynamic role!

Key Responsibilities

  • Represents insured individuals and Allstate in the defense of bodily injury and property damage lawsuits, subrogation litigation, PIP/no-fault matters, and uninsured/underinsured motorist cases.

  • Independently manages all aspects of litigation from case inception through resolution, including case evaluation, discovery, motion practice, arbitrations, mediations, settlement negotiations, and trial.
  • Reviews new file assignments, analyzes documentary evidence, develops litigation strategy, and directs discovery efforts.
  • Prepares for and conducts hearings, depositions, examinations under oath, arbitrations, mediations, settlement conferences, and trials.
  • Drafts and argues substantive motions and prepares complex pleadings, trial documents, and motions in limine.
  • Prepares witnesses, clients, and expert witnesses for depositions, arbitrations, mediations, and trial testimony.
  • Investigates and pursues subrogation opportunities and recovery efforts, as appropriate.
  • Provides legal counsel and strategic litigation guidance to claims business partners and other internal clients.
  • Keeps claim business partners informed regarding case developments, litigation strategy, exposure assessments, settlement recommendations, and trial preparation.
  • Keeps abreast of and evaluates new laws, regulations, and case law developments; identifies emerging legal trends and proactively advises business partners regarding potential impacts.
  • The Senior Trial Attorney is required to travel to court as needed throughout the Metro Boston area, Worcester, the South Shore, Greater Boston, and other locations across Massachusetts in support of litigation responsibilities, including court appearances, depositions, mediations, arbitrations, and trials.

Education

  • Juris Doctorate and active membership in good standing with the Massachusetts State Bar.

Experience

  • 4+ years of litigation experience within insurance defense, bodily injury, personal injury, PIP/no-fault litigation, subrogation, or related civil litigation fields.
  • First or second chair jury trial experience preferred.
  • Experience conducting depositions, mediations, arbitrations, hearings, and settlement negotiations.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage an active litigation caseload through resolution.
  • Strong legal research, writing, analytical, and advocacy skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, legal research platforms, and internet-based legal research tools.
  • Strong teamwork skills, able to collaborate effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and administrative assistants.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote/hybrid environment and travel throughout Massachusetts, including the Metro Boston area, Worcester, the South Shore, Greater Boston, and other court venues as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

***This role is also eligible for a bonus plan

Explore the Benefits of Joining Allstate's Client Legal Services:

  • Exceptional Work-Life Balance:At Allstate, we understand the importance of achieving harmony between work and personal life. Our in-house litigation roles provide more predictable schedules and flexibility, allowing you to excel professionally while enjoying a fulfilling personal life.
  • Holistic Understanding of the Business:As part of the Allstate legal team, you'll gain invaluable insight into our diverse business operations, objectives, and culture. This comprehensive understanding enables you to align legal strategies closely with the company's goals, fostering impactful contributions and strategic partnerships across departments.
  • Direct Client Collaboration:Working in-house at Allstate means collaborating directly with internal stakeholders and business units. This close partnership cultivates deeper client relationships, facilitating a nuanced understanding of their needs and priorities. By providing proactive legal guidance and support, you'll play a pivotal role in driving the company's success.
  • Strategic Influence and Impact:As an integral member of our legal team, you'll have the opportunity to shape strategic decisions and risk management initiatives. Your insights and expertise will inform key business decisions, empowering you to mitigate risks effectively and drive positive outcomes that directly impact Allstate's bottom line.
  • Diverse Legal Challenges:In-house litigation roles at Allstate encompass a broad spectrum of legal work beyond traditional litigation, including regulatory compliance, risk assessment, and dispute resolution. This diversity of challenges ensures continuous professional growth and development, expanding your skill set and enhancing your career trajectory.
  • Professional Growth Opportunities:With opportunities for advancement and professional development, you'll have the support and resources you need to reach new heights in your legal career.

Become a part of our story.

The Role

As a talented Digital Product Manager, you love to execute on strategic vision and turning it into something tangible whether that be a story, a design or even code. We need you to get your hands dirty with raw data and derive meaningful and actionable insights that you can use to influence direction of product team and those that surround it. Youre an innovative thinker, an independent mover, an expert communicator, and an agile problem solver looking to join an exciting team.

As an ideal candidate, you can learn and adapt quickly and are able to use every tool at your disposalsoftware, data, analytics and beyondto understand and effectively tackle hard problems. You appreciate the importance working through problem statements and defining success before the team writes code. You can hop into architecture, UX, and business discussions and ensure that the team is always driving towards collective success.

Product Roadmap Execution: Craft and execute a comprehensive product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements. Ensure that portfolio of products are aligned horizontally and meeting product goals.

User Experience Design: Advocate and design for seamless user experiences, from concept to execution.

  • Agile Processes: Proficiency in Agile methodologies (e.g., iterations, point systems, refinements).

  • Adaptability: Comfort operating in an agile environment with ambiguity.

  • Data Literacy: Navigate complex data landscapes, leveraging insights to inform product decisions

  • Analytical skills: Ability to independently analyze and query data to find insights and understand patterns. Working knowledge of SQL and some coding skills (Python) would be a plus.

Skills

Agile Methodology, Amazon Web Services (AWS), API Integration, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Business Case Analyses, Critical Thinking, Digital Product Management, Microsoft Azure, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Python (Programming Language), Systems Thinking, User Experience (UX)

Job Description

A day in the life of a Large Loss Property Contents Adjuster:


  • Handle escalated claims files that have complex contents and ALE.
  • You enjoy working independently from home.
  • Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.
  • You will be using advanced video technology to collaborate with onsite vendors to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.
  • Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair and easy manner.
  • Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.
  • Coordinate with structure adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file.
  • Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert youll live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver youll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • 3 years experience handling Large Loss property contents claims and ALE expenses using Xactimate for complex estimating.
  • Previous experience handling property insurance claims.
  • Experience managing 100+ inventory property content items per claim.
  • Value providing an effortless customer service experience.
  • View problems and setbacks as opportunities for improvement and look forward to coming up with creative solutions.
  • Are organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.
  • Are known for clear and professional communication both written and verbal.

Schedule:

  • Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm, with rotational Saturday or Sunday duty.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser licensewhich includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor.If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.



Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

Job Description

Help Customers Navigate Their Health Coverage with Confidence

Are you passionate about helping people, building relationships, and making a difference in customers' lives? Join our team as a Licensed Customer Engagement Specialist, where you'll serve as a trusted guide for customers, agents, and prospective members seeking support with their Accident & Health insurance needs.

In this role, you'll combine your customer service expertise, communication skills, and insurance knowledge to educate customers, answer questions, support enrollment and retention efforts, and connect individuals with solutions that fit their unique situations. If you're a motivated professional who enjoys helping others, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and values meaningful customer interactions, we'd love to hear from you.

Why You'll Love This Role
Make a direct impact by helping customers understand and access important health insurance products and services.
Work from home in a supportive, team-oriented environment.
Expand your skills through continuous training, coaching, and cross-functional learning opportunities.
Be part of a collaborative team that values flexibility, customer advocacy, and professional growth.
Utilize your Accident & Health insurance license to make a meaningful difference in every customer interaction.

What You'll Do


As a Licensed Customer Engagement Specialist, you'll proactively engage customers through outbound outreach while delivering exceptional service and support. You'll help customers navigate their insurance options, answer questions, and ensure they have access to the resources they need.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct high-volume outbound outreach using approved dialing systems and customer lists.
  • Build rapport quickly and create positive customer experiences through professional, empathetic communication.
  • Educate customers about available programs, services, benefits, and next steps.
  • Follow approved scripts and compliance requirements while maintaining an authentic and conversational approach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and follow-up activities within company systems.
  • Address questions, identify customer needs, and escalate complex issues when appropriate.
  • Protect sensitive customer information and comply with all privacy, regulatory, and company requirements.
  • Support inbound customer calls and other service initiatives as business needs evolve.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and development activities to continuously strengthen your skills.
  • Collaborate with teammates and cross-functional partners to deliver a seamless customer experience.

What We're Looking For


Required Qualifications

  • Active Accident & Health Insurance License in your state of residence (required).
  • Bilingual Requirement: Fluency in Spanish and English (required)
  • Strong customer service background with a passion for helping others.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to build trust, demonstrate empathy, and navigate sensitive conversations professionally.
  • Comfortable working in a structured environment with established processes and scripts.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to accurately document customer interactions.
  • Ability to work independently while remaining highly engaged with a team.



Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous call center, healthcare, health insurance, Medicare, sales support, or customer engagement experience.
  • Experience working remotely and maintaining productivity in a home-office environment.
  • Prior experience in high-volume outbound calling environments.

Success in This Role


The ideal candidate is:

  • Customer-focused and passionate about helping others.
  • Adaptable and comfortable shifting between outbound and inbound support as business needs change.
  • Open to cross-training and learning new responsibilities.
  • Coachable and receptive to feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Confident following required scripts and compliance guidelines while delivering a personalized customer experience.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and able to stay productive in a remote work environment.
  • Resilient and professional when managing challenging conversations or customer concerns.

Work Environment


This position may be performed remotely, in a hybrid setting, or in an office environment based on business needs. Team members use company-provided technology and must maintain a secure, professional workspace that supports confidential customer conversations.


Join Us


If you're a licensed insurance professional who enjoys connecting with people, solving problems, and delivering exceptional service, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career while making a meaningful impact on customers every day. We welcome motivated, customer-focused professionals who are eager to learn, grow, and contribute to a high-performing team.


Apply today and help customers navigate their health insurance journey with confidence.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Represented/Litigation Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

The individual selected for this role will join a team who primarily handles claims in the following states: Alabama, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina

As a Represented/Litigation adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

* Candidates in the Central and Eastern time zones preferred. *

**This position is not available for Alaska, Hawaii, Washington, or Puerto Rico residents.**


Job Description

Allstate Benefits
Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visitwww.allstategoodlife.comto learn more.

  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solveryoull utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 3+years of Casualty Represented or Litigation UM/UIM claim handling experiencerequired
  • Candidates with experience in AL/GA/NC/SC a plus
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Job.JobTitle: Virtual Auto Supplement Estimator - National General
Job.JobDescription:
National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Virtual Auto Supplement Estimator to support material damage claims through accurate estimate writing, supplement creation, and repair negotiations. This role is fully remote and requires a highly skilled estimator who can independently evaluate damages, write and revise estimates, negotiate repair costs, and assist with total loss and repairability decisions.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience preparing estimates, writing supplements, and negotiating directly with repair facilities, rather than solely reviewing estimates prepared by others.

This role will be primarily supporting claims in the Western region. The ideal candidate will preferably reside in Pacific, Mountain, or Central time zone.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create, review, and finalize comprehensive auto damage estimates for first- and third-party claims.
  • Independently prepare and write supplements based on repair findings and additional damage discovery.
  • Compile accurate repair estimates using industry-standard estimating platforms, primarily CCC ONE.
  • Negotiate repair costs and supplements directly with body shops and repair facilities.
  • Assess repairability, damage consistency, and estimate accuracy.
  • Support repair-versus-total-loss evaluations through estimate and valuation analysis.
  • Ensure estimates align with company guidelines, policy coverage, and applicable claims handling practices.
  • Maintain clear documentation of estimate decisions, negotiations, and claim activities.
  • Partner with claims professionals, repair facilities, and customers to facilitate timely claim resolution.
  • Manage workload independently within a fully remote environment while meeting productivity and quality expectations.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Auto damage estimating experience.
  • Direct body shop negotiation experience.
  • Experience writing and managing supplements.
  • Experience compiling and creating estimates from the ground up, not solely auditing or reviewing estimates.
  • Strong working knowledge of vehicle repair processes, repair procedures, and damage analysis.
  • Previous experience using CCC ONE estimating software.
  • Strong written and verbal negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.
  • Advanced-level estimator experience comparable to an Estimator III environment.
  • Prior experience handling higher-complexity supplement and repair negotiations.
  • Total loss and valuation exposure.
  • Prior insurance carrier or collision repair estimating experience.

Job Description

The Measurement Science Lead Consultant combines deep analytical expertise with strong consulting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. This role is responsible for defining and ensuring high-quality measurement practices across Claims. This role serves as a strategic leader and subject matter expert, partnering with business and analytics teams to ensure initiatives are measured accurately, enabling confident, data-driven decision making. Reducing the risk of misinformed decisions is critical to the future success of Allstate.
The role is guided by 3 core pillars.
Consult: We have short term consulting engagements with teams across claims. These engagements are used to provide feedback and course correct measurement on specific projects.
Embed: We have long-term engagements. This role periodically serves as a dedicated resource within business and product teams, providing hands-on analytical support, domain expertise, and partnership to help achieve strategic objectives.
Educate: We help educate claims leaders and employees on how to think about and execute with measurement science.

Communication & Stakeholder Influence

  • Translate complex analytical concepts into clear business recommendations.
  • Present findings, risks, and opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Build strong partnerships across Claims, Analytics, Technology and Finance.
  • Lead complex measurement engagements involving multiple stakeholders.

Measurement Strategy & Consulting

  • Partner with business leaders to define business objectives, success metrics, assumptions, and measurement approaches.
  • Provide consultative expertise on measurement design and business outcomes. Ensure analyses are accurate, defensible, and aligned to business objectives.
  • Identify measurement risks and opportunities that could impact decision quality.
  • Promote consistent measurement standards, frameworks, and best practices.

Experimental Design & Evaluation

  • Design and execute experiments, quasi-experiments, and observational studies.
  • Apply statistical and causal inference methods to evaluate business initiatives.
  • Establish baselines, control groups, and success criteria to support valid attribution.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, data science, measurement science, economics, statistics, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated experience designing experiments, causal inference analyses, or program evaluations.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience influencing decisions through analytics and business consulting.
  • Experience working in matrixed organizations and partnering with senior business stakeholders.
  • Claims experience preferred but not required.

Job.JobTitle: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Represented/Litigation, Complex/Severe - CA, NW & SW States (Remote)
Job.JobDescription:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Job Description Summary
A day in the life of a Represented/Litigation Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job:

The individual selected for this role will join a team who primarily handles claims in the following states: California and Northern and Southern West Coast states.

As a Complex/Severe Represented/Litigation adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury with attorney/litigation involved. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer and attorney communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with all parties involved.

*Candidates in the Pacific time zone are preferred. Candidates in the Mountain and Central time zones will be considered if willing to work hours of 8 am - 4:30 pm PST or 9 am - 5:30 pm PST.*

**This position is not available for Alaska, Hawaii, Washington, or Puerto Rico residents.**

Allstate Benefits
Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, youll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visitwww.allstategoodlife.comto learn more.

Youll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expertyoull live into Allstates Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in eachcasualtyclaim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator youll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator youll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. Youll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solveryoull utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder youll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. Youll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

  • 3+years of Casualty Represented or Litigation third-party claim handling experiencerequired.
  • California and/or Northwest or Southwest States Casualty Claim handling experience preferred.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Notice of Licensing Requirement

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Job Description

The Data Analytics Engineer will help the Risk Data Team create a trusted, connected, and insight-driven risk ecosystem where high-quality data enables faster decisions, proactive risk management, and measurable improvements in control effectiveness. This hands-on role transforms fragmented risk, control, regulatory, and operational data into reliable, accessible, and actionable information through analytics, reporting, automation, governed datasets, and reusable data products. The role partners with risk, control, product, engineering, and leadership stakeholders to improve confidence in risk data, reduce manual reporting, and surface insights that help the organization understand trends, identify weaknesses, and prioritize action.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complex risk data analytics initiatives from requirements through delivery, validation, implementation, and operational support.
  • Partner with risk, control, regulatory, product, engineering, and leadership stakeholders to translate business questions into clear data, analytics, and reporting requirements.
  • Build and maintain trusted risk datasets, semantic models, dashboards, reports, and reusable analytics products using SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Python, and advanced Excel.
  • Integrate and analyze information from internal platforms, vendor tools, external sources, and operational systems to create a connected view of risk and control performance.
  • Automate data collection, preparation, validation, reconciliation, refreshes, and recurring reporting processes to reduce reliance on spreadsheets and manual effort.
  • Define, document, and apply common risk metrics, data definitions, business rules, and quality standards so reporting is consistent, traceable, and trusted.
  • Produce analytics that identify trends, control weaknesses, emerging risks, performance gaps, and opportunities to prioritize risk action.
  • Support governed, analytics-ready data products that can safely enable leadership reporting, operational insight, automation, and future AI-based capabilities.
  • Establish best practices for data sourcing, transformation, quality, documentation, governance, access, and reporting adoption.
  • Coach analysts and enable stakeholders through technical consultation, reusable templates, training, and practical guidance on using trusted risk data.

Experience:

  • 3 or more years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, risk analytics, data governance, operational reporting, or a related field.
  • Experience delivering analytics, reporting, or data product solutions from requirements through implementation and ongoing improvement.
  • Experience working with risk, compliance, controls, audit, cybersecurity, technology operations, insurance, or other complex business data is preferred.
  • Experience improving data quality, reconciling data sources, defining metrics, documenting business rules, or reducing manual reporting processes is preferred.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • This job does not have supervisory duties.

At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from lifes uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstates Risk Data Team is seeking a Data Engineer to help build the trusted data foundation that enables faster decisions, proactive risk management, and measurable improvements in control effectiveness. This role will focus on transforming fragmented risk and control data into reliable, accessible, and actionable information through scalable data pipelines, governed datasets, analytics-ready data products, and automation.

You will work closely with analytics engineers, product teams, risk partners, platform teams, and governance stakeholders to integrate data from internal platforms, vendor tools, and external sources. The role plays a critical part in reducing reliance on manual reporting and spreadsheets, improving confidence in risk data, and enabling dashboards, reporting, analytics, and future AI-based capabilities across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain trusted risk data products and scalable batch and streaming data pipelines using cloud-native technologies.
  • Integrate data from risk platforms, control systems, vendor tools, operational applications, and external sources into governed, analytics-ready datasets.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT workflows that automate data ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and delivery.
  • Build and manage data processing workloads within modern data lake and lakehouse environments, including Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.
  • Implement data quality, monitoring, lineage, and reconciliation processes to ensure data reliability, consistency, and accuracy.
  • Create curated datasets and analytical outputs that support operational reporting, leadership dashboards, trend analysis, risk identification, and decision-making.
  • Optimize data architectures, schemas, and processing patterns for scalability, performance, resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and operational monitoring to improve productivity and maintainability.
  • Partner with analytics, product, risk, governance, security, and compliance stakeholders to establish data definitions, metrics, quality standards, and secure data access.
  • Participate in Agile delivery activities including sprint planning, backlog refinement, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role building and supporting production-grade data pipelines and data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Spark for large-scale data processing and transformation.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and modern data engineering best practices.
  • Experience developing ETL/ELT solutions within cloud-based data lake, lakehouse, or analytics platforms.
  • Experience designing and optimizing analytical data models that support reporting, dashboards, operational insights, and advanced analytics.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, validation, monitoring, reconciliation, and production support processes.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex data quality, performance, and integration issues across multiple data sources.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, or similar modern analytics platforms preferred.

Essential Qualifications

  • Experience working with risk, controls, compliance, audit, governance, or regulatory data domains.
  • Experience building real-time, near real-time, or event-driven data processing solutions.
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, data lineage, access controls, and enterprise data quality frameworks.
  • Experience with orchestration and workflow management tools for data pipelines.
  • Experience supporting operational reporting, executive dashboards, trend analysis, advanced analytics, or machine learning initiatives.
  • Interest in building governed, scalable datasets that support AI and data-driven products.

Apache Spark, Data Engineering, Data ETL, Python (Programming Language), Software Development, Structured Query Language (SQL)

Compensation offered for this role is 100,000.00 - 170,500.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. Job Description

As a Material Damage (MD) Claims Adjuster you are responsible for investigating and confirming the facts of loss for basic to advanced automobile accidents. Determines coverage, liability, damages and otherwise adjusts and negotiates claims within limit of authority.

We are seeking an experienced Material Damage Claims Adjuster who is passionate about delivering exceptional customer service to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate resides in the CST time zone and brings strong customer service skills with a focus on empathy and professionalism. This individual demonstrates expertise in de-escalation techniques and effective communication, thrives in a collaborative environment, and works well across teams. Additionally, the candidate should have a solid foundation in coverage investigation and liability determination, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in handling claims.


Key Responsibilities

Determines subrogation or fraud potential and how to handle for complex cases

Applies advanced understanding of insurance policies written by the company, the industry, and organizational relationships within the company and department

Handles investigation regarding all aspects of complex auto claims (coverage, liability and damages) with the exercise discretion and independence within increased level of authority

For claims involving injuries (if handled), learns how to review, evaluate, and negotiate moderate to complex injury claims

Recognizes and identifies body parts of a vehicle and understanding other potential property damage

Identifies customer needs and works to meet those needs using appropriate customer service skills

This job does not have supervisory duties.
